kāmaiṣaṇā tu prāṇaiṣaṇādhanaiṣaṇayorantarbhāvanīyā, śarīrasampattidhanasampattisādhyatvāt kāmasya; yadi vā kāmaiṣaṇāyāṃ svata eva puruṣaḥ pravṛtto bhavati nopadeśamapekṣata iti tadeṣaṇopadeśo na kṛtaḥ
trayāṇāṃ madhye dve pūrve bhavataḥ, tṛtīyāyāḥ sarvottaratvenāpūrvatvāt; tena dvayostara iti nyāyāt pūrvataraṃ prāṇaiṣaṇeti sādhustaraprayogaḥ
prāṇaśabdo jīvitavacana ekavacanāntoapyasti; yaduktaṃ- “daśaivāyatanānyāhuḥ prāṇo yeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ” (sū.a.30) iti, tena prāṇapratyavamarśakaṃ ‘tasya’ iti padamekavacanena yuktameva
prāṇānupālanāditi prāṇānupālanasādhanāt; tena prāṇānupālanadīrghāyuṣṭvayorarthābhedāt sādhyasādhanabhāvo nāstīti yaccocyate tannirastaṃ bhavati
dvitīyāmiti hetugarbhaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, yasmādiyameva dvitīyā prāṇaiṣaṇānantaramavaśyopādeyatvena, tata iyamevocyata ityarthaḥ
prāṇaiṣaṇāmanu cāsyāḥ prādhānyaṃ darśayati- prāṇebhyo hītyādi
upakaraṇam ārogyabhogadharmasādhanībhūto dhanaprapañcaḥ, sa yasya nāstyasāvanupakaraṇaḥ
dhanopāyāniti vaktavye upakaraṇopāyāniti yataḥ karoti, tena dhanasya bhogadharmasādhanārthamevotpādamicchanti, na punaḥ kṛpaṇasyeva viniyogaśūnyasya susaṃvardhitamātrakaraṇārtham
dīrghaṃ jīvitaṃ jīvati dhārayatītyarthaḥ, anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ; yadi vā dīrghajīvitaṃ yathā syāttathā jīvatīti kriyāviśeṣaṇatvena vyākhyeyam
atra ca paralokasya durjñeyatvena cārvākādināstikāsammatatvena ca paralokaṃ pramāṇena vyavasthāpayituṃ nirṇayārthaṃ pramāṇapravṛttiviṣayaṃ saṃśayameva tāvat paraloke darśayati- saṃśayaścātretyādi
itaścyutā iha janmani mṛtāḥ, bhaviṣyāmo janmāntara ityarthaḥ
nāsti punarbhavo nāsti karmaphalaṃ nāstyātmetyādināstinā pracaratīti nāstikaḥ, tasya bhāvo nāstikyam
yata pratyakṣapramāṇenopalabhyate ghaṭapaṭādi, tadeva paramasti; nopalabhyate ca pratyakṣeṇa paralokaḥ, tasmānnāsti paraloka iti nāstikābhiprāyaḥ
asti punarbhava iti yeṣāṃ mataṃ tān darśayati- santītyādi
evaṃ tāvadvādivipratipattirekā saṃśayakāraṇaṃ darśitā; saṃśayahetvantaramāha- śrutibhedāccetyādi
etāni ca mātāpitarāveva janmakāraṇamityādīni punarbhavapratikṣepakāṇi vacanāni
āgamapratyayādasti punarbhava iti yo brūte, tadvacanena samaṃ vādivipratipattirūpatayaiva saṃśayakāraṇaṃ bhavatītyata uktamupasaṃhāre ‘ataḥ saṃśayaḥ’ iti

eke manyante janmakāraṇamiti janmakāraṇamiti padaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā svabhāvaṃ tathā paranirmāṇamiti padatrayeṇa sambadhyate; yadṛcchāṃ cāapare janā ityatra manyante janmakāraṇamiti padaṃ sambadhyate
mātāpitarāvevātmāntaranirapekṣāvapatyotpādane kāraṇaṃ, tena pūrvaśarīraṃ parityajya śarīrāntaraparigraharūpa ātmanaḥ paraloko nāstīti prathamavādinaḥ pakṣaḥ

paridṛśyamānapṛthivyādibhāvānāmevāyaṃ svabhāvo- yat- saṃyogaviśeṣānmilitāḥ santaścetanaṃ puruṣādilakṣaṇaṃ kāryaviśeṣamārabhante, yathā surābījādīni pratyekamamadakarāṇyapi madakaraṃ madyamārabhante, nātra kaścidātmā vidyate yasya paralokaḥ syāditi svabhāvavādino bhāvaḥ

para aiśvaryādiguṇayukta ātmaviśeṣaḥ, tena saṃsāryātmanirapekṣiṇā nirmāṇaṃ paranirmāṇaṃ, tatrāpi parasyaivaiśvaryādiguṇayuktasyātmaviśeṣasya prabhāvādbhūtāni cetayante nātmāntaramastīti paralokābhāvaḥ

yadṛcchā kāraṇāpratiniyamenotpādaḥ; na kāraṇapratiniyamena kāryotpādoavadhārayituṃ śakyate, avadhārakapramāṇānāṃ prāmāṇyānavadhāraṇāt; tasmādātmaiva punarbhavamanubhavatīti na vācyamiti yādṛcchikasyābhiprāyaḥ
nāstyeva paraloka iti viparyayajñānaṃ nāstikyabuddhiḥ, tāṃ jahyāt

paralokaviṣayo viparyayo yathā dharmānuṣṭhānaṃ prati virodhakaḥ, tathā stokakrameṇāsti paraloko na veti saṃśayoapi dharmānuṣṭhānaṃ prati virodhaka ityāha- vicikitsāṃ ceti; vicikitsāṃ jahyāditi sambandhaḥ, vicikitsā sandehaḥ, sā ceha prakṛtatvāt paralokaviṣayaiva
apratyakṣatvāt paraloko nāstīti prathamavādimataṃ dūṣayati- pratyakṣamityādi

yathā, pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamavyabhicāripramājanakatvena; tathāaagamādīnyapi tathābhūtapramājanakatvāt pramāṇānyeva; tataśca pratyakṣāviṣayatvenaiva yat punarbhavasya nāstitvaṃ vyavasthāpyate tanna yuktamiti prakaraṇārthaḥ
pratyakṣāviṣayatve satyapi yānyanyapramāṇasiddhāni santi tānyāha- yairevetyādi

atisannikarṣādanupalabdhiryathā- nayanagatakajjalādeḥ, ativiprakarṣādyathā- dūrākāśagatasya pakṣiṇaḥ, āvaraṇādyathā- kuḍyādipihitasya ghaṭādeḥ, karaṇadaurbalyādyathā- kāmalādyupahatasya cakṣuṣaḥ paṭaśauklyādyapratibhānaṃ, manonavasthānādyathā- kāntāmukhanirīkṣaṇaprahitamanasaḥ pārśvāgatavacanānavabodhaḥ, samānābhihārādyathā- bilvarāśipraviṣṭasya bilvasyendriyasambaddhasyāpi bhedenāgrahaṇam, abhibhavādyathā- madhyandine ulkāpātasya, saukṣmyādyathā- tricaturhastapramāṇadeśavartinaḥ krimiviśeṣalikhyāderagrahaṇam
apatyaśarīre mātāpitroḥ kāraṇatvamanumatameva, yatastathāvidhe mātāpitroḥ kāraṇatve satyapi caitanyahetorātmanaḥ paralokādāgamane pretyabhāvoakhaṇḍita eveti
caitanyamapatyasya mātāpitrorapi caitanyaheturya ātmā tata eva bhavatīti yo manyate taṃ pratyāha- ātmā māturityādi
sarva iti mātaraṃ pitaraṃ parityajyāpatyaṃ gacchet; avayaveneti ekoavayavo vāaatmano mātari pitari vā tiṣṭhet, anyaścaikadeśa ātmanoapatyaṃ gacchet
nirantaramiti cchedaḥ, nirantaraṃ tatkālameva, yadi māturātmāapatyaṃ sañcarettadā tatkālameva māturmaraṇaṃ, yadi tu piturātmāapatyaṃ sañcarettadā tatkālameva piturmaraṇaṃ, syāditi
sūkṣmasyeti asthūlasya; sthūlānāṃ pṛthivyādīnāmavayavā bhavanti, na tu sūkṣmāṇāmākāśakālamanobuddhiprabhṛtīnāṃ; tataścāvayavābhāvādātmanoavayavena sañcaraṇaṃ dūramapāstamityarthaḥ
atha śaṅkyate- māaatmā mātāpitroḥ sañcaratu, buddhistu tayormano vāapatyaṃ sañcaratu, ata evāpatyasya caitanyaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāha- buddhirmanaścetyādi

nirṇīte vyavasthāpite pramāṇena, kimbhūtenetyāha- yathaivātmā niravayavatvenāvayavasañcaraṇākṣamastathā tatkālameva mātāpitṛparityāgaprasaṅgena kārtsnyenāpi sañcaritumakṣamaḥ, tathā te api buddhimanasī niravayavatvānnaikadeśena sañcareyātāṃ, mātāpitrostatkālamevābuddhimattvāmanaskatvaprasaṅgācca na kārtsnyena sañcareyātāmiti bhāvaḥ
evaṃ manyate- saṃsvedajānāṃ maśakādīnāṃ tathodbhijjānāṃ gaṇḍūpadādīnāṃ cetanānāṃ mātāpitarau na vidyete; tatasteṣāmacaitanyaṃ syāt, mātāpitroścetanakāraṇayorabhāvāditi
ṣaṇṇāṃ dhātūnāmiti pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśātmanām, eṣāṃ ca dhātutvaṃ śarīradhāraṇājjagaddhāraṇācca

svalakṣaṇam ātmīyamavyabhicāri lakṣaṇaṃ; tacca pṛthivyāḥ kāṭhinyādi, apāṃ dravatvādi, tejasa uṣṇatvādi, vāyostiryaggamanādi, ākāśasyāpratighātādi ātmano jñānādi; etena, etadeva parameṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ svābhāvikaṃ, na tāvadātmarahitānāmeṣāṃ caitanyamapi svābhāvikamastīti darśayati

tataśca yat pratyekaṃ bhūtānāṃ na sambhavati tanmilitānāmapi na sambhavati caitanyaṃ; yato bhūtānāmapi saṃyogāccaitanyasambhave bahūni cetanāni syurbālyādyavasthābhedāt, tataśca jñātṛbhedāt pratisandhānānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ; ātmasambandhena tu caitanyaṃ sammatameva, paraṃ tatrāpi garbhotpattau bhūtānāmātmasambandhe tathā maraṇe bhūtānāmātmano viyoge karmaiva janmāntarakṛtaṃ kāraṇaṃ, nānyat
atra paranirmāṇapakṣe śarīrasyātmarahitasya pareṇa nirmāṇaṃ vāabhipretaṃ syāt, ātmano vāapi pareṇa nirmāṇamabhipretaṃ syāt; ātmanaḥ paranirmāṇaṃ dūṣayati- anāderityādi
nityasya cetanādhātoriti ātmanaḥ; neṣyate nityasyotpādakakāraṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ; nityatvaṃ cātmanaḥ śārīre pratipādayiṣyati
atha śarīramātrasya paranirmāṇamabhipretaṃ, tadanumatameva; pareṇāaatmanā dharmādharmasahāyena tasya kriyamāṇatvādityāha- para ityādi
heturiṣṭa iti śarīrotpāde heturiṣṭa ityarthaḥ; astu paranirmitirīdṛśī pretyabhāvāvirodhinīti bhāvaḥ

evaṃ manyate- pareṇaiśvaryādiguṇayuktenātmaviśeṣeṇaitaccetanaṃ śarīraṃ kriyamāṇaṃ cetanāhetubhūtātiriktātmasambandhamantarā (cetanāyuktaṃ) kartuṃ na pāryeta, ghaṭādivadacetanatvaprasaṅgāt; cetanāhetuścātmā nityatvena na kriyate, tasmāccetanāhetunityatvena janmāntarasambandhinamātmānaṃ gṛhītvā śarīraṃ cetanaṃ paraḥ karotīti svīkaraṇīyam; evamapi ceśvaradaridrādijagadvaicitryadarśanādātmano dharmādharmayogavaicitryaṃ kalpanīyaṃ; tathāca satyātmana eva dharmādharmasahāyatāavaśyaṃ svīkaraṇīyā, tasmāt sa eva śarīrādyutpattau kāraṇamastu kimapareṇehātmaviśeṣakalpanena; yadi vā, evamātmanyanekajanmasambandhini saṃsārahetudharmādharmaguṇaśālini siddhe astu soapyātmaviśeṣaḥ kāraṇam, ato na kācit kṣatiriti
yadṛcchāvādī khalvekamapi pramāṇaṃ nānumanyate, tataśca tasyāprāmāṇikatvāt pramāṇaṃ vinaiva yatkiñcidbruvato na śraddheyaṃ vacanaṃ bhavati, tasmādupekṣaṇīya evāyamiti prakaraṇābhiprāyaḥ

yadṛcchayā aparisthitapakṣatayā, upahata ihalokaparalokānupayukta ātmā yasya sa yadṛcchopahatātmā; tasya parīkṣā nāstīti parīkṣāhetūnāṃ pramāṇānāmabhāvādityarthaḥ; parīkṣyamapi nāsti, parīkṣakapramāṇābhāvādeva; evaṃ kartāapi nāsti tatkāraṇamapi nāsti, pramāṇāsvīkārāditi bhāvaḥ; tathā sarvajanasiddhā devādayoapi na santītyabhidhānena nāstikasya varjanīyatvaṃ darśayati
pātakebhyo brahmāvadhādibhyaḥ; paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ; nāsti paraloka ityādiko graho nāstikagrahaḥ; nāstikabuddhyā hyucchṛṅkhalaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvamapi pātakaṃ karotīti bhāvaḥ
buddhireva pradīpo buddhipradīpaḥ, tena pratyakṣādipramāṇena paśyedityarthaḥ
samprati parapakṣaṃ dūṣayitvā svapakṣaparalokasādhanāni pramāṇānyavatārayati- dvividhamityādi
sarvamiti yatkiñcit pramāṇapratīyamānaṃ, taddvividhaṃ; taddvaividhyamāha- saccāsacca; saditi vidhiviṣayapramāṇagamyaṃ bhāvarūpam, asaditi niṣedhaviṣayapramāṇagamyamabhāvarūpam
parīkṣyate vyavasthāpyate vastusvarūpamanayeti parīkṣā pramāṇāni, āptopadeśādaya uttaragranthe sphuṭā bhaviṣyanti

āptī rajastamorūpadoṣakṣayaḥ, tadyuktā āptāḥ; śāsati jagatkṛtsnaṃ kāryākāryapravṛttinivṛttyupadeśeneti śiṣṭāḥ; boddhavyaṃ viśeṣeṇa buddhametairiti vibuddhāḥ; āptāḥ, śiṣṭāḥ, vibuddhā iti sañjñātrayeṇāptānāṃ loke prasiddhiṃ darśayati; teṣāmāptānāṃ vākyamasaṃśayaṃ niścitaṃ satyaṃ yathārthamityarthaḥ
tadvākyasatyatve hetumāha- vakṣanti te kasmādasatyaṃ nīrajastamā iti
nīrajastamā iti tamappratyayāntaḥ śabdaḥ, tena nīrajastvaprakarṣeṇa tamoapi vyudastaṃ bhavati; na hi sarvathā nīrajaske puruṣe tamo bhavati; yaduktaṃ- “nārajaskaṃ tamaḥ” (vi.a.6) iti

vakṣanti te kasmādasatyaṃ na kasmādapītyarthaḥ; asatyaṃ mithyājñānādvāabhidhīyate, samyagjñāne satyapi rāgadveṣābhyāṃ vāabhidhīyate, tacca tritayamapi mithyājñānarāgadveṣarūpaṃ rajastamonirmukte sattvaguṇodrekādamalavijñāne na sambhavatītyarthaḥ; yadi vā ‘nīrajastamaso mṛṣā’ iti pāṭhaḥ sugamaḥ

etaccāptalakṣaṇaṃ sahajāptabrahmādyabhiprāyeṇa, laukikānāṃ tu puruṣāṇāmāptatvaṃ prativiṣayasamyagjñānasambhavane tadviṣayarāgadveṣāsambhavena ca boddhavyam; etena, āptopadeśa iti śabdarūpapramāṇalakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati; buddhipramāṇapakṣe tu, āptopadeśajanitā buddhiḥ pramāṇamiti boddhavyam
sannikarṣāditi sambandhāt; sa ca sambandhaḥ- saṃyogaḥ, samavāyaḥ, saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ, saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyaḥ, samavetasamavāyaḥ, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvalakṣaṇo boddhavyaḥ
vyaktā ityanena vyabhicāriṇīmayathārthabuddhiṃ saṃśayaṃ ca nirākaroti

tadātve tatkṣaṇam; anena ca pratyakṣajñānānantarotpannānumānajñānaṃ smaraṇaṃ ca paramparayāaatmendriyamanorthasannikarṣajaṃ vyavacchinatti; ātmādicatuṣṭayasannikarṣābhidhānaṃ ca pratyakṣakāraṇābhidhānaparaṃ; tena, ‘indriyārthasannikarṣāt pravartate yā’ ityetāvadeva lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam; etena sukhādiviṣayamapi pratyakṣaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhavati; tatra hi catuṣṭayasannikarṣo nāsti, ātmasannikarṣastu pramāṇajñānasādhāraṇatvenaiva lakṣaṇānupayuktaḥ
iha ca pratyakṣaphalarūpāapi buddhiḥ pratyakṣaśabdenābhidhīyate, tathaiva lokavyavahārāt; paramārthatastu yato bhavatīndriyāderīdṛśī buddhistat pratyakṣam

trividhamityanenānumānatraividdhyaṃ darśayati; tena, kāryāt kāraṇānumānaṃ, yathā- garbhadarśanānmaithunānumānaṃ; tathā kāraṇāt kāryānumānaṃ, yathā- bījāt sahakārikāraṇāntarayuktāt phalānumānaṃ; tathāakāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ ca sāmānyato darśanādanumānaṃ, yathā- dhūmādvartamānakṣaṇasambandhādagnyanumānam; etattrividhamanumānaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhavati
tena, vyāptigrahaṇādanu anantaraṃ mīyate samyaṅniścīyate parokṣārtho yena tadanumānaṃ, vyāptismaraṇasahāyaliṅgadarśanamityarthaḥ

dṛṣṭvā bījāt phalaṃ jātamityanena bījaphalayoḥ kāraṇakāryalakṣaṇāṃ vyāptiṃ darśayati; yadyapi ca kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vyabhicarati, yato nāvaśyaṃ bījasadbhāve phalaṃ bhavati, tathāapi sahakārikāraṇāntarayuktaṃ bījaṃ phalaṃ na vyabhicaratītyabhiprāyo boddhavyaḥ; kāraṇasāmagrī ca kāryaṃ na vyabhicaratyeva
yukteḥ pramāṇasyānyaśāstraprasiddhatvenodāharaṇānyeva tāvaddarśayati, udāharaṇe jñāte yukterlakṣaṇaṃ sukhena jñāyate ityabhiprāyeṇa- jalakarṣaṇetyādi
karṣaṇaśabdena karṣaṇasaṃskṛtā bhūmirgṛhyate, jalakarṣaṇabījartusaṃyogāt sasyasya sambhavo bhavatīti yajjñānaṃ tadyuktiriti yojanīyam

mathyaṃ manthanakāṣṭhayantrakaṃ, kāṣṭhaṃ manthanaṃ, manthānaṃ kāṣṭhabhrāmaṇaṃ; kiṃvā ‘manthaka’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatra manthānaṃ bhrāmyamāṇakāṣṭhaṃ; saṃyogānmelakāditi boddhavyaṃ, yato manthanasya kriyārūpasya saṃyogo na saṅgacchate; kiṃvā manthanaśabdena manthanarajjurucyate
yujyate sambadhyateanayeti yuktiḥ, tayā yuktā yuktiyuktā
yā buddhirbhāvān paśyati viṣayīkaroti, bahukāraṇayogo bahūpapattiyogaḥ, janiścāyaṃ jñānārthe, tena bahūpapattiyogajñāyamānānarthān yā buddhiḥ paśyati ūhalakṣaṇā sā yuktiriti pramāṇasahāyībhūtā

evamanena bhavitavyamityevaṃrūpa ūhoatra yuktiśabdenābhidhīyate; sā ca paramārthatoapramāṇabhūtāapi vastuparicchede pramāṇasahāyatvena vyāpriyamāṇatvāt, tathā tayaiva ūharūpayā prāyo lokānāṃ vyavahārādiha pramāṇatvenoktā
ata eva pradeśāntare yuktiṃ vinā yathoktaṃ pramāṇatrayaṃ darśayiṣyati- “trividhā vā (parīkṣā) sahopadeśena” (vi.
tathā, upamānaṃ gṛhītvā rogabhiṣagjitīye śabdādīni catvāri pramāṇānyabhidhāsyati
trivargasādhakatvaṃ ca trivargasādhanādeva, ūhenaiva hi prāyastrivargānuṣṭhāne pravṛttirbhavati; (pramāṇaparicchedena tu pracāro virala eva

) yattu bahukāraṇajalakarṣaṇabījartusaṃyogādbhāvisasyajñānaṃ yuktirucyate, taccānumānānnārthāntarabhūtaṃ; tatrānumānādbhedo duṣkara iti nādriyāmahe; kiñca kāraṇebhyaḥ kāryaṃ pratīyamānaṃ na kadāapi vartamānaṃ pratīyate, tataśca trikāleti parāhataṃ syāt
atra śāntarakṣitakamalaśīlābhyāṃ yuktipramāṇāntarasvīkāre pūrvapakṣasiddhāntāvuktau- “yasmin sati bhavatyeva na bhavatyasatīti ca

etacchāntarakṣitavacanaṃ kamalaśīlena vyākhyātaṃ- “tadbhāvabhāvitvena yā tatkāryatāpratītiriyaṃ yuktiḥ; iyaṃ ca savikalpatvānna pratyakṣaṃ; nāpyanumānaṃ dṛṣṭāntābhāvāt, tathāhi- dṛṣṭāntoapi- ata eva tadbhāvabhāvitvāttatkāryatāpratipattiḥ, tatrāpi dṛṣṭāntoanyoanveṣaṇīyaḥ, tatrāpyapara ityanavasthā syāt; tasmāt pramāṇāntaraṃ yuktirityāha carako vaidyaḥ; evaṃ pūrvapakṣamutthāpya dūṣitaṃ yat- “kāryakāraṇabhāvasya pratipattirna saṅgatā

etadvyākhyātaṃ kamalaśīlena- “yuktau na sādhyasādhanayorbhedaḥ; tathāhi- atra tadbhāvabhāvitā hetuḥ, kāryakāraṇatā ca sādhyā, na cānayorbheda upalabhyate paryāyatvāttarupādapavat; atha mataṃ- na kāryakāraṇatā sādhyate kintarhi tadbhāvavyavahāra iti, tatrāha- tadbhāvavyavahāre ityādi; tasyā hetuphalatāyā bhāvastadbhāvaḥ, tatra vyavahāro yaḥ sa tadbhāvavyavahāraḥ jñānābhidhānapravṛttilakṣaṇamanuṣṭhānaṃ, tasmin yogyatā mūḍhaṃ prati sādhyate; ye yadvyāpārānantaraniyatopalambhasvabhāvāste tatkāryavyavahārayogyāḥ, tadyathā- saṅketakālānubhūtāḥ kulālādivyāpārānantaropalambhasvabhāvā ghaṭādayaḥ; tathā ca tālvādivyāpārānantaraniyatopalambhasvabhāvāḥ śabdā iti svabhāvo hetuḥ; tataśca sa dṛṣṭāntatvādanumānādabhedo yukteḥ”
prastute parīkṣāṃ prayojayati- tayā cāsti upalabhyate ca punarbhava iti
tatra śabdasya punarbhavapratipādakatvaṃ darśayati- tatrāaaptāgama ityādi
prathamaṃ vedaṃ pradarśayan vedasya nirastavibhramāśaṅkaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ darśayati, yaścānyoapītyanena granthena vedārthāviparītatvādibhirhetubhiḥ paricchedanīyaprāmāṇyāyurvedasmṛtiśāstrādīni darśayati
abhyudayaḥ svargaḥ, niḥśreyasaṃ mokṣaḥ; atra yathāyogyatayā svargasya mokṣasya ca kāraṇamiti boddhavyam

anativṛttau avanupaśāntau sattvadoṣau manodoṣau rajastamorūpau yeṣāṃ te tathā, teṣām; punarbhavo mokṣaḥ, dharmadvāreṣu dharmaśāstreṣu, adoṣaiḥ nirmanodoṣairmaharṣibhiḥ, upadiśyate na, iti sambandhaḥ; tena punarbhava upadiśyate ityarthaḥ
anupahatasattvaguṇo buddheḥ pracāro bodhalakṣaṇo yeṣāṃ te tathā, etena viśuddhabuddhitvaṃ darśayati
divyamatīndriyārthadarśi cakṣuḥ samādhirūpaṃ jñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te divyacakṣuṣaḥ, taiḥ
pratyakṣaṃ ca yadyapi punarbhavaṃ na gṛhṇāti, tathāapi tat punarbhavagrāhakānumānasya liṅgagrahaṇe yathā vyāpriyate tathā darśayati- pratyakṣamapītyādi
tulyasambhavānāṃ tulyotpādakāraṇānāṃ kaścidgauraḥ kaścit kṛṣṇaḥ, evaṃ svarādāvapi viśeṣo boddhavyaḥ

ruditādayoamī avyutpannabālagocaratayā boddhavyāḥ; ete ca ruditādayo yathāyogamiṣṭāniṣṭasmaraṇamantarā na bhavanti, smaraṇaṃ ca pūrvajñānaṃ vinā na bhavatīti pūrvajanmajñānānumānāt paralokānumāyakā bhavanti
pūrvapratipāditaṃ ca visadṛśatvādivaicitryamuttaratra pratipādanīyaṃ ca lakṣaṇotpattyādikāraṇāntarādarśane sati pūrvajanmakṛtakāraṇānumāyakamiti paralokānumāyakaṃ mantavyam

jāteratītāyāḥ smaraṇaṃ jātismaraṇaṃ; tadeva smaraṇaṃ darśayati- ihāgamanamitaścyutānāmiti; iha kule jātoasmi, itaśca kulādāgatoasmītyevamākāraṃ jātismaraṇamityarthaḥ yadi vā, iha janmani cyutānāmiha janmani punarāgamanam, anena ca nāmabhrāntyā yamapuruṣairnītasya punarāgamanaṃ dṛśyate
samadarśane tulyākāre kvacit puruṣe priyatvaṃ kvacit punarapriyatvamiti samadarśane priyāpriyatvam
evaṃ pratyakṣeṇa liṅgagrahaṇaṃ darśayitvāanumānamāha- ata evetyādi
itaśceti iha janmani kṛtāt karmaṇaḥ, anyaditi bhāvijanmāntaraṃ, bhaviṣyatītyanumīyata iti sambandhaḥ
phalāt phalasadṛśāpatyadarśanāt, bījaṃ pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ karmādikāraṇamanumīyate; tathā phalaṃ ca bhāvijanmāntare sukhaduḥkhādi, bījādihajanmakṛtāt karmaṇoanumīyata iti yojanā
ṣaḍdhātusamudāyādgarbhajanmeti vadatā ātmasambandhamantarā cetanā garbhasya notpadyate, ātmā ca paralokasambandha eveti paralokasadbhāve yuktirupadarśyate
kartṛkaraṇasaṃyogāt kriyeti ātmānaṃ kartāraṃ vinā kriyā paridṛśyamānā yāgādilakṣaṇā na bhavatīti
karmasadṛśaṃ phalamiti pūrvakṛtaśubhakarmaṇaḥ śubhaṃ putradhanādi phalam
atra bahuvaktavye prameye tathāvidhopayogābhāvādvistarabhayācca vistaro na kṛtaḥ
dehādiparīkṣāyāmavadhīyeteti vacanādavadhānopadarśanena dehādīnāṃ kṣayitvādi dharmanirūpaṇenopajāyamānāṃ matiṃ viṣayānabhiṣaṅgaṃ ca jāyamānamicchanti
viṣayeṣu prasaktiṃ manaso vārayitvāaatmani samādhānaṃ manaḥsamādhiḥ
vṛtterdhanasya puṣṭiḥ vṛttipuṣṭiḥ, dharmaiṣaṇāyāṃ ca vṛttipuṣṭikarābhidhānaṃ dharmahetūnāṃ vṛttihetvavirodhenācaraṇopadeśārtham
paralaukaiṣaṇā tṛtīyaiva, tataśca punastṛtīyeti padaṃ dharmasya prāṇadhanakāraṇatvena dharmaiṣaṇāyāḥ prāṇadhanaiṣaṇātvaprasaktipratiṣedhārtham
samprati trisaṅkhyāvacchinnopoddhātenānyānyapi trisaṅkhyāvacchinnāni svasthāturahitatveneha vaktavyānyāha- atha khalvityādi

prathamamupastambhā abhidhīyante mūlabhūtaśarīradhārakatvena, tadanu balamupastambhāhārādijanyatvāt, tadanu rogāyatanāni balavirodhakartṛtvena, tadanu rogāstajjanyatvena, tadanu tanmārgajñānaṃ suvinyastameva, tadanu rogapratiṣedhārthaṃ pradhānakāraṇavaidyābhidhānaṃ, tadanu tadupakaraṇatvena bhaiṣajyam

anyena stabhyamānaṃ dhāryamāṇamupa samīpaṃ pradhānakāraṇasya gatvā stambhayati dhārayatītyupastambhaḥ; yathā gṛhadhāraṇaniyuktapradhānastambhasamīpavartī tadbalādhāyaka upastambhaḥ, tathehāpi śarīrasyāyuḥsampravartakena karmaṇā dhriyamāṇasyāhārādayo dhārakatvenopastambhā ityucyante

āhārādayaśceha pradhānakalpanayā praśastā eva gṛhyante, tena virūḍhakāhārādīnāṃ śarīrānustambhakatvaṃ nodbhāvanīyam; ata eva yuktiyuktairiti viśeṣaṇaṃ kariṣyati, yuktyā praśastena yogena yuktā yuktiyuktāḥ
āyuḥsaṃskārāt āyuḥkāraṇaṃ dharmādharmāvasānaṃ yāvadityarthaḥ; saṃskāraśabdaḥ kāraṇavacanaḥ
sattvaṃ manaḥ, manaso balaṃ vā yat ‘utsāha’ ucyate
prākṛtamiti janmādipravṛttaṃ prākṛtadhātuvṛddhyā hetvantaranirapekṣaṃ vṛddhaṃ, dṛśyante hi kecit svabhāvādeva balino durbalāśca kecit
āhārasya māṃsasarpirādeḥ, ceṣṭāyā ucitaviśrāmavyāyāmāderyoga āhāraceṣṭāyogaḥ; anye tu yogaśabdena rasāyanaprayogaṃ grāhayanti
atra hīnamātradarśanaṃ vikāraṃ na karoti, tena ‘sarvaśa’ ityuktam
adarśanaṃ cātiprabhāvatāmeva boddhavyam, aprabhāvatāṃ ca ghaṭādīnāṃ darśanamatiyogādapi na doṣakaram; evamanyatrāpi sarvaśa iti vyākhyeyam

atiśliṣṭaṃ nayanapratyāsannam, ativiprakṛṣṭam atidūravarti, raudram adbhutakāraṇātmakaṃ bhayajanakaṃ, bhairavam anadbhutamapi vyāghrādi, diṣṭaṃ yadyasya dveṣyaṃ, bībhatsanaṃ manasa udvegakārakaṃ, vikṛtaṃ hīnāṅgādi, vitrāsanaṃ jhaṭiti bhayajanakam; ādigrahaṇādamedhyādīnāṃ grahaṇam

raudrādayo yadyapi na rūpaṃ kintvākṛtiviśeṣāḥ, tathāapi rūpaikārthasamavāyena cakṣurarthā eva; na cehendriyārthagrahaṇena rūpādīnāmeva paraṃ grahaṇamiti pūrvameva vyākhyātaṃ, yataḥ sparśanarasanayoḥ samyagyogeasamyagyoge ca bahavaḥ sparśarasavyatiriktāḥ snānābhyaṅgādayaḥ prakṛtisaṃyogasaṃskārādayaśca kāraṇatvena vaktavyāḥ
atimātrastanitaṃ pravṛddho meghadhvaniḥ, paṭahaḥ paṭahaśabdaḥ, utkruṣṭaṃ darpādatimātraṃ śabditaṃ, pradharṣaṇaṃ tiraskāraḥ

tīkṣṇo gandhaścakṣurvirecanakārakaḥ, yathā- kṛṣṇajīrakādīnām; ugro vamanakārako vacādīnām; abhiṣyandī staimityakārako mastusurāsavādīnāṃ; pūti atyarthaklinnaṃ; viṣayuktaḥ pavano viṣapavanaḥ; kuṇapaḥ śavaḥ
ihānādānamiti kurvan hīnayogoapi rasānāṃ vikārakara iti darśayati

āhāravidhiviśeṣāyatanāni rasavimāne vakṣyamāṇāni “prakṛtikaraṇasaṃyogarāśideśakālopayogasaṃsthopayotkraṣṭamāni” (vi.a.1); tatra rāśivarjyeṣvitivacanena rāśiṃ pṛthakkaroti, rāśerāhārasya parimāṇarūpasya yo doṣaḥ- hīnamātratvamatimātratvaṃ vā, tasyātiyogāyogābhyāmeva gṛhītatvāt; na mithyāyogo rāśeḥ sambhavati; uktaṃ hi- “rāśiḥ punarmātrāmātrāphalaviniścayārthaḥ” (vi.a.1.) iti

prakṛtyādīnāṃ tu doṣādāhārasya mithyāyoga eva paraṃ sambhavati, yataḥ prakṛtiviruddhānāṃ māṣādīnāṃ bhojanaṃ mithyāyoga evāhārasya bhavati; evaṃ saṃskāraviruddhaśaktupiṇḍikeapi mithyāyoga eva, tathā saṃyogaviruddhasamadhṛtamadhusarpirupayogeapi; evaṃ kālādiviruddhodāharaṇamapi rasavimāne pratipāditaṃ sarvaṃ mithyāyogarūpameva, teṣāmayogātiyoganirapekṣāṇāmeva doṣakartṛtvāt
yadyapi śītoṣṇādīnāmabhyaṅgādīnāṃ ca hīnayogoapi rogakarastathāapi sarvaśoanupasevanamiti vacanaṃ sarvaśoanupasevanasya bhūripravyaktavikārakartṛtvābhiprāyeṇa
anānupūrvyā yathoktakramalaṅghanena, yathā- snātvā utsādanaṃ, tathoṣṇapīḍitasya sahasā śītalapānīyāvagāhanam, evamādi

nanu cakṣurādīni pañcendriyāṇi, atasteṣāṃ pratiniyatāḥ pañcāsātmyendriyārthasaṃyogāḥ, tat kathamekoasātmyendriyārthasaṃyoga ityākhyāyata ityāśaṅkya sparśanendriyasya sarvendriyavyāpakatvaṃ darśayitvā sarvendriyānugataṃ sparśamarthagrahaṇakāraṇamekarūpaṃ darśayati, tataśca tasyaikasyāsātmyendriyārthena saṃyogādupapanna ekarūpoasātmyendriyārthasaṃyoga iti darśayati- tatraikamityādinā sātmyārtho hyupaśayārtha ityantena
indriyāṇi cakṣurādīni vyāpnotītīndriyavyāpakaṃ; sparśanaṃ hi sarveṣvindriyeṣvasti, ata eva spṛṣṭvaivārthamindriyāṇi gṛhṇanti
tarhi kathaṃ na sarvadāarthagrahaṇaṃ bhavatītyata āha- ceta ityādinā

śrotraṃ cāsmaddarśane pāñcabhautikaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīgatanabhorūpaṃ, tena tasyāpi sparśoasti; cetaḥsamavāyi manaḥsambandhi; manaḥsambandhakathanena cārthagrahaṇaṃ prati samarthatvaṃ sparśasya darśayati, manoadhiṣṭhitānāmindriyāṇāmarthagrāhakatvāt

tat kimaṇuparimāṇena manasaikatrasthitenaiva sparśanasya sarvendriyavyāpakasya sambandhāt sarvendriyāṇi pravartante, tathā sati yugapatpañcajñānotpattiprasaṅga ityāha- sparśanendriyavyāptervyāpakamapi ceta iti

sparśanenendriyāṇāṃ vyāptiḥ sparśanendriyavyāptiḥ, tasyāścetoapi vyāpakam; etaduktaṃ bhavati- yāvati pradeśe sparśanaṃ tiṣṭhati tāvantaṃ deśaṃ manoapi bhramati pratyakṣeṇārthagrahaṇārthaṃ, tena yasmin pradeśe yadā mano vartate tadā tena pradeśena cakṣurādirūpeṇārthaṃ gṛhṇātīti na yugapajjñānotpattiḥ

vyāpakaścāsau sparśaśceti vyāpakasparśaḥ, tena kṛtastannibandhanaḥ; sarvendriyāṇāṃ bhāvaviśeṣaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣoarthagrahaṇakāraṇībhūtaḥ sparśa ityarthaḥ; yamadhikṛtyoktam- “sparśanendriyasaṃsparśaḥ sparśo mānasa eva ca
a.1) iti; atra śloke sparśanasambandhakṛtaḥ sarvendriyasparśaḥ sparśanendriyasaṃsparśaśabdenoktaḥ, mānasastu sparśaścintyena viṣayeṇa satāapi sambhavatīti tatraiva vyākhyeyam

soayamekasyendriyavyāpakasya sparśasyaikarūpoasātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ, anupaśayāditi duḥkhakartṛtvāt, pañcavidhaḥ cakṣurasātmyendriyārthasaṃyogo ghrāṇāsātmyendriyārthasaṃyoga ityādirūpaḥ san, punastrividhavikalpo bhavati- ayogātiyogamithyāyogeneti bhāvaḥ

anupaśayaśabdena cakṣurādyanupaśayaviśeṣoatrāsātmyendriyārthasaṃyogasya pañcavidhahetutvopadeśādboddhavyaḥ, na hyekarūpoanupaśayaḥ pañcavidhatvamasātmyendriyārthasya kartuṃ samarthaḥ, yataścakṣurādīnāṃ pratiniyatānyevopaghātakānyatibhāsvararūpādīni, tataśca sparśendriyavyāptyāapi naikasparśanendriyatvaṃ cakṣurādīnām, ekatve hyekendriyopaghātakamanyeṣāmapyupaghātakaṃ syāditi mantavyam
etenānupaśayenendriyārthasaṃyogaṃ darśayitvāasātmyendriyārthasaṃyoga iti sañjñākaraṇamaviruddhamiti darśitaṃ bhavati

atra yadyapi bhūripradhānaśarīrarogakartṛtvena pūrvaṃ śārīrameva karmāsātmyamabhidhātuṃ yujyate, tathāapyalpatvena vāṅmanase karmaṇī pūrvamukte, pratyekamithyāyogakathane tu prādhānyācchārīra eva mithyāyogaḥ prathamaṃ darśitaḥ
atrātiyogarūpāatipravṛttistathāayogarūpāapravṛttirvihitānāṃ kāyavāṅmanaḥ karmaṇāṃ boddhavyā, ahitācaraṇasya tu sarvasya mithyāyogatvena vaktavyatvāt
ahitamiha janmani, anupadiṣṭamityanena paralokeadharmahetutayā pāpakārakaṃ paradārasevādi grāhayati; etena yaducyate- adharmasyāgrahaṇānnyūnametadāyatanakathanamiti, tanna bhavati

śārīramānasikavācanikakarmamithyāyogenaivādharmotpādāvāntaravyāpāreṇādharmajanyānāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kriyamāṇatvāt, yathā- agniṣṭomena svargaḥ kriyate dharmotpādāvāntaravyāpāreṇaiva; anye tu kālamithyāyogeadharmaṃ kṣipanti, adharmo hi kālavaśādeva phalati na tatkālamiti kṛtvā; etacca prathamādhyāya eva prapañcitam

samprati karmāsamyagyogaḥ prajñāparādhamūlatvāt prajñāparādha evocyata iti trividhamityādinā darśayan, yaduktaṃ pūrvaṃ hetutrayakathane “asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ prajñāparādhaḥ pariṇāmaśca” ityasyāvirodhaṃ darśayati; evaṃ yadagre vakṣyati ‘kālaḥ punaḥ pariṇāma ucyate’ tatrāpi pūrvoktāvirodhopadarśanaṃ vyākhyeyamiti
yathāsvalakṣaṇācchītāderviparītalakṣaṇo yathā- hemante varṣaṇaṃ, varṣāsu śītamityādi
vikārāṇāṃ hetavo bhavantīti sambandhaḥ; tathā samayogayuktāḥ samyagyogayuktāḥ prakṛtihetavo bhavantīti yojyaṃ; prakṛtiḥ ārogyam

idānīṃ dhātusāmyavaiṣamyahetutvena samyagyogāyogau ca pratipādya bāhyānāmapi vṛkṣaghaṭādīnāṃ samyaksthitivināśayoḥ samyagyogāyogāveva kāraṇamiti dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ bhāvasvarūpajñānārthaṃ cāha- sarveṣāmityādi

bhāvaḥ samyagavasthānam, abhāvaḥ, asamyagavasthānaṃ vināśo vā; yogāt samyagyogādbhāvaḥ, ayogādibhyoabhāvaḥ; yathāsvaṃ yuktiryā yasya bhāvasyābhāvasya vā yuktiḥ svakāraṇayuktiḥ, tadapekṣiṇau bhavata iti sambandhaḥ
yathā- vṛkṣasya bhāve avasthāneanatyalpapānīyayogādiryuktiḥ, abhāve tu vṛkṣasya pānīyātapātiyogāyogau tathā vajrapātādiryuktiḥ; tatastadapekṣau vṛkṣasya bhāvābhāvau bhavata ityādi kalpanīyam
iṣṭalābhājjāyate kāmaharṣādiḥ, aniṣṭapriyaviyogādilābhācca śokādayaḥ; yadi vā ‘iṣṭasyālābhāllābhāccāniṣṭasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ; atra tu pāṭhe cakārādiṣṭalābhoapi heturboddhavyaḥ
trayametaddharmārthakāmarūpaṃ mānasaṃ sukhaṃ vā mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā niṣpadyata iti yojyam
- koahaṃ, kiṃ me hitamityātmajñānaṃ; ko deśaḥ, asmin kimucitamiti deśajñānam; evaṃ kālādāvapi jñānaṃ boddhavyam
atra śākhetisañjñākaraṇaṃ vyavahārārthaṃ, tathā raktādīnāṃ dhātūnāṃ śākhābhidheyānāṃ vṛkṣaśākhātulyatvena bāhyatvajñāpanārtham

tvakceti tvakśabdena tadāśrayo rasoapi gṛhyate; sākṣāttu rasānabhidhānaṃ hṛdayasthāyino rasasya śākhāsañjñāvyavacchedārthaṃ, tasya hi koṣṭhagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇam; anena nyāyena yakṛtplīhāśritaṃ ca śoṇitaṃ koṣṭhatvenaivābhipretamiti boddhavyaṃ, samānanyāyatvāt
uktaṃ ca koṣṭhavivaraṇe- “sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca
samprati yanmārgāśrito yo rogo bhavati taṃ darśayati- tatra gaṇḍetyādi
bahirmārgajāśceti visarpādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ visarpādayo hyantarmārgabhājoapi sambhavantyatastadvyudāsārtham
jvaro yadyapi sarvaśarīraga eva, tathāapi viśeṣeṇāmāśayasamutthatvādihocyate
bahirmārgajo gulmo yo bahiruttuṇḍita upalabhyate bahiśca pacyate sa jñeyaḥ, anyastu sarvaḥ koṣṭhagata eva

daivamadṛṣṭaṃ tadvyapāśrayaṃ, tacca yadadṛṣṭajananena vyādhipratyanīkaṃ mantrādi; yadi vā daivaśabdena devā ucyante, tānāśritya yadupakaroti tattathā; mantrādayo hi devaprabhāvādeva vyādhiharāḥ, balyupahārādiprītāśca devā eva prabhāvādvyādhīn ghnanti
praṇipāto devādīnāṃ śārīro namaskāraḥ, gamanaṃ vidūradevādigamanam
prāyaḥśabdaḥ śarīradoṣakopa ityanena sambadhyate; tena, mānasadoṣajeapyunmādāpasmārādāvañjanādi bhavatīti darśayati; yadi vā prāyastrividhamityanena śārīreapi daivavyapāśrayaṃ svastyayanādi darśayati
sañjñā samyagjñānaṃ vyādhirayaṃ tvarayā pratikartavya evamākāram
trātāraṃ vaidyamanāsādya; tathāvidhaṃ hi rogiṇaṃ vaidyo nopasarpatīti bhāvaḥ
godhādṛṣṭāntena jīvanārthaṃ yatnaṃ kurvannapi vipadyata iti darśayati
saṅgrahe dhīmatā bhāvā iti chedaḥ; aṣṭau bhāvā iti sambandhaḥ
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke tisraiṣaṇīyo nāmaikādaśoadhyāyaḥ

pūrvādhyāye rogāḥ svarūpamārgabāhyakāraṇabheṣajairabhihitāḥ, upayuktajñānāstatkāraṇavātādayo bahuvācyatvānnoktāḥ, ataḥ samprati pṛthakprakaraṇe teabhidhīyante vātakalākalīye; tatrāpi prādhānyādvāyureva prathamamucyate

kalā guṇaḥ, yaduktaṃ- “ṣoḍaśakalam” (sū.a.10) iti; akalā guṇaviruddho doṣaḥ; tena vātakalākalīyo vātaguṇadoṣīya ityarthaḥ; yadi vā kalā sūkṣmo bhāgaḥ, tasyāpi kalā kalākalā; tasyāpi sūkṣmo bhāga ityarthaḥ
rūkṣādayo bhāvapradhānāḥ, tena rūkṣatvādayo guṇā mantavyāḥ
dāruṇatvaṃ calatvaṃ calatvāt, evaṃ dīrghañjīvitīyoktaṃ calatvamuktaṃ bhavati; yadi vā, dāruṇatvaṃ śoṣaṇatvāt kāṭhinyaṃ karotīti

etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati- yadyapi vāyunā vātakāraṇānāṃ vātaśamanānāṃ vā tathā sambandho nāsti, tathāapi śarīrasambaddhaistairvātasya śarīracāriṇaḥ sambandho bhavati, tataśca vātasya samānaguṇayogādvṛddhirviparītaguṇayogācca hrāsa upapanna eveti
śarīrāśarīracarasyeti vātasvarūpakathanaṃ, tena śarīreṣu carata iti bahiḥ śarīrebhyo veti ca punaruktaṃ na bhavati
tantraṃ śarīraṃ, yaduktaṃ- “tantrayantreṣu bhinneṣu tamoantyaṃ pravivikṣatām” (iṃ.
a.12) iti, tadeva yantraṃ; yadi vā, tantrasya yantraṃ sandhayaḥ
niyantā anīpsite viṣaye pravartamānasya manasaḥ, praṇetā ca manasa evepsitearthe
udyojakaḥ prerakaḥ; kiṃvā ‘udyogakāraka’ iti pāṭhaḥ, soapyabhinnārthaḥ
abhivoḍhevābhivoḍhā sarvendriyārthagrāhakatvena; taccāsya vāyumayena sparśanendriyeṇa sarvendriyāṇāṃ vyāpakatvāt pūrvādhyāyapratipāditena nyāyena boddhavyam
prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ, śabdakāraṇatvaṃ ca vāyornityamākāśānupraveśāt; uktaṃ hi khādīnyabhidhāya- “teṣāmekaguṇaḥ pūrvo guṇavṛddhiḥ pare pare” (śā.
śravaṇamūlatvaṃ vāyoḥ karṇaśaṣkulīracanāviśeṣe vyāpriyamāṇatvāt; mūlaṃ pradhānakāraṇam
dhātūnāmiti pṛthivyādīnāṃ, dhātavaḥ kāryadravyāṇi prastarādīni; mānaṃ parimāṇaṃ, saṃsthānamākṛtiḥ, tayorvyaktirabhivyaktiḥ, tatra kāraṇamiti yāvat
avikledaḥ pākakālādarvāgaviklinnatvam, upaśoṣaṇaṃ ca pākena yavādīnāmārdrāṇāmeva, avikledopaśoṣaṇe śasyānāmeva
avaikārikavikāreṇa sarvasminneva jagati prakṛtirūpe kāraṇatvaṃ brūte
visarjanaṃ visargaḥ, sa ca pṛthaṅnīhārādibhiḥ sambadhyate; nīhāraḥ śiśirasamūhaḥ, nirhrādo meghaṃ vinā garjitam, aśaniḥ vajrabhedoagniḥ
vāyuriha devatārūpoabhipretaḥ, tena tasya bhūtarūpacaturyugāntakarānilakaraṇamaviruddham; evaṃ yadanyadapyanupapadyamānaṃ vāyostadapi devatārūpatvenaiva samādheyam
samprati sāmānyena punaḥ kupitākupitasya vāyoḥ svarūpamucyate- sa hi bhagavānityādi

pittāntargata iti vacanena śarīre jvālādiyuktavahniniṣedhena pittoṣmarūpasya vahneḥ sadbhāvaṃ darśayati; na tu pittādabhedaṃ, pittenāgnimāndyasya grahaṇyadhyāye vakṣyamāṇatvāt, tathā pittaharasya sarpiṣoagnivardhanatvenoktatvāt

paktimapaktimiti avikṛtivikṛtibhedena pācakasyāgneḥ karma, darśanādarśane netragatasyālocakasya, ūṣmaṇo mātrāmātratvaṃ varṇabhedau ca tvaggatasya bhrājakasya, bhayaśauryādayo hṛdayasthasya sādhakasya, rañjakasya tu bahiḥsphuṭakāryādarśanādudāharaṇaṃ na kṛtam
vividhaṃ nānāprakāraṃ sannikhilameva vāyoḥ karma, yat punaścaturvidhaṃ kupitākupitaśarīrāśarīracarabhedena bhavati, taduktamiti yojanīyaṃ; na hi caturvidhavyatirekeṇa vāyoḥ pṛthagvidhaṃ karmoktam
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke vātakalākalīyo nāma dvādaśoadhyāyaḥ
nirdeśavātakalākalīye vātādayoabhihitāḥ, teṣāṃ bheṣajaṃ yathā kalpanīyaṃ tadupadeṣṭuṃ kalpanācatuṣkoabhidhīyate

bheṣajānāṃ kalpanā bheṣajakalpanā, sā ca kalpanā āśrayadravyābhidhānaṃ vinā na pāryate kalpayitum; ataḥ snehādidravyagocarā sneha-sveda-vamana-virecanakalpanehābhidhīyate, bastikalpanā tviha bahuvaktavyatvānnoktā
atrāpi vamanādipravṛttau snehasyaiva prathamaṃ vidhīyamānatayā tathā doṣapradhānasya vātasya pradhānabheṣajatvācca tatpratipādaka eva snehādhyāyoabhidhīyate
saṅkhyātaṃ jñātaṃ saṅkhyeyaṃ jñeyaṃ yaiste tathā; yadi vā ‘saṅkhyātasaṅkhyeyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tadā punarvasuviśeṣaṇametat; arthastu samānaḥ
saṃśayamiti saṃśayena viṣayiṇā viṣayaṃ lakṣayati, tena saṃśayamiti saṃśayaviṣayamityarthaḥ
ke naceti ke na ca snehyāḥ
kiṃ pānāt snehapānāt prathamaṃ pūrvaṃ hitāhitaṃ; kiñca pīte snehe tathā jīrṇe ca snehe hitāhitamiti yojyam
citrā gorakṣakarkaṭī, tadbījamiha; yadi vā citrā lohitairaṇḍaḥ
atra yadyapi yogāttilabhavameva tailaṃ, tathāapi rūḍhyeha sarva eva sthāvarasnehāstailamityucyante
sarvasnehottamā ityatra sarvaśabdena dadhikṣīrādayo gṛhyante; sarvasnehottamatvaṃ ca sarpirādīnāṃ snehaguṇaprakarṣavattvena
etaduktaṃ bhavati- yat- na tathā tailādayo dravyāntarasaṃskṛtāḥ saṃskāraguṇān vahanti yathā sarpiriti

ata eva saṃskārakadravyacitrakādiguṇānuvidhāneapi sarpirna svaguṇān snehaśaityādīn jahāti, kiñca svaguṇān tadguṇāṃśca vahati, yatoanuśabdena paścādvācinā svaguṇavartanasya paścāt saṃskārakaguṇavartanamucyate
ghṛtaṃ tulyaguṇaṃ doṣaṃ saṃskārāttu jayet kapham” (ni.

na ca vācyaṃ rūkṣoṣṇacitrakādisaṃskārādrūkṣoṣṇaṃ sarpirbhūtaṃ, tataśca sarpiṣaḥ snehaśaitye tadviruddhe kathaṃ tiṣṭhataḥ? iti; yataḥ sarpiḥsambaddhacitrakāvayavānugataṃ hi rūkṣoṣṇatvaṃ, sarpirgate ca snehaśaitye iti bhinnāśrayatvānna virodhaḥ; idameva ca sarpiṣaḥ saṃskārānuvartanaṃ yat- svaguṇaviruddhasyāpi tasyānupaghātena dhāraṇaṃ; saṃskārakacitrakādiguṇavahaneapi sarpiṣaḥ śaityādayaḥ kadācidabhibhūyante saṃskārakaguṇairuṣṇādibhirna punaḥ snehaguṇaḥ, tasya sneheṣu sarvātmanā vyavasthitasya prabalatvāt; ata eva sarpirādayaḥ snehapradhānatvāt ‘snehā’ ityucyante

anye tu saṃskārānuvartanaṃ svaguṇopaghātena saṃskārakaguṇavahanaṃ bruvate, etacca taile tiṣṭhati na sarpiṣīti vadanti; sarpiṣi tu saṃskārānuvartanamuktaṃ yat tat sarpiṣi sarvathā kasyacidguṇasya saṃskāraguṇenānupaghātādbhavati; tathāhi- dāhapraśamanārthaṃ jvare candanādiśītadravyasādhitatailamuktaṃ, yataḥ śītena sādhitaṃ tailamuṣṇamapi svabhāvācchītameva bhavatīti
śaradi bahupittatvena pittaviruddhaṃ ghṛtameva yaugikaṃ, nānyastailādiḥ

vasāmajjñostu nātiśītoṣṇatvāt sādhāraṇe; yatastayoranupāne śītatvena voṣṇatvena vā nirdeśo na kṛtaḥ; “yathāsattvaṃ tu śaityauṣṇye vasāmajjñorvinirdiśet” (sū.a.27) iti tu vacanena śaityauṣṇyābhidhānaṃ sāmānyena, tailasarpirvadauṣṇyaśaityānabhidhānānna prakarṣaprāptaśaityoṣṇatvaprāpakam
ata evoktaṃ- “tailavasāmajjasarpiṣāṃ tu yathāpūrvaṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ vātaśleṣmavikāreṣu bhavati, yathottaraṃ pittavikāreṣu” (vi.a.8) iti
atrottarasya sarpiṣaḥ śaityāt pittaharatvaṃ, tailasya tūṣṇatvādvātaśleṣmaharatvaṃ, vasāmajjñostu sādhāraṇatvena madhyagatatvamiti sthitam
evaṃ vasāmajjñoḥ sādhāraṇatvena tathā balyatvadhātuvṛddhikaratvābhyāmanatiśītoṣṇe tathā balakṣayadhātukṣayayukte mādhave prayogo yuktaḥ
caitrastu mukhyasādhāraṇaguṇoapi prabhūtaśleṣmatayā na snehaviṣaya ityanuktaḥ
nātyuṣṇe grīṣme, nātiśīte hemante śiśire ca tathā varṣajanitaśaitye varṣākāle
ayaṃ cānātyayikavikāre sati kālaniyamo jñeyaḥ, agre uṣṇe śīte ca kāle snehopadeśāt
kālaviśeṣe doṣaviśeṣe ca pānakramaṃ darśayati- vātetyādinā
vātaśca pittaṃ ca vātapittaṃ, tadadhiko vātapittādhikaḥ
śleṣmādhikagrahaṇamatyantaśītavikāragṛhītapuruṣopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena vātaśleṣmādhikaḥ śleṣmādhikaśca gṛhyate; ata eva suśruteapyuktaṃ- “vātapittādhiko rātrau vātaśleṣmādhiko divā” (su.ci.31) iti
kevalavātādhikasya tathā pittādhikasya śleṣmādhikasya ca sādhāraṇe śaradādau kāle utsargasiddha eva pānakālo vakṣyamāṇo bhavati
anye tu bruvate- vātādhikagrahaṇena kevalavātasyāpi grahaṇaṃ, śleṣmādhikavyapadeśācca vātaśleṣma-pittaśleṣmaṇorapi grahaṇamiti
amalaḥ prabalaraśmiryasmin dinasya bhāge bhāskaraḥ soamalabhāskaro madhyāhna iti yāvat

atyuṣṇe kāle divā pītaḥ snehaḥ ślaiṣmikasyāpi yathoktavikārakaraḥ, tathā vātapittādhikena pītaḥ śītakāleapi yathoktavikārakaraḥ; evaṃ niśāpāneapi vākyārthaḥ; paraṃ niṣiddhasya kālasya doṣasya ca melakeatyaye coktavikāraprakarṣāprakarṣau tarkaṇīyau
anupānaparimāṇaṃ tu samyagbheṣajapākārthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ bheṣajāvaikārikapākenaivonneyaṃ, vṛddhavaidyavyavahārācca
lehaḥ śarkarādīnāṃ pākāt kṛtaḥ; lihyata iti lehaḥ

pravicāryate avacāryateanukalpenopayujyateanayeti pravicāraṇā odanādayaḥ; odanādayaśca snehapravicāraṇāyāṃ snehayuktā eva boddhavyāḥ; abhyañjanādayastu yadyapi śuddhasnehasampādyāstathāapi jaṭharāgnisambandhe na vyāpriyanta iti tantre vicāraṇāśabdenocyante
kevalasnehapānaṃ tu snehane śaktyatiśayavattvena na vicāraṇāsañjñayocyate, etadevāha- acchapeya ityādi
acchaśca peyaśca acchapeyaḥ, odanādyasambandhe sati peya ityarthaḥ
na tāmāhurvicāraṇāmiti vacanena vaidyaparamparāsiddhoayaṃ vyavahāra iti darśayati
prathame śreṣṭhe kalpe pakṣe bhavatīti prāthamakalpikaḥ, śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ
samāso rasānāmanyonyamelakaḥ, vyāsoamelakaḥ; samāsavyāsavadbhiḥ ṣaḍbhī rasairodanādigatairupahito yuktaḥ san snehastriṣaṣṭisaṅkhyāṃ prāpnoti
triṣaṣṭhī rasabhedā ātreyabhadrakāpyīye “svāduramlādibhiryogaṃ” (sū.a.26) ityādivākye vakṣyamāṇā boddhavyāḥ
evaṃ snehānāṃ rasayuktānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ pravicāraṇā bhavanti
catuḥṣaṣṭiriti snehānāmityanena sambadhyate, tena pravicāraṇetyekavacanamupapannaṃ bhavati
na sarvavicāraṇā sarvatra kartavyā, kintu sātmyartuvyādhidoṣapuruṣān parīkṣya yā yatra yujyate sā tatra kartavyetyāha- okartvityādi
puruṣagrahaṇena kasmin deśeayaṃ puruṣo vartata iti parīkṣayā deśoapyavaruddho boddhavyaḥ, vayobalaprabhṛtayaśca boddhavyāḥ

ahorātraśabdoaṣṭapraharopalakṣaṇaḥ, evamahaḥśabdārdhāhaśabdau catuḥpraharadvipraharopalakṣaṇau, tena praharādyatīteapyahani pītā mātrā yathoktapraharakālaprāptyā dināntare rātrau vā jīryamāṇā mantavyā; anye tvahorātraśabdena nyūnenāpyahnā yuktā rātrirahorātraśabdenocyate, kṛtsnārdhāhau tu praharopalakṣaṇāviti vadanti
atra yadā ahorātrapariṇāminī mātrā kriyate, tadā tadaharāhāro na kartavyaḥ; ata evaitatpānaṃ puruṣaviśeṣaviṣayakathane uktaṃ- “kṣutpipāsāsahānarāḥ” iti
śodhanārtha iti śodhanārtha(ṅga)snehakaraṇe; etena uttamamātrā saṃśamane eva paraṃ, na tu śodhanāṅgasnehe kartavyeti darśayati

vātapittavikāragrahaṇenaiva vātapittaprakṛtiṣu labdheṣu punastadabhidhānaṃ vātapittaprakṛtīnāṃ stokaśleṣmavikāreapi ghṛtapānopadeśārtham; evaṃ vātavyādhibhirāviṣṭā vātaprakṛtayaśca ya ityatra vyākhyeyam
śītale kāla iti tailasyoṣṇatvena śītaleapi kāla ityarthaḥ; tena sāmānyapratiṣedhaḥ ‘nātyuṣṇaśīte snehaṃ pibennaraḥ’ iti na virudhyate; yadi vā sarpiḥpānakālāpekṣayā śītatvaṃ boddhavyam
prakarṣāviti alpaprakarṣabhūyaḥprakarṣau; tena, alpatvena trairātrikaḥ prakarṣaḥ, bhūyastvena sāptarātrika iti ca bhavati
etacca vakṣyamāṇasadyaḥsnehaprayogātiriktaprayoge boddhavyaṃ; yadi vā, sadyaḥsnehaprayogā api tryaheṇaiva snehayanti, stutyarthaṃ tu teṣu sadya ityuktam
yaduktaṃ- “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ
nātaḥ paraṃ snehanamādiśanti sātmyībhavet saptadināt paraṃ tu” (si.a.1.) iti
svedyāḥ svatantrasvedasādhyā vātarugārtādayaḥ, śodhanāṅgasvedasādhyānāṃ tu śodhayitavyā ityanenaiva gṛhītatvāt
yeṣāṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate laṅghanabṛṃhaṇīye- “abhiṣyandā mahādoṣā marmasthā vyādhayaśca ye
a.22) ityanena, teṣāṃ śodhanādṛte snehanaṃ na śastaṃ, yadā tu śodhanena virūkṣyante tadā paraṃ śodhanāṅga(rtha)statra snehaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ
utsanno vṛddhaḥ kapho medaśca yeṣāṃ te tathā; etacca viśeṣaṇaṃ virūkṣaṇīyā evambhūtā eva bhavantīti darśayati
snehāt pūrvaṃ yat pathyaṃ tadāha- dravoṣṇamityādi
annakāle dvipraharādilakṣaṇe bubhukṣā kadācinna syādapi tadarthaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ- prakāṅkṣita iti
śuddhyarthaṃ tu snehaṃ naiśe dināntarakṛte āhāre jīrṇa eva prātareva pibedityarthaḥ

saṃśamanārthasneho yadi jaraṇānte prātareva kriyate tadā koṣṭhopalepakadoṣasyākṣayāttena doṣeṇa sambaddho doṣotkleśaṃ kuryānna saṃśamanaṃ, saṃśodhanārthastu doṣotkleśaṃ karotītyapekṣaṇīya eveti bhāvaḥ
etacca kālakathanamutsargeṇa, tena “vātapittādhiko rātrau” ityuktakālavirodho na bhavati
snehaṃ pratibhuñjāna iti snehe jīrṇeapi snehaprayogānuguṇamanyasnehamaviruddhavīryādiguṇayuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ
etena snehe pīte jīrṇe kiñca hitāhitamiti praśnadvayasyottaramidam- uṣṇodakopacārī syādityādi bhavati
kṛśarā tilataṇḍulamāṣakṛtā yavāgūḥ; vacanaṃ hi- “tilataṇḍulamāṣaistu kṛśarā trisareti ca”
grahaṇī koṣṭhasthāgnyadhiṣṭhānabhūtā nāḍī; yaduktam- “agnyadhiṣṭhānamannasya grahaṇādgrahaṇī matā” (ci.a.15) iti

krūrakoṣṭhasya grahaṇīgato vāyurguḍādīnāṃ saratvaṃ pratibadhnāti, mṛdukoṣṭhasya hi grahaṇyāṃ virodhako vāyurnāsti, stambhakoapi śleṣmāalpaḥ, udbhūtasaratvaguṇaṃ ca pittaṃ prabalaṃ; tena guḍādibhiḥ sukhaṃ virecanaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
ojaḥ sarvadhātusārabhūtaṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ, prakṣārayan sthānādbhraṃśayan kṣapayaṃśca
balītyanena snehendhano vahnirnitarāṃ balavān bhavatīti darśayati
vacanaṃ hi- “nālaṃ snehasamṛddhasya śamāyānnaṃ sugurvapi” iti
chardayediti prathamaṃ snehameva tṛṣṇākārakaṃ chardayitvā punaḥ śītodakaṃ pītvā rūkṣānnaṃ ca bhuktvā ullikhediti yojanīyam

- na sarpiḥ sāme pitte peyaṃ, kevalaṃ tvasaṃskṛtaṃ viśeṣato na peyaṃ sāmapitta eveti yojanā; evaṃ manyate- saṃskṛtaṃ tiktakādibhiryutaṃ sāme pitte tiktakādipācanaguṇānuyogādyogyaṃ kadācidbhavatyapi, asaṃskṛtaṃ tu sarvathā viruddhameva; yadivā, kevalamasaṃskṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pitte sāmānyena sāme nirāme vā na peyaṃ, sāme pitte viśeṣata iti yojanā
etena, yatrāpi sāmānyena ghṛtaṃ vihitaṃ, yathā- “ata ūrdhvaṃ kaphe mande vātapittottare jvare
paripakveṣu doṣeṣu sarpiḥpānaṃ yathāamṛtam” (ci.a.3) ityādau, tatrāpyucitabheṣajasaṃskṛtameva boddhavyam
yadivā, na kevalaṃ pitte sāme sarpirviśeṣato na peyaṃ, kintarhi tailādīnyapi vātaśleṣmavihitāni tayoḥ sāmayorna peyānītyarthaḥ
tadvaditi snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca rasaudanaṃ snehoparamadivasa eva
yadyapi vamanoktā eva tatroccairbhāṣyādayo virecanavṛttāvapyatidiṣṭāstathāapīha vamanavidhi parityajya virecanavidhyatideśo dhūmapānapratiṣedhārthaḥ, virecane hi tatra “dhūmapānavarjaṃ” (sū.
a.15) iti kṛtaṃ, snehapāne ca dhūmapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ mātrāśitīye- “na madyadugdhe pītvā ca na snehaṃ” (sū.
rase snehārthoktarasa ucitaḥ saṃyogo yeṣāṃ te rasasaṃyogāḥ, teṣāṃ saṅgrahaṇaṃ saṅgrahaḥ
yathārhamiti yo yatra sneho yujyate sarpirādiḥ
siddhairiti pippalībhistathā harītakyā tathā triphalayā ceti pṛthagyojanīyaṃ; pippalyādisiddhasnehaśca kuṣṭhādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyamiti kecit
samprati sneha upayukto yathā śarīraṃ sasnehyādhiko dṛśyate, tadāha- gṛhṇātītyādi
nanvagnyadhikaścet sravati, tadavadhi ca snehalakṣaṇamuktaṃ, yaducyate- “adhastāt snehadarśanam” iti, tenaikadina evādhikasnehapānaṃ kriyatāmityāha- yathā cetyādi
tvaritasevitaḥ sneho dhātūnasnehayitvaiva sraṃsateadho yāti yāvān, na tāvatā snehanaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
ato vakṣyamāṇasvedopakalpanādhyāyayoḥ sambandhasūcakaṃ svedādiṣu snehasya prāgbhāvamāha- snehamityādi
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne kalpanācatuṣke snehādhyāyo nāma trayodaśoadhyāyaḥ
vātakaphātmakā asaṃsṛṣṭavātakaphajāḥ, vātakaphajatveapyudarādayaḥ svedena na śāmyanti, ata āha- svedasādhyāḥ; etenodarādayoasvedyā vyāvartyante
yathānyāyaṃ yathāgamam, etacca snehasvedopapādanairityanena sambadhyate; yadi vā yathānyāyaṃ yathāsahajaṃ namayantīti sambandhaḥ
rogamṛtuṃ vyādhitaṃ ca balavattvādināapekṣata iti rogartuvyādhitāpekṣaḥ
kalpita iti rogādīnapekṣya yathocitena dravyeṇa deśe cāmāśayādau yathāyogyatayā sampādita iti mantavyam
vyādhau mahābale tathā śīte kālakṛte mahābale
mahāniti caṇḍatāpa eva punaḥ punaḥ kriyamāṇatvena mṛdusvedāpekṣayāadhikatāpatvena jñeyaḥ
durbala iti tathā madhyama iti ca vyādhyādiṣu pūrvavadyojanīyam
snigdharūkṣadravyakṛtaḥ snigdharūkṣaḥ, snigdharūkṣadravyādayo vātaśleṣmādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mantavyāḥ; etacca snigdharūkṣādikathanaṃ dravyāpekṣakalpanodāharaṇaṃ; vāte snigdhaḥ, kaphe rūkṣaḥ
taṃ deśaviśeṣasambandhena vyabhicārayan deśāpekṣāṃ kalpanāmāha- āmāśayetyādi

āmāśayagate vāte rūkṣapūrvaḥ sthānāpekṣayā pūrvaṃ rūkṣaṃ kṛtvā paścādvātāpekṣaḥ snigdhaḥ kāryaḥ, evaṃ pakvāśayagate kaphe snehapūrvo vyākhyeyaḥ; āmāśayaśabdena kaphasthānaṃ jñeyaṃ, kaphasthānāpekṣayā hi prathamaṃ rūkṣaḥ kriyate, yaduktaṃ- “sthānaṃ jayeddhi pūrvaṃ tu sthānasthasyāviruddhataḥ” iti
mṛdu naiva veti svedaikasādhye vṛṣaṇādigate vyādhau mṛdusvedaḥ, svedavyatiriktopāyāntarasambhave tu na veti boddhavyam

svedanādviratirmatetyupadiśan śītādivyuparame sati svedo nivartanīyaḥ, śītādyanuparame ca svedaḥ kartavya iti dvayamupadiśati; tataśca ita eva svedanivṛttiviṣayaśītādivyuparamotpādaḥ svedasya samyagyogalakṣaṇaṃ tathā śītādivyuparamānutpādaśca svedānivṛttiviṣayoayogalakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavatīti nāyogalakṣaṇānabhidhānamudbhāvanīyam
graiṣmiko vidhirityanena labdhe punarmadhuraḥ snigdhaśītala ityādivacanaṃ “madyamalpaṃ na vā peyaṃ” (sū.a.6) ityatropadiṣṭamadyapānasya pratiṣedhārthaṃ, madhuraśītādiyogaviśeṣavidhānārthaṃ ca

kaṣāyadravyakṛtaṃ madyaṃ kaṣāyamadyaṃ; kiṃvā kaṣāyaśabdoamadhuravacanaḥ, na tena yaducyate- kaṣāyanityasya vātapradhānatā syāt kaṣāyasya vātakāritvāt, vāte ca svedo vihita eva, tat kathaṃ kaṣāyanityaṃ prati svedaniṣedha iti, tannirastaṃ bhavati
kiṃvā, kaṣāyanityā rūkṣātistabdhagātrā bhavanti, kaṣāyasya virūkṣakastambhakatvena; tataśca teṣāṃ svedaḥ parvabhedamāvahatītyataḥ kaṣāyanityaniṣedhaḥ

raktapittināmavidhānādeva svede niṣiddhe, punaḥ svedaniṣedho raktapittināṃ yadyanyoapi svedasādhyo vātaśleṣmajo vikāro bhavati tatrāpi svedaniṣedhārthaṃ, tathā raktapittināṃ vamanavirecanāṅgatayā prāptasvedapratiprasavaniṣedhārthaṃ ca; evaṃ pittamehikāmalyādiṣvapi vyākhyeyam

madhumehaśabdena sarva evaṃ mehā gṛhyante, madhumehaśabdo hi sarveṣveva meheṣu vartata iti kiyantaḥśirasīye darśanīyaṃ, meheṣu ca sarveṣveva śarīraśaithilyapravṛtteṣu viśeṣataḥ śarīraśaithilyahetutvena svedo na yujyate; pittamehināmiti tu punarabhidhānaṃ pittasambandhena viśeṣapratiṣedhatādarśanārtham
eṣu cāsvedaviṣayeṣu yadi svedaikasādhyaḥ sannyāsādirbhavati tadā mahāpratyavāyabhayādalpapratyavāyamupekṣyāpi svedo vidheya iti nyāyasiddhameva; yadāhurnyāyavidaḥ- “bhūyovirodhe svalpamanyāyyam” iti

alāghava iti pūrvamukteapi punargauravavacanamaṅgānāṃ gurutaratvapratipādanārtham, alāghavavacanaṃ tu lāghavapratiṣedhamātraprayojanaṃ nātigurutvaṃ brūte, yataḥ sarvatra nañ viruddhe na vartate, yathā “arūkṣamanabhiṣyandi tvāsīnapracalāyitam” (sū.a.21) ityatra na hyarūkṣaśabdena snigdhatvamabhipretaṃ, kiṃ tarhi rūkṣatāpratiṣedhamātrameva
karīṣaḥ śuṣkagomayaḥ; āyasaḥ ayovikāraḥ, sa ceha puṭakaraṇayogyo boddhavyaḥ
yathāsvamityanena tilamāṣādayo vāte, gokharādigranthoktāśca śleṣmaṇi, prastarasvede kartavyā iti darśayati
grāmyetyādinā vātāpaho nāḍīsveda uktaḥ, vāruṇetyādinā kaphāpahaḥ, bhūtīketyādinā vātaśleṣmāpahaḥ
vāruṇo varuṇaḥ amṛtakā guḍūcī, sarṣapairityatra patrairiti sambadhyate
punaḥ śobhāñjanagrahaṇāddvitīyo viṭapaśobhāñjano gṛhyate, saireyaḥ jhiṇṭī
jalakoṣṭhaḥ avagāhārthaṃ kṛtaṃ mahajjalapātram; evaṃ ghṛtakṣīratailakoṣṭhāśca vyākhyātāḥ
upanāhaḥ bahalaṃ lepaṃ dattvā carmādibhirāvṛtya vyādhiyuktasyāṅgasya bandhanam; carmabhiścopanaddhavya ityatra upanāhoanagnisvedo grāhyaḥ
samprati sāgnisvedānāṃ saṅkarādīnāṃ lakṣaṇamabhidhātuṃ saṅkarādīn svedān nāmatastāvaduddiśati- saṅkara ityādi
saṅkarādiśabdāścāyurvedaparamparāsiddhāḥ; tatra kvacinnāḍīsvedādau nāḍyā praṇīyata ityanvayoapyanusaraṇīyaḥ, jentākādayaścānvayanirapekṣā eva
prastīryata iti prastaraḥ śayanapramāṇena svedavastūnāṃ vistaraṇaṃ, tasmin prastare
bāṣpamanudvamantyāmityanena kvathanakāle bāṣpo yathā na niryāti tathā kartavyamiti darśayati
utkvathitānāṃ bāṣpaṃ snehāktagātraḥ san nāḍyā upaharediti sambandhaḥ
vyāmaḥ tiryagvistṛtabāhudvayapramāṇaṃ; vyāmadīrghatvaṃ nāḍyā bahalasvede kartavyam
vyāmacaturthabhāgena vyāmāṣṭabhāgena ca mūle agre ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mānaṃ nāḍyā veditavyaṃ; pariṇāhena veṣṭanena sroto randhraṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā
vihatacaṇḍavegatvaṃ nāḍīkāyā dīrghatvena vakratvena ca boddhavyam
vātikāni vātaharāṇi, uttaravātikāni uttaravāte pradhānavāte vātaśleṣmaṇi hitānīha grāhyāṇi
suṣṭhu upa samīpe tīrthaṃ yasya tasmin sūpatīrthe
prāṅmukhamiti paścime, udaṅmukhamiti dakṣiṇe; evaṃ hyabhimukhaṃ tīrthaṃ bhavati
aṅgārārthaṃ koṣṭhoavakāśo vidyate yasmin soaṅgārakoṣṭhakaḥ, sa eva stambha ityaṅgārakoṣṭhakastambhaḥ
sa ityatra ‘tvaṃ’ ityadhyāhāryaṃ, jānīyā ityarthaḥ; kiṃvā, ‘jānīyāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ, uttaratrāpi ‘praveśayet’ iti pāṭhaḥ; evaṃ ca sugamam
sarveṣu srotaḥsu vimuktaṃ sarvasrotovimuktam apagatavibandhastu apagatamalavibandho boddhavyaḥ
cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthamiti atropataptasya sahasā śītajalapraveśe śītajalaparāhata ūṣmā nayanopaghātaṃ karotītyabhiprāyaḥ

atra ca jentāke bhūmiviśeṣaparigrahajalasānnidhyādayo maṅgalārthāḥ; jalasānnidhyaṃ tu svidyamānasya darśanena dṛṣṭeḥ paripālanārthaṃ ca, tathā svedātiyogapratikriyārthaṃ kūṭāgārasya jalasānnidhye sukhena karaṇārthaṃ ca
śayanaṃ tatra coparīti atra kumbhīkopari śayanaṃ khaṭṭādi tathā kartavyaṃ yathā kumbhīkā na bhajyate
susaṃstīrṇa iti suṣṭhu saṃstīrṇe ācchādite, śayyayā khaṭvoparisthitayā ācchādite kūpe iti boddhavyam
uṣṇasadanamiti agnisantāpavyatirekeṇa nirjālakatayā ghanabhittitayā ca yadgṛhaṃ svedayati tadboddhavyam

upanāho dvividhaḥ- sāgniranagniśca; tatra yaḥ sāgnirupanāhaḥ sa saṅkara eva boddhavyaḥ, yaduktaṃ- “kolaṃ kulatthāḥ suradārurāsnāḥ” (sū.a.3) ityādināaaragvadhīye; yastvanagnirbahalatvena śarīroṣmarodhaṃ kṛtvā svedayati sa iha boddhavyaḥ
ātapaśca yadyapyuṣṇaḥ, tathāapyagnikṛtaṃ tasyoṣṇatvaṃ na bhavatītyanagnisveda uktaḥ
svinnena yathā kartavyaṃ tadāha- snigdha ityādi
pathyāśano bhavedityatra yadyapi śṛṅgagrāhikayā pathyaṃ noktaṃ, tathāapi svedapravṛttiviṣayadoṣasya yat pathyaṃ tadeva boddhavyam
saṅgrahe svedo yathā kāryakara iti snehapūrvaṃ prayuktenetyādi
yebhyaśca yadvidha iti vāte snigdha ityādi saṅgṛhṇāti
yatra deśe yathā yogya iti āmāśayagate vāte rūkṣapūrva ityādi
rājña iva mātrā paricchado yasya sa rājamātraḥ

sūkṣmāṇītyādi sūkṣmāṇīva sūkṣmāṇi durbodhatvena; tatra doṣasyāvasthāntarāṇi- kṣayastathā vṛddhistathā samatvaṃ, evamūrdhvadehagamanaṃ tathāadhodehagamanaṃ tiryaggamanaṃ vā, tathā śākhāśrayitvaṃ koṣṭhāśrayitvaṃ madhyamārgāśrayitvaṃ, tathā svadeśagamanaṃ paradeśagamanaṃ, tathā svatantratvaṃ paratantratvaṃ, tathāṃaśāṃśavikalpaḥ, tathā dhātuviśeṣāśrayitvaṃ, tathā kālaprakṛtidūṣyānuguṇatvādikṛtsnatantrapratipāditāni jñeyāni; evaṃ bheṣajasyāvasthāntarāṇi- taruṇatvaṃ, vṛddhatvam, ārdratvaṃ, śuṣkatvaṃ, dravyāntarasaṃyuktatvaṃ, svarasādikalpanāyogitvaṃ, rasavīryavipākaiḥ prabhāvaiśca tasmin dehe doṣādau tattatkāryakartṛtvamevamādīni; deśastvānūpajāṅgalasādhāraṇapraśastādibhedabhinnaḥ; kālāvasthāntarāṇi tu ṛtubhedāḥ, pūrvāhṇādiśca tathā vyādhyavasthā jvarāṣṭāhādaya ityevamādīni; balaṃ tu sahajaṃ yuktikṛtaṃ tathā kālakṛtamutkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭamadhyādibhedabhinnaṃ; śarīraṃ tu sthūlatvakṛśatvasāravattvaniḥsāravattvādi, tathā paripālanīyadṛṣṭimarmādyavayavaviśeṣādibhiśca bhinnam; āhārastu prakṛtikaraṇasaṃyogarāśibhedādibhirbhinnaḥ; sātmyaṃ tu deśataḥ kālato vyādhitaḥ prakṛtitaḥ svabhāvatoabhyāsataśca bhinnaṃ bhavati; sattvaṃ tu bhayaśauryaviṣādaharṣādiyogabhinnaṃ bhavati; prakṛtibhedāstvanekaprakārabhinnavātādyārabdhatvena boddhavyāḥ; vayobhedāstu bālyayauvanavārdhakyatadavāntarabhedāḥ; etāni doṣādyavasthāntarāṇi cikitsāprayoge yathāyathāapekṣyante, tadudāharaṇaṃ śāstreanusaraṇīyam, iha likhyamānaṃ tu vistaratvaṃ granthasyāvahatīti noktam

vividhānapīti apiśabdaḥ samāsenāpītyevaṃrūpo jñeyaḥ; tena gṛhādayoapi vistareṇocyante, saṅgrahaṇīyādayaśca samāseneti dvayamapi susthaṃ syāt; yadi vā ‘dvividhānapi’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tena bhogārthāni tathā vyāpatsādhanāni gṛhyante

ācamanīyodakoṣṭham ācamānārthamudakakoṣṭhaṃ; kiṃvā ācamyate yena pātreṇa tadācamanaṃ; maṇiko golakaḥ, piṭharaḥ sthālī, paryogaḥ kaṭāhaḥ, kumbho dṛḍhāvayavoalpamukho ghaṭaḥ, kaṭaḥ tṛṇādiracitamāsanam, udañcanaṃ pidhānaśarāvaḥ, paripacanaṃ tailapācanikā
suprakṣālitetyādau upadhānaḥ śilāputra iti prasiddhaḥ, dṛṣadaḥ pāṣāṇapaṭṭakāḥ
iṣṭa iti śodhanakartṛpuruṣanakṣatrādyanuguṇe auṣadhaprayogārthaṃ vihita ityarthaḥ; yaduktaṃ jyotiṣa- “puṣyo hastastathā jyeṣṭhā rohiṇī śravaṇāśvinau
svāti saumyaṃ ca bhaiṣajye kuryādanyatra varjayet” ityādi
upavegaṃ vegasamīpam; etena sarvathāapravṛtte vege pravartanaṃ niṣedhayati

vegaviśeṣadarśanāddhītyādigranthasya bhāvino yogāyogādīn vegaviṣayānupalabhya tarkayatītyarthaḥ; kiṃvā, siddhau vaigikī śuddhirabhidhātavyā “jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau” (si.a.1) ityādinā, tāmanena darśayati

apravṛttiḥ kutaściditi sarvasyaivāpravṛttiḥ; tathā kevalasya kṛtsnasya śodhanīyadoṣasyāpravṛttiḥ; tathauṣadhasya vibhraṃśaḥ prātilomyena gamanaṃ; yathā- vamanasyādha ūrdhvaṃ ca virecanasya, etadeva siddhāvuktaṃ- “ayogaḥ prātilomyena nacāalpaṃ vā pravartanam” (si.
kiṃvā, kutaściddhāapravṛttiḥ stokadoṣapravṛttirityarthaḥ, tathā kevalasya cāpyauṣadhasya pravṛttiriti yojanā
yathākramamiti vamane prathamaṃ śleṣmā, tadanu pittaṃ, tadanu vāyuḥ; yaduktaṃ- “kramāt kaphaḥ pittamathānilaśca yasyaiti samyagvamitaḥ sa iṣṭaḥ” (si.
samyagyogoapi hartavyadoṣasyālpatvamadhyatvotkṛṣṭatvena trividho bhavatīti darśayannāha- yogena tvityādi
tuśabdoavadhāraṇe, tena yogenaiva yaḥ pramāṇaviśeṣoalpādistena, na tvayogātiyogābhyāmityarthaḥ; ayaṃ ca tīkṣṇādiyogavibhāgaḥ peyākramotkarṣārthaḥ, tathāhi vakṣyati siddhau- “peyāṃ vilepīṃ” (si.
a.6) ityādinā granthena prapañcena vaktavyāḥ, atastatraiṣāṃ yogātiyogajanyo yaścāyogajanyaḥ sa sphuṭo jñeyaḥ
snaihikādidhūmapānavikalpaḥ puruṣaprakṛtyapekṣaḥ; ata eva sāmarthyata ityuktaṃ, yadyasya yujyata ityarthaḥ
tāni dṛṣṭvā tu peyādikramaṃ kuryānna laṅghanam” (si.
ayaṃ ca dvādaśakālanivartanīyaḥ kramaḥ pradhānaśuddhiśuddhe jñeyaḥ, madhye tvaṣṭānukālikaḥ, tathāalpe caturanukālikaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “peyāṃ vilepīṃ” (si.

etacca saṃsarjanakramādūrdhvaṃ saptarātreṇa prakṛtibhojanagamanaṃ tadā kartavyaṃ yadi vamanānantaraṃ virecanaṃ na kartavyaṃ bhavati, tatkaraṇe tu saṃsarjanakramādūrdhvameva snehapānaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “saṃsṛṣṭabhaktaṃ navameahni sarpistaṃ pāyayedvāapyanuvāsayedvā” (si.
yadi saṃsarjanakramaṃ tathāanuguṇābhyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā snehaḥ kriyate, tadā pakṣādvireko vāntasya na syāt
vikārāṃśceti kuṣṭhajvarādīn virecanasādhyān; pūrvaṃ tu “sūkṣmāṇi hi” ityādau vikāro noktaḥ, tasya parīkṣyatvenaiva grahaṇāt; kiṃvā doṣagrahaṇenaiva tatra vikāragrahaṇam
samprati daridrasya yathoktaṃ sambhāramakṛtvāapi saṃśodhanakaraṇamāha- daridra ityādi
saṅgrahe- īśvarāḥ savilāsāḥ; tena rājño rājamātrasya ca grahaṇam
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne nirdeśacatuṣke pañcadaśoadhyāyaḥ
cikitsā prabhṛtarūpā sadā yatnena āturopaḍhaukanīyatvena ca yasya vidyate sa cikitsāprābhṛtīyaḥ
virecayatītyatra vāmayatītyapi boddhavyaṃ, virecanaśabdasya vamaneapi pravṛtteḥ

nanu vamanādau kasmānmithyāyogo nocyate, yāvatā yasya vastuna ucito yogaḥ sa yogaḥ, tasya svalpo vā yogaḥ sarvathā vā ayogo ayoga ucyate, tasyaivātimātrayogo vikārakaroatiyogaḥ, anucitasambandhena tu vastuno mithyāyogaḥ; tenehāpyutkliṣṭaśleṣmādidharmaprayukte puruṣe virecanaṃ sarvathāayaugikameva, tacca prayuktaṃ pratīpagamanenaiva yāti, virecane mithyāyogoayamucitaḥ, evaṃ vamanādiṣvapi jñeyam
naivam, evambhūtamithyāyogasyāyogenaiva grahaṇāt, uktaṃ hi- “prātilomyena doṣāṇāṃ haraṇātte hyakṛtsnaśaḥ

duṣṭavirecanauṣadhasya rasanayopayujyamānasya hīnamātratvātimātratvābhyāṃ vinā yadvyādhikaraṇatvaṃ tanmithyāyogādeva paraṃ bhavati; yaduktaṃ tisraiṣaṇīye- “mithyāyogo rāśivarjeṣvāhāravidhiviśeṣāyataneṣūpadekṣyate” (sū.
satyaṃ bheṣajasya mithyāyogoayaṃ, vamanasya tu doṣaharaṇarūpasyāyoga iti; evaṃ ca virecanādāvapi jñeyam
yadyapyatrāpi mithyāyogaḥ kathañcit pāryate kalpayituṃ, tathāapi prayojanaśūnyatvādācāryeṇa pṛthaṅna kṛtaḥ, śabdādiṣu tu mithyāyogināṃ sambandhamātrasyāpi parihārārthaṃ pṛthakkṛta iti
yathākramamiti paṭhan krameṇaiveti darśayati; yaduktaṃ- “prāptiśca viṭpittakaphānilānāṃ samyagviriktasya bhavet krameṇa” (si.
vamanātiyoge viṭpittakaphavātānāmiti na yojanīyaṃ, yena vamanaprayoge kaphapittānilāgamarūpaḥ kramo bhavet
yaduktaṃ- “kramāt kaphaḥ pittamathānilaśca yasyaiti samyagvamitiḥ sa iṣṭaḥ” (si.
anāyāsakṛtaḥ śramaḥ klamaḥ; śramastviha svalpenāyāsena jñeyaḥ
samūladoṣāpahārakatvaṃ saṃśodhanasya, laṅghanapācanayostu doṣāpaharatve satyapi na saṃśodhanavaddoṣahantṛtvamityāha- doṣā ityādi
na teṣāṃ punarudbhava iti balavaddoṣakāraṇatvaṃ vineti mantavyam
laṅghanapācanābhyāṃ rogakāraṇībhūtadoṣaprakopaharaṇamātre kṛte rogo yo nivṛttaḥ sa mūlabhūtāśayavyavasthitadoṣānucchedādyatkiñcidanuguṇakālādiprāptyā punaḥ kupitadoṣeṇa bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
samprati śodhanena yathā doṣakṣayastathā dhātukṣayoapi bhavati, tena tatra pratīkāramāha- bheṣajetyādi
āhāraireveti evāvadhāraṇe; tena bheṣajena bṛṃhaṇaṃ niṣedhati, bheṣajasya vīryapradhānasya tadā duḥsahatvāt
sānuvāsanairityatra cakāro boddhavyaḥ, tenābhyaṅgādibhiśca bṛṃhaṇaṃ pathyam
smaran pūrvamanukramamityanena yaḥ pūrvamayoge hetubhūtastaṃ pariharanniti śikṣayati
samprati yadetat siddhau vakṣyamāṇaṃ rogāṇaṃ sādhanaṃ tadanuṣaṅgeṇa ca sarvabheṣajānāmeva kṣaṇabhaṅgibhāve pakṣeapi rogaśamakatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ prakaraṇamārabhate- jāyanta ityādi

pravṛttihetuḥ utpattiheturbhāvānāmasti, nirodhe vināśe heturbhāvānāṃ kāraṇaṃ nāsti; yasmāt sarva eva bhāvāḥ pradīpārcirvadutpattau kāraṇāpekṣiṇaḥ, vināśe tu dvitīyakṣaṇāvidyamānatvalakṣaṇe sahajasiddhe na hetvantaramapekṣante; yato na svābhāvikarūpe hetvantarāpekṣā bhavati, nahyutpannaḥ khaṅgaḥ svābhāvike lauhamayatve kāraṇāntaramapekṣate; tadevaṃ sarveṣāmeva bhāvānāṃ svābhāvike nāśe viṣamadhātūnāmapi nāśaḥ svābhāvika eveti bhāvaḥ
tatrāpi vināśeapi, hetuṃ kāraṇaṃ, hetoravartanamiti utpādakahetorabhāvaṃ, manyanta iti yojanā
evamapi hetuparamparāyāḥ kṣaṇikatvena tatkāryāṇāmapi svabhāvādeva nityaṃ sannihitasvahetuvināśarūpavināśahetūnāṃ na vināśahetucikitsāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ
karma sādhyaṃ; svabhāvoparame sati na kimapi sādhyaṃ paśyāmīti bhāvaḥ
kān samīkurute iti viṣamāṇāmasthiratvena sāmyaṃ tatra kartuṃ na pāryata ityāśayaḥ
kā vā cikitseti rogapraśamaṃ pratyakāraṇatvena cikitsā nāstītyarthaḥ
kimarthaṃ vā prayujyata iti yannivṛttyarthaṃ cikitsā prayujyate taddhātuvaiṣamyaṃ svata eva nivṛttamiti cikitsāprayojanaṃ nāsti

bhāvānāṃ nāśakāraṇaṃ na jñāyate, tat kimabhāvādeva, yathā- śaśaviṣāṇam, uta vā jñānāyogyatvāt pṛthivyāṃ nikhātamūlakīlakādivat sadapi na jñāyate, ityāha- nāśakāraṇābhāvāditi; na jñānāyogyatvena, kintarhyabhāvādevetyarthaḥ

evaṃ manyate- nityagaḥ kālo yathā vinaśvaratvena na hetvantaraṃ vināśeapekṣate, tathā sarva eva bhāvāḥ; yaddhi yasya hetvantarāpekṣaṃ na tasya tadavaśyambhāvi, yathā- paṭasya rāgaḥ; hetvantarāpekṣī cedvināśaḥ syāt, nāvaśyambhāvī syāt; etadviparyayāccānapekṣatvaṃ vināśasya siddham
sampratyahetuko vināśa utpattyanantarameva bhavati, paścādasthiratvena saṃskārādhānamapi bhāveṣu na pāryate kartumityāha- śīghragatvādityādi
yathā bhūta iti yādṛśa utpannaḥ, tatheti tādṛśa eva vipadyate; kutaḥ? śīghragatvāt asthiratvāt
pūrvasādhitamahetuvināśitvaṃ tathā śīghragatvahetusādhitaṃ cāsaṃskāryatvamupasaṃharati- nirodha ityādi
anyathākriyā anyathākaraṇaṃ, saṃskārādhānamiti yāvat; etena viṣame dhātau sāmyaṃ saṃskāra ādhīyatāmityevaṃrūpāapi cikitsā nirastā mantavyā
evaṃ vyavasthite pūrvākṣiptaṃ cikitsitaṃ samādadhati- yābhirityādi
‘sā cikitsā’ ityanena ‘kā vā cikitsā’ ityākṣepaḥ parihṛtaḥ
‘ityarthaṃ kriyate kriyā’ ityanena ‘kimarthaṃ vā’ ityākṣepaḥ parihṛtaḥ
viṣameṣu dhātuṣu yābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ sāmā dhātavo janyante sā cikitsā

evaṃ manyate- yadyapi dhātuvaiṣamyaṃ kṣaṇikatvena vinaśvaraṃ, tathāapi vinaśyadapi taddhātuvaiṣamyaṃ svakāryaṃ viṣamameva dhātumārabhate, evaṃ soapyaparaṃ viṣamamiti na dhātuvaiṣamyasantānanivṛttirdhātusāmyajanakahetuṃ vinā; yadā tu dhātusāmyaheturupayukto bhavati, tadā tena sahitaṃ vaiṣamyasantatipatitamapi kāraṇaṃ samameva dhātusantānamārabhate, yathā- mudgaraprahārasahito ghaṭaparamāṇusantāno visadṛśaṃ kapālasantānamārabhate; evaṃ vyavasthite ‘kathaṃ śarīre’ ityādigrantho vyākhyeyaḥ
dehasukhāyuṣāṃ dānāt dharmādīnāṃ dātā bhavati, dehasampattisādhyatvāddharmādīnāmiti bhāvaḥ
saṅgrahe siddhisaṃśrayaṃ ca vyāpattisaṃśrayaṃ ca siddhivyāpattisaṃśrayaṃ; tatra siddhisaṃśrayaṃ siddhisthānasaṃśrayeṇa, vyāpattisaṃśrayaṃ ‘atiyogānubaddhānāṃ’ ityādinoktam
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne caturthe kalpanācatuṣke cikitsāprābhṛtīyo nāma ṣoḍaśoadhyāyaḥ

pūrvacatuṣkacatuṣṭayena bheṣajamabhihitaṃ, samprati tadviṣayarogābhidhānārthaṃ rogacatuṣkoabhidhātavyaḥ, cikitsā ca vidheyatvenaiva pradhānamataḥ prathamamuktā, kiñca darśitaścāyaṃ prathamādhyāya eva sambandhaḥ, evaṃ cāṅgeṣu marmasu ca pradhānabhūtaśirohṛdayarogābhidhāyakatvena kiyantaḥ śirasīyoabhidhīyate
kṣayasthānavṛddhayo doṣamānaṃ, tasya vikalpo doṣāntarasambandhāsambandhakṛto bhedaḥ

yatoatraiva sāmānyena brūte- “vinā pramehamapyetā jāyante duṣṭamedasaḥ” iti; anyathā hi ‘vinā madhumehaṃ’ iti kṛtaṃ syāt; tathā cikitsite vakṣyati sāmānyenaiva yat- “pramehiṇāṃ yāḥ piḍakā mayoktā rogādhikāre pṛthageva sapta” (ci.

tathā madhumehapiḍakānāṃ cikitsitopadeśācca sarvamehabhavatvaṃ piḍakānāṃ, madhumehabhavatve hi madhumehasyaivāsādhyatvānna tadbhavapiḍakānāmupakramaṇīyatvamasti; kiñca pradeśāntareapi madhumehaśabdenāyaṃ sarvapramehānuktavān, yathā- “gulmī ca madhumehī ca rājayakṣmī ca yo naraḥ
atra hi yadi vātiko madhumehoabhipretaḥ syāttadā tasya svarūpata evāsādhyatvena ‘balamāṃsaparikṣaye sati’ iti viśeṣaṇamanarthakaṃ syāt
suśrutenāpi ca sāmānyena pramehe evaitāḥ piḍakā darśitāḥ, yaduktaṃ- “tatra vasāmedobhyāmabhipannaśarīrasya tribhirdoṣaiścānugatadhātoḥ pramehiṇo daśa piḍakā jāyante” (su.
sarva eva pramehā yasmāddehaṃ madhurīkṛtya jāyante tasmānmadhumehā ityucyante, vacanaṃ hi- “ṣaṭpadapippīlikābhiśca śarīramūtrābhisaraṇam” (ni.
4) iti, tathā ca vāgbhaṭaḥ- “madhuraṃ yacca sarveṣu prāyo madhviva mehati
atīti pūrveṇa pareṇa ca śītāmbusevanādityanena sambadhyate
duṣṭādāmāt duṣṭāmāt; kiṃvā ‘uṣṇāmāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tatroṣṇāccāmāccetyarthaḥ
asraṃ ca praduṣyatītyabhidadhānaḥ sarvaśirorogeṣu raktaduṣṭiṃ darśayati
prāṇā ityādināaṅgeṣu śiraḥprādhānyaṃ darśayan prakṛtaśirorogāṇāmevātyahitatvaṃ darśayati; tena notsūtraṃ śiraḥprādhānyābhidhānam
śirogatatvena nāsādirogeṣvapi prāpteṣu tān vihāyaivāṣṭodarīye proktāṃstāneva śiraḥśūlalakṣaṇān rogān prapañcena vaktumāha- pṛthagityādi
saṅgrahe aṣṭodarīye; tena nārūṃṣikādayoatraprakaraṇe śirorogaśabdenocyante; śirorogaśabdasya śūla eva rujākare vṛttatvāt
atra ca yadyapi samatāapi vṛddhikṣayavikalpe paṭhyate, tathāapi samatāyāḥ svātantryeṇa vikārākartṛtvāt ‘vṛddhikṣayakṛta’ ityuktam
vṛddhirekasya samatā caikasyaikasya saṅkṣaya ityanena ṣaḍvikārāḥ

atra kecidetadeva paramudāharaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ paṭhanti, śeṣodāharaṇaṃ tu kṛtsne tantre boddhavyaṃ; kecittu vṛddhikṣayavikalpasya durbodhatvena sarveṣāmeva dvādaśānāmapi vikalpānāmācāryeṇa lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtamiti kṛtvā sarvameva paṭhanti
nanu prakṛtisthe pitte kathaṃ tadā dāhaśceti saṅgataṃ bhavati, na hi prakṛtistho doṣo vikārakārī, na ca vāyordāhaḥ sambhavati

ucyate- yatra yatreti vacanād yatra kupitena vāyunā pittaṃ nītaṃ, tatra śarīrāvayave prakṛtimānasthitamapi pittaṃ vṛddhameva, yatastasmin pradeśe tāvān pittasambandha ucito na bhavatyevetyadhikena tatra pittena dāha upapanna eva, evamanyatrāpi prakṛtisthasyāpi doṣasya vikāre vyākhyeyam
anye tu bruvate- prakṛtisthānāmapi doṣāṇāṃ duṣṭadoṣasambandhādvikārakāritvaṃ bhavati; yathā- raktādīnām
dehaujo dehasāraḥ; kiṃvā dehaśca ojaśca dehaujaḥ
liṅgaṃ svaṃ jahatītyanena kṣīṇānāṃ prakṛtiliṅgakṣayavyatiriktaṃ vikārakartṛtvaṃ nāstīti darśayati; yato vṛddhā unmārgagāmino doṣā dūṣyaṃ dūṣayanto jvarādīn kurvanti na kṣīṇāḥ, svayameva duḥsthitatvāt
ete ca dviṣaṣṭirbhedā āviṣkṛtatamatvenoktāḥ; tenaikadoṣakṣaye dvidoṣavṛddhau ca vṛddhavṛddhatarabhedādibhyoadhikatvamudbhāvanīyam
nanu bhavatvevaṃ saṅkhyā yadi sannipāto doṣāṇāṃ syāt, sa tu na bhavitumarhati, yato vātādīnāṃ parasparaṃ viruddhāḥ santi guṇāḥ, viruddhaguṇānāṃ tu parasparopaghāto bhavati, yathā- vahnitoyayoḥ

naivaṃ, virodho hi bhāvānāṃ kāryonneyaḥ, nānyato dṛṣṭamātreṇa kalpayituṃ pāryate; yatoanyatra toyadahanayorbheda upalabdhaḥ, tat kiṃ pāñcabhautikadravyārambheapi tayorvirodhāt pāñcabhautikaṃ dravyaṃ na syāt, toyāgniguṇātirekādvāamlaraso na syāt, tasmādanupalabdhatvāddoṣasaṃsarge virodhasya svabhāvaparyanuyogo na yujyate
atha manyase- evaṃ viruddhaguṇānāmapi doṣāṇāmavirodhe “viruddhaguṇasannipāte bhūyasāalpamavajīyate” (vi.

prabhāvastu tayorvirodhako bhavatyeva; yathā- tridoṣakaranikucagatā guṇāḥ samān doṣān kurvanti paraṃ, na tu viruddhatvena doṣaharaṇaṃ kurvate tridoṣakartṛtvaprabhāvāt; tathā āmalakeamlatvaṃ vātaṃ hanti, mādhuryaśaitye tu pittaṃ, śleṣmāṇaṃ ca kaṭutvatiktatve; nikuce tvamlatvaṃ kaṣāyaśaityābhibhūtaṃ vātaṃ na nihanti, mādhuryaśaitye cāmlatvābhibhūte pittaṃ na jayata evamādi
tasmāddoṣāṇāṃ prabhāvoayaṃ dṛṣṭatvādavadhāryate- yat- na te parasparamupaghnanti
evambhūtaprabhāvatve tu teṣāmadṛṣṭameva kāraṇaṃ, prāṇināṃ duḥkhajanakena hyadṛṣṭena teavirodhena niveśyante, ata eva vakṣyati- “viruddhairapi na tvete guṇairghnanti parasparam
anena ca vyākhyānena ‘yathā doṣā anyonyaṃ nopaghnanti, tathā rasaraktādīnapi nopahanyuḥ’ ityādi yaducyate kaiścit, tat sarvaṃ nirastam
3) iti cikitsite vakṣyati, tena prakṛtirdoṣasya pratipakṣā bhavatītyuktaṃ, prakṛtiśca janmaprabhṛtivṛddho vātādirucyate, “doṣānuśayitā hyeṣāṃ dehaprakṛtirucyate” (sū.

7) ityādivacanāt; tadayaṃ prākṛtena doṣeṇa doṣasya virodhaḥ kathaṃ tarhyupapannaḥ? ucyate- tatra prakṛteḥ pratyanīkatā ananuguṇatvena mantavyā, samānāṃ hi prakṛtiṃ prāpya doṣaḥ pravṛddhabalo bhavati, asamānāṃ tu prāpya tathā balavānna bhavati, nāsamānayā prakṛtyā hanyate; evamanyatrāpyunneyam
ativṛddhena vāyunāśleṣmaṇo durbalasya duṣṭatvādvirodho bhavatyeva kvacit, naitāvatā saṃsargasannipātāsambhavaḥ
atra malānāmityanena mūtrapurīṣayoḥ pañcendriyamalānāṃ ca grahaṇam
malāyanānītyanena pañcendriyādhiṣṭhānānāṃ mukhanāsikācakṣuḥkarṇānāṃ tvagindriyādhiṣṭhānabhūtānāṃ ca lomakūpaprajananānāṃ yathāsvaṃ malāyanāni gṛhyante
śuddhamiti śuklaṃ, raktamīṣaditi kiñcidraktaṃ, sapītakamiti īṣatpītakaṃ; tena śuklavarṇamojaḥ, raktapītau tu varṇāvatrānugatau; kiṃvā, īṣadityalpapramāṇaṃ, tenāṣṭabindukamoja iti darśayati
etaccāṣṭabindukaṃ paramojo jñeyam, ardhāñjaliparimāṇaṃ tu yadojastadapradhānaṃ; yacchārīre vakṣyati- “tāvaccaiva ślaiṣmikasyaujasaḥ pramāṇam” (śā.
ata evārthe daśamahāmūlīye vakṣyati- “tat parasyaujasaḥ sthānaṃ” (sū.
iha ca kṣayalakṣaṇamardhāñjalimānasyaiva jñaiyam, aṣṭabindukasya tvavayavanāśeapi mṛtyurbhavatīti hṛdītyādinā granthena darśayati
etaccaujaḥ sarvadhātusamudāyarūpaṃ, tena saptadhātuṣvevāvaruddhamiti nāṣṭamadhātutvātiprasaktiḥ; ata eva suśruteapyuktaṃ- “rasādīnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ dhātūnāṃ yat paraṃ tejastat khalvojaḥ” (su.
tadvadojaḥ śarīrebhyo guṇaiḥ saṃhriyate nṛṇām” iti

ete cāṣṭādaśa kṣayā āviṣkṛtatamatvenoktāḥ; tena udakakṣayasvarakṣayādyanabhidhānaṃ nodbhāvanīyam; uktaṃ hi- “svarakṣayamurorogaṃ” iti; tathodakakṣayalakṣaṇaṃ yathā- “jihvātālvoṣṭhakaṇṭhaklomasaṃśoṣaṃ pipāsāṃ cātivṛddhāṃ dṛṣṭvā udakavahānyasya srotāṃsi praduṣṭānīti jānīyāt” (vi.
atra vātakṣayaheturnokto vilakṣaṇatvāt, sa cācintanadivāsvapanādirjñeyaḥ; kiṃvā, anaśanāt kiṭṭābhāvaḥ, tataśca kiṭṭarūpasya vātasyāpyanutpādāt kṣayo jñeyaḥ
samprati saptapiḍakā vaktavyāḥ, atastāsāṃ pradhānahetutvena pramehāneva tāvannidānādikrameṇāha- gurvityādi
tena suśruteapi piḍakādhikyamuktaṃ yat, tanna virodhi
vidradhiṃ dvividhāmityanenābhyantaravidradherapi vidradhitvena piḍakānāṃ saptatveavirodha iti darśayati
vyāpannaṃ ca bahu ca madyamupayuṅkte yaḥ sa vyāpannabahumadyaḥ
hṛnnābhibastijāsu sānnipātikīṃ pṛthak paṭhan sānnipātikīṃ pakvāmapakvāṃ cāsādhyāṃ darśayati
etena ca piḍakānāṃ mādhumehikatvaṃ yat pūrvamuktaṃ tat prāyikatvena jñeyam
pramehapiḍakāprasaṅgenānyāsāmapi piḍakānāmāviṣkṛtānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūte- tathāanyā ityādi
samprati doṣāṇāṃ gatiṃ vivṛṇoti- kṣaya ityādi
caya ityatra praśabdo luptanirdiṣṭaḥ, tena prakṛṣṭacayaḥ; evaṃ prakṛṣṭaḥ kopaḥ prakopaḥ; evaṃ praśamoapi
etena varṣādiṣu pittādīnāṃ prakṛṣṭaścayo bhavatīti darśyate, itaradoṣasyāpi ca stokamātreṇa cayo yathāsambhavaṃ sūcyate; tena śaradyanubalatvena kaphaprakopo bhavatītyādi gṛhītaṃ bhavati
etacca prādhānyenaiva jñeyaṃ, tena prāvṛṣi śleṣmapittakopenāpradhānena na vyabhicāraḥ
atra hi pavanādaya iti pavanapradhānāḥ; evaṃ vasante vātapittaprakope vyākhyeyam

atra ca ṣaṭsu ṛtuṣu pittaśleṣmavātānāṃ prabalacayādayo vibhajyamānatvena; tena pittacayakāle vātasya kopaḥ, śaradi pittasya prakopakāle vātapraśamaḥ, hemante pittapraśamaḥ kaphasya cayaḥ, vasante tu kaphaprakopa eva paraṃ, tathā kaphapraśamake grīṣme vātacaya iti ca syāt
vātaṃ parityajya pittādīnāmityabhidhānāṃ visargasyābhipretatvenāgre vaktavyatvāt kṛtaṃ, visarge ca pittacaya eva bhavatīti kṛtvā
oja iti sārabhūtaṃ; yadi vā dvitīyaślaiṣmikaujohetutvenaujaḥ
vakṣyati hi śārīre- “tāvaccaiva ślaiṣmikasyaujasaśca pramāṇam” (śā.a.7) iti
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rogacatuṣke kiyantaḥśirasīyo nāma saptadaśoadhyāyaḥ
pūrvādhyāye piḍakā uktāḥ, tāśca śotharūpāḥ, ataḥ śothādhikārāt triśothīyoabhidhīyate
bhedanam āśayavidāraṇaṃ, kṣaṇanam asthicūrṇanaṃ, bhañjanaṃ jarjarīkaraṇaṃ, picchnam atyarthapīḍanam, utpeṣaṇaṃ śilotpeṣaṇamiva, veṣṭanam agranthibandhanaṃ sarpādibhiḥ

nijavyañjanaikadeśaviparītairiti nijalakṣaṇebhya āgantūnāmekadeśo viparīto bhavati, sa ca vātādijanyaśyāvādivarṇavikāratvājjñeyaḥ; kiṃvā āganturvyathāpūrvo bhavati paścādvātādibhiranubadhyate, nijastu pūrvaṃ vātādilakṣaṇairyujyate paścādvedanāvān bhavatītyekadeśavaiparītyam
karmādyatikarśitasya tu sahasāatigurvādisevanaṃ śothahetuḥ; karmeti pañcakarma
na suṣūyate na sahate; sparśanaṃ ca na sahate, uṣṇaṃ ca na sahate
etena vāyoścalatvena kṣaṇācca ruk, kṣaṇācca tadabhāva iti jñeyam

pādābhinirvṛttaḥ śothaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ laghāvadhodeśe jātaḥ san yadā na jīyate tadā gurumūrdhvadeśaṃ gataḥ sa na pāryate jetuṃ, yo hi laghau pradeśe jetuṃ na pāryate sa gurupradeśagato nitarāmeva na pāryate; evaṃ prasṛtaḥ strīmukhācca ya ityapi jñeyam
vacanaṃ hi- “adhobhāgo guruḥ strīṇāmūrdhvaḥ puṃsāṃ gurustathā” (su.sū.a.46) iti
śanairitivacanena galagaṇḍakāriṇo doṣāścirakriyā bhavantīti darśayati; galagrahādau cāśukāriṇo doṣā bhavanti
visarpasya piḍakāyāśca tulyakāraṇatveapi visarpe sarpaṇaśīlo doṣaḥ, piḍakāyāṃ ca sthiro jñeyaḥ; ata eva piḍakāsamprāptau ‘avatiṣṭhate’ ityuktam
yasya pittamityādau pittaṃ prāpya śoṇitaṃ kartṛ śuṣyatīti yojanīyam
durjayoantāyeti durjayo vā yathākramamupakramyamāṇaḥ, antāya vā mithyopakramādveti mantavyam
śothaḥ sañjāyate tena kaścideva pramucyate” iti
kṣipramityanukrānta ityanena sambadhyate, tena trirātraghātitvaṃ yasya tasya kathaṃ śīghrapraśama iti codyaṃ nottiṣṭhate; kiṃvā kṣipraṃ sampadyate sukhīti vyādhimahimnā bhavati
vyādherevaitat svarūpaṃ yacchīghraṃ hanti, śīghraṃ praśāmyatīti
yaduktaṃ- “sa śīghraṃ śīghrakāritvāt praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā” (ci.
bālaiḥ ajñaiḥ, asādhye ajñā evotsāhāt pravartanta ityarthaḥ
asādhyasya mṛdudāruṇatvaṃ yāpyapratyākhyeyabhedena, tathā sadyaḥprāṇaharakālāntaraprāṇaharatvādinā ca
samutthānabhedā hetubhedāḥ; rūkṣabhojanarātrijāgaraṇādibhinnahetujanyo hi vāto bhinnopakramasādhyaśca bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
yathāsthūleṣviti ye ye sthūlā udaramūtrakṛcchrādayasteṣu; saṅgrahaḥ aṣṭodarīyarogasaṅgrahe (udiśyate) ityarthaḥ
asthūleṣu vikāreṣu aṣṭodarīye sañjñayāanukteṣu kathaṃ vyavasthākaraṇamityāha- tathetyādi
prakṛtisāmānyaṃ samānakāraṇatā; tenānukteṣu sākṣāddhyādhiṣu vātajoayaṃ śleṣmajoayamiti, tathā rasajoayaṃ raktajoayamityādikā cikitsāvyavahārārthaṃ vyavasthā kartavyeti bhāvaḥ
sthānāntaragataścetyatra cakāra ekasthānagatoapi bahuvikāraṃ karotīti samuccinoti
evaṃ manyate- yadvātārabdhatvādijñānameva kāraṇaṃ rogāṇāṃ cikitsāyāmupakāri, nāmajñānaṃ tu vyavahāramātraprayojanārthaṃ na svarūpeṇa cikitsāyāmupakārīti
samprati vātādijñānena rogajñānamuddiṣṭaṃ tenopoddhātena vātādīnāṃ prakṛtisthānāmaprakṛtisthānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ vaktumāha- nityā ityādi
dhātugatiriti rasādīnāṃ poṣyaṃ dhātuṃ prati gamanam
kṣamādayaśca śleṣmaṇaḥ prabhāvāt kriyante; evamanyatrāpi jñeyam
vṛddhirvāapi virodhināmiti uktaprākṛtalakṣaṇavirodhināṃ karmaṇāṃ vṛddhiḥ; yathā vātakṣaye utsāhavirodhino viṣādasya vṛddhiḥ, pittakṣayeadarśanāpaktyādīnāṃ, śleṣmakṣaye raukṣyādīnāṃ vṛddhiḥ

iha prākṛtakarmahānau satyāṃ nāvaśyaṃ virodhikarmavṛddhirata uktaṃ- vṛddhirvetyādi; na hyavaśyamutsāhahānāvalpamātrāyāṃ satyāṃ viṣādo vardhate, alobhanyūnatve vā manāglobho vardhate; kiṃvā, utsāhādyabhāvenābhāvamukhena jñānārthaṃ ‘karmaṇaḥ prākṛtāddhāniḥ’ ityuktaṃ, viṣādādivṛddhyā tu vidhimukhena jñānārthaṃ ‘vṛddhirvāapi virodhinām’ ityuktam

yaducyate- vṛddhirvāapi virodhināmiti virodhidoṣāṇāṃ, yathā- pittavṛddhau śleṣmakṣayo jāyate, ityevamādi; tanna, yatoanyadoṣavṛddhāvanyasyāvaśyaṃ na hyapāyo bhavati, tathāhi sati pittavṛddhau satyāṃ sarvadā śleṣmakṣyaḥ syāt; na ca doṣāḥ parasparaghātakā iti prāgeva pratipāditaṃ; pradeśāntareapi doṣāṇāṃ svalakṣaṇahānireva paraṃ kṣayalakṣaṇaṃ- “kṣīṇā jahati liṅgaṃ svaṃ” (sū.a.17) ityanenoktam
prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ, tasya vaiśeṣyamādhikyaṃ; śleṣmaṇaḥ snehaśaityamādhuryādiryā prakṛtistasyā atisnigdhātiśaityātimādhuryādivaiśeṣyaṃ vṛddhilakṣaṇam
niyatamiti pratiniyataṃ, yadyasya prakṛtilakṣaṇaṃ tadvṛddhaṃ saptasyaiva vṛddhilakṣaṇamityarthaḥ; anye tu niścitamityāhuḥ
saṅgrahe śothānāṃ sādhyatāmiti bheṣajaviśeṣasādhyatvam, upaśaya ityarthaḥ; tacca ‘snehauṣṇyamardanābhyāṃ ca praṇaśyet sa ca vātika’ ityuktaṃ jñeyam
na ceti na ca sādhyatāṃ, yathā- ‘yaśca pādābhinirvṛttaḥ’ ityādi
śothān pūrvajānityabhidadhāna upajihvādiṣu pūrvaṃ śotho bhavati, paścādupajihvādirogavyaktiriti darśayati
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rogacatuṣke triśothīyo nāmāṣṭādaśoadhyāyaḥ
ihaikādi saṅkhyāparityāgādaṣṭasaṅkhyāgrahaṇamādau kṛtam, aṣṭasaṅkhyāyā bahutvena prādhānyāt; viṃśatisaṅkhyamehādīnāmūnaviṃśatyādyadhaḥsaṅkhyānupūrvīprāptyabhāvānna kṛtaḥ prathamaṃ niveśaḥ
yadyapi cikitsiteaṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni, tathāapīha mahākuṣṭhābhiprāyeṇa saptocyante
sthānamiva sthānaṃ kāraṇaṃ; tena, anaśanasthānānyarocakāni; anena kāraṇena kāryāṇyarocakāni lakṣyante; tena rogasaṅgrahe kāraṇābhidhānamanyāyyamiti na bhavati
pūrvoddeśamabhisamasyeti kiyantaḥśirasīye vistaroktān saṅkṣipya; kiṃvā kiyantaḥśirasīya eva “ardhāvabhedako vā syāt” (sū.
17) ityādyuddiṣṭānabhisamasya parityajya śirasyeva rujārūpā ye pañca ta ucyante
‘sāhasaṃ sandhāraṇaṃ kṣayo viṣamāśanam’ iti pāṭhe kāraṇena kāryaṃ caturvidhaḥ śoṣa ucyate

dvau jvarāvityādau śītasamutthatvenaivoṣṇābhiprāyatā labdhā, yato nidānaviparītamicchati jvarī; tadihoṣṇābhiprāyatāviśeṣaṇaṃ śītartusamutthatvena paittikasyāpi jvarasya śītasamutthatvanirāsārtham; evaṃ śītābhiprāyeapi vācyam
dvividhamāmamiti āmaviṣasya trividhakukṣīye vakṣyamāṇasyālasaka evāntarbhāvāt; anye tvāmaviṣasya viṣatvenānyaviṣatantraviṣayatvādihāgrahaṇamiti bruvate
atattvābhiniveśo mānaso vikāraḥ, sa ca sarvasaṃsāriduḥkhahetutayā gada ityucyate
doṣasya dūṣyeṇa raktādinā saṃsargo doṣadūṣyasaṃsargaḥ, prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam; tatra doṣadūṣyasaṃsarganirdeśena raktayonyādayaḥ, prakṛtinirdeśena prākcaraṇādayo yonivyāpatticikitsitaṃ vīkṣya vyākartavyāḥ
atra madā eva madātyayarūpatāṃ yāntīti kṛtvā madātyayāḥ pṛthaṅnoktāḥ

iha coktānāṃ rogāṇāṃ yadyapi prakārāntareṇānyathāapi saṅkhyā bhavati; tathā hi- aṣṭau jvarāḥ, dvāvunmādau nijāgantukabhedenetyādi, tathāapi pradhānavivakṣayā eta eva bhedā gṛhītāḥ; prādhānyaṃ ca svādhikāre rogāṇāmanusaraṇīyam

sampratyaṣṭodarādīnāṃ tathā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ mahāroge tathāanuktānāmiha tantre rogāṇāṃ nijānāṃ vātapittaśleṣmāṇa eva vyastāḥ samastā vā kāraṇaṃ bhavantītyetadrūpaṃ rogāṇāṃ cikitsopayogi sūtraṃ darśayitumāha- sarva ityādi
yadyapyāgantuṣvapi doṣasambandho na vyabhicarati, tathāapyāgantau roge doṣāpekṣayā na cikitsetyāgantuvyudāsārthaṃ nijā ityuktam
nanu, yadi vātādijanyā eva sarvavikārāstat kimarthamanyathāapyudarādayaḥ plīhajatvādibhirnirdiśyanta ityāha- vātapittetyādi
sthānaṃ rasādayo bastyādayaśca, saṃsthānam ākṛtirlakṣaṇamiti yāvat, prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam, eṣāṃ viśeṣānabhisamīkṣya tāṃstānupadiśantīti ‘aṣṭāvudarāṇi’ ityevammādyupadiśanti
tatra, sthānaviśeṣādupadeśo yathā- ūrustambharaktayonikāmalāprabhṛtayaḥ; saṃsthānaviśeṣāt piḍakāgulmaprabhṛtayaḥ; prakṛtiviśeṣācchleṣmaplīhodaraprabhṛtayaḥ
anye tu vyākhyānayanti- yatastāneveti vātādijāneveti vyapadiśanti; tadātmakānapīti yathoktāṣṭādisaṅkhyāyuktānapi
yadyapi plīhādikāraṇāntareṇa bhinnā api rogāstathāapi vātādisthānajanyatvena tathā vātādilakṣaṇayuktatvena tathā vātādikāraṇajātatvena vātādijā eva sarvavikārā iti vākyārthaḥ
svaśabdoagre vakṣyamāṇaśarīrāpekṣaḥ; tena śarīradhātuvaiṣamyaṃ gṛhyate, mānasaṃ tu pratikṣipyate
dhātavaśca na svarūpeṇa rogakāraṇamiti vaiṣamyapadaṃ kṛtam

āgantavo hi rogā abhighātajvarādayo dhātuvaiṣamyajā bhavanti, atastahyudāsārthaṃ nimittapadam; āgantuṣu vaiṣamyaṃ vidyamānamapi kāraṇatvena na vyapadiśyate, apradhānatvāt; kintvāgantureva laguḍādiprahārastatra cikitsāviśeṣaprayojakaḥ kāraṇaṃ, nije tu vaiṣamyameva cikitsāprayojakam
nimittajā iti ca svadhātuvaiṣamyapadasya karmadhārayatvena, bahuvrīhipakṣe tvanarthakameva syāt
bahuvacanenaiva bahutve labdhe punaḥ ‘bahavaḥ’ iti vacanaṃ bahuvacanasya tritvamātreṇaiva caritārthatvaniṣedhārtham
na te pittakaphānilebhyaḥ pṛthagiti pittakaphānilā eva te dūṣyādiviśeṣabhāja ityarthaḥ
iha pittamādau kṛtaṃ chandoanurodhāt; kiṃvā prādhānyāniyamajñāpanārthaṃ kṛtam
atra ca dhātuvaiṣamyamātraṃ vikāro noktaḥ, tasya vātādivaiṣamyarūpatvena siddhatvādeva; yastu dhātuvaiṣamyaviśeṣo dhātuvaiṣamyajāto jvarādirūpaḥ, sa iha śiṣyaṃ prati vikṛtavātādyabhedena pratipādyate

nijaṃ prathamasamutpannaṃ vikāramāganturbhūtādijanyo vikāraḥ anveti anugato bhavati, yathā- doṣaja eva jvare unmāde vā paścādbhūtaniveśoapi bhavati; tathāaagantumutpannamabhighātajaṃ jvaraṃ bhūtajaṃ conmādaṃ paścāddhetumāsādya nijoapi tatra doṣalakṣaṇalakṣito gado bhavati
‘api pravṛddhaḥ’ iti vacanena āgantvavasthāyāmapi nijadoṣo vṛddhoastyeva, paraṃ pravṛddhoasau na bhavati svalakṣaṇākartṛtveneti darśayati
samyagjñātveti balavattvābalavattvādinā; kiṃvā, anubandhaḥ apradhānaḥ; prakṛtiḥ anubandhyaḥ pradhānamityarthaḥ
yaduktaṃ- “svatantro vyaktaliṅgo yathoktasamutthānapraśamo bhavatyanubandhyaḥ, ato viparītastvanubandhaḥ” (vi.
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rogacatuṣkeaṣṭodarīyo nāmonaviṃśoadhyāyaḥ
pūrvaṃ sāmānyena vātādijanyā gadā uktāḥ, sampratyavaśiṣṭān kevalavātādijanyānabhidhātuṃ mahārogādhyādhyoabhidhīyate
manaḥśarīraviśeṣāditi āgantorapi manaḥ śarīraṃ cādhiṣṭhānam, evaṃ nijasyāpi; āgantugrahaṇena ca mānasoapi kāmādirgṛhyate
evaṃ caturvidhatvādi pratipādya punaḥ prakārāntareṇāparisaṅkhyeyatāṃ rogāṇāmāha- vikārā ityādi
prakṛtiḥ pratyāsannaṃ kāraṇaṃ vātādi, adhiṣṭhānaṃ dūṣyaṃ, liṅgāni lakṣaṇāni, āyatanāni bāhyahetavo duṣṭāhārācārāḥ; eṣāṃ vikalparūpo viśeṣo vikalpaviśeṣaḥ, teṣāmaparisaṅkhyeyatvāditi

atra doṣāḥ saṃsargāṃśāṃśavikalpādibhirasaṅkhyeyāḥ, dūṣyāstu śarīrāvayavā aṇuśaḥ parasparamelakena vibhajyamānā asaṅkhyeyāḥ, liṅgāni kṛtsnavikāragatānyasaṅkhyeyānyeva, āviṣkṛtāni tu tantre kathitāni, hetavaścāvāntaraviśeṣādasaṅkhyeyāḥ pravyaktā eva
kecit punaḥ ‘eṣāṃ vikārāḥ’ iti paṭhanti, sa tu pāṭho nānumatastāvat; yadi ca syāttadā dehamanaḥpratyavamarśakam eṣām iti padaṃ, bahuvacanaṃ tu manaḥśarīrayorbahutvavivakṣayā
na sandehamāpadyanta iti na sandehaviṣayatāmāpadyante; miśrībhūtā api pratisvaṃ bhinnairlakṣaṇairbhedena jñāyanta ityarthaḥ

āganturutpannaḥ san, vyathāpūrvamiti pīḍāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā, paścāddoṣāṇāṃ vaiṣamyamiti doṣavaiṣamyalakṣaṇamuktaṃ; svalakṣaṇakārakaṃ tu vaiṣamyamāgantorāditaḥprabhṛti vidyamānamapyakiñcitkaramiti bhāvaḥ
āgantunijayorbhedakaṃ lakṣaṇamabhidhāya nijavikārakarāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ bhedajñānārthamāha- teṣāmityādi
yadyapi prāṇādibhedabhinnasya vāyoḥ pṛthageva sthānāni vakṣyati; yathā- “sthānaṃ prāṇasya śīrṣoraḥkaṇṭhajihvāsyanāsikāḥ” (ci.
28) ityādi; tathāapīdaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ sthānaṃ jñeyaṃ, yatoatra prāyo vātavikārā bhavanti, bhūtāśca durjayāḥ; atra ca vijite vāte sarvavātavikārāvajaya iti
pittasthāneṣu āmāśaya iti āmāśayādhobhāgāḥ, śleṣmasthāneṣvāmāśaya āmāśayordhvabhāgaḥ
sāmānyajā iti vātādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ militaiśca ye janyante
evaṃ ca na gṛdhrasyādīnāṃ sāmānyajatvaṃ, yathoktāṃśasya kevalavātajanyatvāt

ekāṅgarogaḥ sarvāṅgarogaśceti jvarādiṣu uṣṇatvaśītatvādīnāṃ kadācidekāṅgavyāpakatvenaikāṅgarogaḥ, teṣāmeva kadācit sarvāṅgavyāpakatvena sarvāṅgarogaḥ; doṣāntarasambandheapi vyāptyavyāptī vātakṛte eva, “vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra varṣanti meghavat” iti vacanāt
atra kasyacidaṅgasya pādādeḥ śūlādayoabhihitā na hastādīnāṃ; tatra yeabhihitāste pradhānabhūtāḥ prāyobhāvitvena, anuktāstu vātavikārāṇāmaparisaṅkhyeyatvena grāhyāḥ

atrāpyapariṇāmīti sambadhyate; apariṇāmīti pittaśleṣmasambandhanirapekṣaṃ, na tu śarīrāvayavānapekṣamiti; yataḥ brūte- taṃ taṃ śarīrāvayavamāviśataḥ iti; ata eva ca sraṃsādīnāṃ śarīrāvayavāpekṣatvena na sarvadā bhāvaḥ
tvagavadaraṇaṃ bāhyatvaṅmātrāvadaraṇaṃ; carmāvadaraṇaṃ tu ṣaṇṇāmapi tvacāṃ daraṇam
balāsakaḥ balakṣayaḥ; kiṃvā śleṣmodrekānmandajvaritvaṃ, sthūlāṅgatā vā balāsakaḥ
atrāmāśayamanupraviśyeti vacanena śleṣmasthāneṣvāmāśayasya prādhānyaṃ, pūrvaṃ tu ‘tatrāpi uro viśeṣeṇa’ iti vacanenoraḥ pradhānam; evamubhayamapi tulyaṃ jñeyam
auṣadhaparīkṣā rogāpekṣiṇī, tena tadanantarameva sā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
vikārāśca mukhaṃ ca vikāramukhaṃ, tatra ‘vikārāḥ punaḥ’ ityādinā vikārāḥ, ‘mukhāni’ ityādinā mukham
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyavyākhyāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ sūtrasthāne rogacatuṣke mahārogādhyāyo viṃśatitamaḥ
