kīṭāśca yadyapi suśrute vātapittakaphasannipātakopanāḥ kumbhīnasādayaḥ saptaṣaṣṭiḥ pratipāditāḥ, tathāapīha sañjñeyābhidhitsayā dūṣīviṣaprāṇaharabhedenaivocyante; evaṃ lūtādiṣvapi sañjñeyabhedāddvaividhyoktirjñeyā
saha ugragandhyasṛjā vartata iti sogragandhyasṛk sogragandhi lohitam

lūtāścānyatrāṣṭau sādhyā asādhyāścāṣṭau trimaṇḍalāsauvarṇikādaya uktāstāsāṃ tathā mūṣikakṛkaṇṭakavṛścikocciṭiṅgamaṇḍūkamatsyajalaukāśatapadīmaśakamakṣikāṇāṃ suśrutādiṣu prapañcārthibhiḥ prapañcoanusaraṇīyaḥ; iha tu tantrakāreṇa parādhikāratvāt prapañco na kriyate
kaṇabhaśca kīṭaviśeṣa iti suśrute kīṭamadhye eva paṭhitaḥ
ekadaṃṣṭrārpita iti ekayaiva daṃṣṭrayā kṛta ityarthaḥ
jalaukasaśca ṣaṭ saviṣāḥ kṛṣṇākarburādaya uktāḥ sandaṃśaviṣāḥ
uktaṃ hi suśrute “pārvatīyastu kīṭaiḥ prāṇaharai stulyalakṣaṇaḥ” (su.ka.a.8) iti
sthagikāasuhṛditi kāntārikādiṣu suśrutoktaṣaṇamakṣikāsu sthagikākhyā makṣikā prāṇaharītyarthaḥ
uktaṃ hi tantrāntare- “dṛṣṭiśvāsādibhirdivyāḥ sarpā āśīviṣāḥ, āśughātitvāt” iti
prakṛtikālau tulyau viṣasya, yathā- prabalapittaprakṛtiruṣṇaśca kāla iti jñeyam
vārītyādau vṛddhā iti gonasavarjaṃ jñeyāḥ, gonasya tu vārdhakye eva vṛddhaviṣatvaṃ prāguktam
sarvadehāśritaṃ krodhāditi sarvadehāśritamapi daṃṣṭrāsveva viṣaṃ viśeṣeṇa jñeyaṃ; yathā- śukraṃ sarvaśarīragamapi vṛṣaṇayoreva viśeṣeṇāvatiṣṭhati
yatraiva ca śunastridoṣakopo bhavati daivādalarkagrahāveśāt tatraiva saviṣaśirobhitāpitvādi bhavatīti jñeyam
kecittu śirobhitāpādi yathoktaṃ kukkure tathā taddaṣṭe ca bhavatīti vadanti
anyeapyevaṃvidhā iti anyeapi śṛgālatarakṣvādaya evaṃvidhāḥ santaḥ kṛcchraśirorogādikarā bhavantītyarthaḥ
pūrvoktamityatra vakṣyamāṇacikitsitaṃ pūrvoktavidhāvapi avasthāviśeṣavidheyatayā kartavyamityarthaḥ; yadā ‘pūrvoktā’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tadā upakramā ityasya viśeṣaṇametat
ūrdhvaṃ daṣṭasya pādayorityatrāpi kṣatayoreva pādayorviṣasaṅkramaṇārthaṃ māṃsāsṛgdānaṃ jñeyam
śvetā ceti girikarṇikāviśeṣaṇaṃ, tena śvetāaparājitā gṛhyate
karṇikāpatanaṃ tayoriti anantaroktakīṭalūtādaṃśayoryā karṇikā tasyāḥ pātanamityarthaḥ
vārścike ityādi ucciṭiṅgasya viṣe vārścike yo yoga uktaḥ sa kartavyaḥ
evaṃ kaṇabhasyāpi viṣe aundure yo yoga uktaḥ sa kartavyaḥ

śreṣṭhaḥ pañcaśirīṣoayamiti padaṃ triśirīṣādyapekṣayā pañcaśirīṣasya śreṣṭhatvaṃ brūte, pravara iti padaṃ viṣaharayogāntareṣu śreṣṭhatāmāha, tena na punaruktiḥ; kiṃvā śreṣṭha iti śreṣṭhaśirīṣaphalādikṛtaḥ
viṣaśaṅkayā viṣodvegāditi viṣaśaṅkayaiva viṣaprādurbhāvādityarthaḥ; śaṅkā ceyaṃ prabhāvādeva viṣajanikā
sūkṣmamityādau amṛtatāmracūrṇaṃ māṣamānaṃ yāvaddeyam, amṛtenaiva vamanaṃ bhavati
hemapa iti hema yaḥ pibatīti sa hemapaḥ
ayaṃ yogo jatukarṇe paṭhyate- “nāgadantīsnukkṣīraphalairgomūtrasiddhaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāyayet” iti
chatrītyādau chatrī divā, rātrau jharjharapāṇiścarediti vadanti; anye tūbhayatrāpyubhayaṃ bruvate
varauṣadhya iti tantrāntaroktāḥ akṣīvajātapippalājaruhākāyoṣī (?) prabhṛtayaḥ; uktaṃ ca- “akṣīvajātasya pippalasya maṇiḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ” ityādi
vrajedviṣāṇāmaviṣahyatāmiti viṣāṇi taṃ soḍhuṃ na pārayantīti bhāvaḥ
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne viṣacikitsitaṃ nāma trayoviṃśoadhyāyaḥ
mohajanakatvasāmānyāt tathā viṣasamānaguṇajanyatvācca viṣacikitsitamanu madātyayasya cikitsitamucyate
surairityādinā madirāstutyā tathā vakṣyamāṇanindayā vidhinā pīyamānasurāyāḥ śubhaphalamavidhipānāccātyarthaninditaphalavattvaṃ darśayati
yā purā paripūjitetyanena prathamaṃ devaireveyaṃ paripūjitā, tataḥ surayogāt sureti copadiṣṭeti darśayati
sautrāmaṇiḥ surāhaviryajñāntarniviṣṭo yajñaviśeṣaḥ; tasyāṃ hūyate surā
karmibhiryā pratiṣṭhiteti yājñikairabhiṣavaṇādibhiḥ pratiṣṭhitā pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpitā
yajñaṃ vahatīti yajñauhī; anena ca laukikayajñāntarāṇyapi surayā kriyanta ityucyate; sautrāmaṇihome tu tasyā eva pradhānāṅgatocyate
śakraśca somātipatita iti ‘śakroatipītena somena kṣapitabalo nirojasko nirvīryībhūtaḥ sa kila punarāpyāyya nijaṃ vīryamāpāditaḥ’ ityeṣā śrutiḥ; atipānena patitaḥ atipatitaḥ

yajñīyā yajñasiddhaya iti yajñavidhau kānicit kratvarthāni yūpabarhyādīni, kānicittu puruṣārthāni vāsagarbhādīni, kānicid yajñārthāni puruṣārthāni ca yathā sarpiriṣṭakādīni, tadiha surā ‘yajñīyā’ ityanena vāsanādivat ‘puruṣārthā’ ityucyate, yajñasiddhaye bhavatītyanena yūpādivad yajñārthatvaṃ surāyā ucyate
yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ, tadviśeṣāḥ- dhānyaphalamūlasārapuṣpapatrakāṇḍatvacaḥ śarkarānavamāḥ sūtrasthānoktāḥ
mado lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasmānmadalakṣaṇāt sāmānyāt madyasvarūpāt
amṛtaṃ bhūtvetyādau surādhiṣṭhātrī devatā amṛtādirūpeṇa devādīn tarpayatīti darśayati
āśvinaṃ yā mahatteja ityādāvapi surādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāyā eva tejovīryādikāraṇatvāttādrūpyaṃ jñeyam
tejaḥ sarvadevatādigaṃ, tathā sārasvataṃ balaṃ mantrabalam
somaḥ sautrāmaṇau ca yetyanena somarūpatocyate, pūrvaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ hūyata ityuktamiti na paunaruktyam
yā prītirityādau prītyādikāraṇatvena prītyādirūpatayā nirdeśo jñeyaḥ
śarīre snānavasrādibhirbāhya ābhyantaraśca prakṛtyādyapekṣayā snigdhoṣṇānnādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ saṃskāro yena sa śarīrakṛtasaṃskāraḥ
kaphapittādhikebhya ityādau viparyayatantrayuktyā kaphādhikebhyo mādhavaṃ, pittādhikebhyastu mārdvīkaṃ; mārdvīkaṃ mṛdvīkākṛtaṃ, madhukṛtaṃ tu mādhavam

yasmādevaṃ svabhāvaṃ tasmādguṇadoṣe ca taṃ madyamapekṣete; kiñcit puruṣamapekṣya yaugikatvādguṇakaraṃ, kiñcittvayaugikatvāddoṣakaraṃ; yathā- prathame made guṇakaraṃ, doṣakaraṃ ca dvitīyamade iti bhāvaḥ
kāle iti yasya madyasya ya ucito viparītaguṇaḥ kālastasmin
madyaṃ yathā madayati tathā prāha- madyamityādi
daśabhiriti laghvādibhirguṇaiḥ, daśāpi gurvādīnojoguṇān saṅkṣobhya, na dvitrādikaiḥ, ceto vikriyāṃ nayati vikṛtaṃ karoti
yena guṇena madyasya ojoguṇakṣobho bhavati tadāha- gurutvaṃ lāghavādityādi

prasādaṃ cāśubhāvanāditi prasādākhyaguṇamāśugatvāddhanti; āśugatvaṃ ca yadyapi prasādaviruddhaṃ na bhavati, tathāapi madyameva pratikūlatayā ojaḥprasādaṃ hanti, tatrāśuguṇa āhanane vyāpriyata iti jñeyam
vyavāyitvāt sthiratvamiti vyavāyitvaṃ vyāpakatvaṃ, tacca sthiratvaṃ tadviparītatvādeva hanti; āśugatvavyavāyitvayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ- yadāśugaṃ śīghraṃ gacchati, vyavāyi tu sarvavyāpakam
vikāsitvaṃ vikasanaśīlatvaṃ saratvamiti yāvat; tacca ślakṣṇaviparītatvādeva ślakṣṇatāṃ hanti
ete vikāsitvāśugatvādayo guṇā yadyapi viṃśatiguṇagaṇanāyāṃ na paṭhitāstathāapyasaṅkhyeyatvādguṇānāmeṣāmapi guṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ; ye tu tatra paṭhitāste tāvadāviṣkṛtatamā jñeyāḥ
sattvasya ca oja āśrayaḥ, oja upakāryam; yathā- rājāśritaḥ puruṣaḥ
rasavātādivahānāṃ daśadhamanīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ, rasavahā eva yā daśa dhamanyo hṛdayāśrayā uktāstā eva vātādivahāḥ

yaduktaṃ “vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ sarvaśarīracarāṇāṃ sarvāṇi srotāṃsyayanabhūtāni” (vi.a.5) iti; raktādīnāṃ tu sarvaśarīracarāṇāmapi viśeṣeṇa hṛdayaṃ sthānamuktaṃ- “ṣaḍaṅgamaṅgaṃ vijñānamindriyāṇyarthapañcakam
ātmā ca saguṇaścetaścintyaṃ ca hṛdi saṃśritam” (sū.a.30) iti
madyaṃ ceto vikriyāṃ nayatītyutsargavidheḥ prathamamadeapavādamāha- ojasyavihate ityādi
hṛdayāśritabuddhyādau pratibodhite, hṛdayaśabdeneha tatsthopacārāddhṛdayāśritā buddhyādayoabhidhīyante, yathā- mañcāḥ krośantīti; buddhyādibodhanaṃ prathamamadakāryaṃ madyasya prabhāvāt
vihate iti vighāte; ojasaḥ alpe vighāte madhyamo mado bhavati
vihate iti viśeṣeṇa atyarthaṃ hate, uttama iti tṛtīyaḥ
yathāsattvamiti prakṛtyā rājase sattve rājasāḥ, tāmase ca tāmasāḥ
viṣayeṣviti viṣayasevāsu, na cākṣama iti nākṣamatākara ityarthaḥ
yojanā saviparyayeti sthānādīnāṃ samyagyojanā kadācidbhavati, kadācicca sthānādiyojanāviparyayoasamyagyojanārūpo bhavatītyarthaḥ

yadyapi trividho mada uktaḥ, tathāapi dvitīyamadāvasāne tṛtīyamadāprāptyavasthāyā eva atyarthanindyatāṃ darśayan tṛtīyamadasyātyantanindyatāṃ darśayati; yena tasya tṛtīyamadasya pūrvarūpāvasthaiva sarvāśubhakaraṇādihetutayā nitāntaṃ nindyeti bhāvaḥ

iyaṃ ca madhyamadātikramatṛtīyamadāprāptiśabdābhidheyāapyavasthā madhyamamadāntatṛtīyamadādyarūpāvasthābhidhāyikaiva; yathā- “kumbhamīnayormadhye yadā carati candramā” ityatra madhyepadena kumbhāntamīnādirevocyate, paramārthatastayormadhyasyābhāvāt; tathehāpi paramārthatoanyamadakālābhāvād dvitīyāntatṛtīyamadādyabhidhānamevātra tṛtīyamadātyarthanindārthaṃ, na caturthamadopadarśanam
ete doṣāḥ madyasyaikīyamatoktā ahitādidharmayuktasyaiva bhavanti, na hitālpamātravidhipītasyeti bhāvaḥ
madyasyānnasārūpyadarśanena vidhivadupayoge guṇavattāmavidhyupayoge ca doṣavattāmāha- kintvityādi
yuktyā deśakālamātrādyapekṣayā yojanayā yuktaṃ śubham, aśubhaṃ cāyuktiyuktam
yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanamiti yathā “viṣasya tu tilaṃ dadyāt” (ci.a.1) ityādiprayoge tilamānasya rasāyanatvaṃ, tathā jñeyam
āśviti vacanena śīghraṃ harṣādīni karoti na pariṇāmaṃ yāvadapekṣate
anye tu ‘madasukhapradam’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi madasukhaṃ prathamamadārambha eva

svāpanaṃ naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ tathā bodhanaṃ cātinidrāṇāmiti kāryadvayakaraṇamucitanidrākaratvaprabhāvādeva; kiṃvā naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ nidrābhighātahetvaticintanādivismārakatayā nidrākaraṃ bhavati, atinidrāṇāṃ nidrāhetumanovahasrotorodhādihantṛtayā prabodhakaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam
madyotthānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ madyameva prabādhakamiti hetuviparītārthakāritāprabhāvādityarthaḥ

viṣayasaṃyoge prītisaṃyogavardhanamiti viṣayāṇāṃ śabdādīnāṃ saṃyoge prītiṃ saṃyogaṃ ca vardhayati; pītamadyo yadā viṣayaiḥ śabdādibhiḥ saṃyujyate tadā teṣvapi prītimān bhavati, prītaśca sukhākāṅkṣī san punasteṣu saṃyujyate
utsavaḥ autsukyaṃ viṣayābhilāṣa iti yāvat, āmodo harṣaḥ
nanu viṣaye svabhāvādeva prītirbhavati, tat kiṃ madyena kriyate? ityāśaṅkya prathamamadasya viśiṣṭaratikartṛtvamāha- pañcasvityādi

tatrānnaṃ trividhaṃ vātapittakaphakaram, evaṃ pānamapi trividhaṃ, bālyādibhedādvayoapi trividhaṃ, vyādhirapi mṛdumadhyatīvrabhedena trividhaḥ, kiṃvā saumyāgneyavāyavyabhedena trividhaḥ, balaṃ pravarāvaramadhyabhedāttrividhaṃ, kālastu śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇastrividhaḥ, trividhaṃ sattvaṃ śuddhaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ ca
tatrānnāpekṣayā yuktiryathā- vātakaramannamupayujya vātaharaṃ madyaṃ peyam, evaṃ pittakarakaphakaratveapi pittakaphaharānnopayogaḥ
vayastrikeapi bālye sthavire ca tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ na peyaṃ, yauvane tu tīkṣṇamapīti
vyādhyapekṣayāapi yojanā yathā- mṛduvyādhau tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ, uṣṇe ca śītamadhuraṃ, varṣākāle tu snigdhaṃ dīpanaṃ ca madyam
doṣabhedena tu madyaṃ vāte snigdhoṣṇaṃ gauḍikādi, pitte śītamadhuraṃ śārkarādi, kaphe rūkṣatīkṣṇaṃ mādhavādi
uktaṃ hi- “vātikebhyo hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyo gauḍikapaiṣṭikam
sattvabhedenāpi sāttvikena tu bahvapi madyaṃ pātavyaṃ, rājasatāmasaistu svalpameva
avyaktatām īṣadvyaktatāṃ, madhye cāvyaktatāṃ yāntītyarthaḥ, uttame tu sarvathāapyavyaktaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
tatra hemaprakṛtidarśako hutāśo yathā suvarṇasya śuddhāśuddhatāṃ darśayati, tathā madyaṃ tūbhayakārakamiti manaḥprabodhakaṃ manoguṇadarśakaṃ ca
śobhano gandho yasya tat sugandhi, gandharvaḥ gānam
na cottamamadapradamiti nottamamadakaraṃ, kadācidapi madyapānāttṛtīyamadāśaṅkā na bhavati; uttamamadaḥ sāttvike na bhavatītyarthaḥ
sattvasaṃyogāditi sattvākhyaguṇayogāt; sattvākhyo hi guṇaḥ prakāśakatayā na madena mohakenābhibhūyata iti bhāvaḥ
sammohaḥ krodho nidrā ca ante yasya tat sammohakrodhanidrāntam
yairityanena rājasatāmasāḥ pratyavamṛśyante, taiḥ samaṃ piban tatprasaktyā svayamapyatipiban madyadoṣān dvitīyatṛtīyamadadoṣān prāpnoti
āpānaṃ vardhayantīti āpāne prasādaṃ vardhayanti na pānaprasaktiṃ vardhayantītyarthaḥ, tasyā ninditatvāt
madyapānvayā iti madyapavaṃśajāḥ, teṣāṃ madyapānaṃ madyasātmyatvādeva na vikārakaraṃ bhavati, viṣakanyāyā viṣamiva
vātaprāyamityādau prāyaḥśabdenādhikavācinā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ sarvamadātyayānāṃ tridoṣajanyatvaṃ darśayati
sa tu vātetyādau sa tviti paittikaḥ; vātolbaṇasya paitto madātyayo vātapittasaṃyogakṛtatayā bāhya ivāgnirvāyuyuktaḥ śīghrakārī bhavati
tatreyaṃ vyavasthā- yatra sadyaḥphalā kriyā tatra śīghrameva śāmyati, akriyāyāṃ ca śīghraṃ hanti, śaṅkhakarohiṇyādivat
yadyapi madyamamlaṃ, viṣaṃ tvavyaktamadhuraṃ, tathāapi bahuguṇasāmānyāt ta eva madye dṛśyanta ityuktam
śarīraduḥkhamityādinā sarvamadātyayasya sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūte, kiṃvā tridoṣamadātyayasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ; yato rogasaṅgrahe vātapittakaphasannipātaiścatvāro madā uktāḥ
sarva ete madā narte vātapittakaphatrayāt” (sū.a.24) ityanena madasya vātādijatvena cāturvidhyamuktam
tena madātyayasya cāturvidhyaṃ madacāturvidhyāt; yato mada eva ātyayiko madātyaya iti nirucyate
kaphasthānānupūrvyā cātra cikitsā kaphasthānodbhūtatayā prathamaṃ kaphasambandhāt sannipātajvara iva jñeyā
ādau kaphaprabalatāmevāha- pittamārutaparyanta iti; anena cārthāt kaphāditvaṃ lambhayati
samapītena tenaiveti yajjātīyena madyena madātyayo janitaḥ nitarāṃ tajjātīyenaiva śāmyati
yathā viṣaṃ maulaṃ daṃṣṭrīyeṇa śāmyati, tathā madyamapi vijātīyena madyena śāmyatītyeke; kintu tenaivetyanena tāmeva madyajātiṃ pratyavamṛśati, tenāvaśyaṃ tajjātīyameva madyaṃ jñeyam
yatoanantaraṃ vakṣyati- ‘yacca yasmai hitaṃ bhavet’ iti

tathā ‘dadyāt salavaṇaṃ madyaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ vātaśāntaye’ ityanena yena kenacinmadyenodbhūte vātamadātyaye paiṣṭikamuktaṃ, tathā ‘saśarkaraṃ śārkaraṃ vā’ ityādi viśeṣavidhānaṃ bahu kariṣyati; tena tajjātīyamanyajātīyaṃ ca madyaṃ madātyaye deyam
kṣāramādhuryāya yadāamlamadyadānaṃ, tadā kimiti anyadamlaṃ na dīyate ityāha- kṣāro hītyādi
madodayā iti madanimittāstarṣādayaḥ; kecittu ‘jvarādayaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra jvarapradhānāstarṣādaya ityartha unneyaḥ
tittiriḥ pratibhojanaṃ paścājjīrṇe bhojanaṃ yasmin rase taṃ tittiripratibhojanam
anutarṣaṃ ca pāyayediti bhojanasamaye tṛṣāṃ lakṣīkṛtya pāyayet; anupānaṃ dāpayediti yāvat
yayāasya mano na dūṣyata iti na vikṛtiṃ yāti; etena tṛṣāyāṃ manodainyamātrahantṛ yanmadyaṃ bhavati tadanutarṣasañjñaṃ bhavati, natu madaparyantaṃ madyaṃ deyamityarthaḥ
badarītyādau badaryādipatrāṇi mathitvā tajjaḥ pheno grāhyaḥ
śvetāmiti mṛdvīkāṃ, śvetā ca drākṣā kāśmīrabhavā jñeyā
saṅkocoṣṇasukhāṅgīnāṃ saṅkocena saṃśleṣeṇa uṣṇasukhamaṅgaṃ yāsāṃ tāsāṃ; kecittu saṅkocaṃ kuṅkumamāhuḥ

yadyapi trayodaśavidhaḥ sannipāto vṛddhadoṣāṇāmuktastathāapi sarvamadātyayānāṃ tridoṣajatvād yadetadvātādimadātyayacikitsitamuktaṃ tadekadoṣolbaṇasannipātajamadātyayacikitsitaṃ bhavati, tena dvyulbaṇahīnamadhyādhikabhedasamasannipātairye daśāvaśiṣṭāḥ sannipātāstānabhipretyedamuktaṃ- sannipāte daśavidhe tadvikalpyamiti; hīnamadhyādhikadoṣatrayodbhūtamadātyayeṣu hīnamadhyādhikadoṣabhedena vikalpya cikitsā kartavyā; samasannipāte tu trayāṇāmapi militvā cikitsā kartavyā
kasmāt punarmadātyaye praharṣiṇī cikitsā kāryetyāha- nākṣobhyetyādi
manaḥprītyā śarīrapraśamārthaṃ praharṣaṇī kriyā kartavyeti bhāvaḥ
tatra kāryakṣīravṛttikramaṃ punarmadyābhyāsakramaṃ cāha- payasāabhihṛte ityādi
tasya pānātyayoddiṣṭā vikārāḥ sambhavanti hi” iti granthena dhvaṃsakavikṣayāvarodhaṃ varṇayanti
śārīramānasairvikārairiti yogyatayā madyavyāpattijanyaireva śārīramānasairvikāraiḥ; anyahetujāñ śārīramānasavikārān prati madyanivṛttirakiñcitkarīti bhāvaḥ
na yujyata iti śārīramānasavikārairmadyanivṛttyā na yukto bhavati
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne madātyayacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśoadhyāyaḥ
madyamattasya samprahārādinā vraṇotpattau vraṇacikitsārthaṃ dvivraṇīya ucyate
paraḥ mokṣaḥ, avaraṃ dravyādi, tajjānātīti parāvarajñaḥ
tayorliṅgaṃ cikitsāṃ cetyatra hetorapi vyādhigamakatayā liṅgenaiva grahaṇam
doṣā yadyapi śārīrā eva, tathāapīha śārīrapadaṃ snāyukledādiṣvapīha prayuktadoṣavyudāsārtham

nijaiḥ samamāgantavo vraṇā viparītā mantrādibhirbheṣajaiśca, tathā hetubhiśca vadhabandhanādibhiḥ, tathā liṅgaikadeśaiśca; sa ca liṅgaikadeśo yathā- āganturvyathāpūrvamudeti paścādvātādīn kopayati, nije tu pūrvaṃ vātādayaḥ prakupyanti paścādvyathotpadyate
āgantuvraṇasya bhinnaviṣayatayā vistara iha na vaktavyaḥ; tena tasya cikitsāmapi samāsādevāha- vraṇānāmityādi
āgantūnāṃ vraṇānāṃ nijahetūnāṃ satāṃ mantrādicikitsayā aśāmyatāṃ nijānāṃ yathauṣadhaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ tathaiva doṣabalāvekṣī san kuryāditi yojanā
āgantūnāṃ cehāgantucikitsayāapraśamanaṃ nijadoṣānubandhādeva jñeyam; ata eveha nijahetūnāmiti kṛtam

atra yathāsvairhetubhiriti vacanena vātādīnāṃ svātantryeṇa prakopaṃ darśayati, svahetuduṣṭo hi doṣaḥ svatantro bhavati; kiñca yathāsvairhetubhiriti vacanena ya eva vātādikopahetavasta evātra nijavraṇakārakā bhavanti, na punarvraṇānāṃ viśiṣṭo heturasti; sāmānyavātādihetostu viśiṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇakāryotpattiḥ samprāptibhedādbhavatīti jñeyam
stabdha ityādinā vātādivraṇānāṃ lakṣaṇāni tathā cikitsāsūtraṃ cāha
ete ca vraṇabhedādayoagre kṛtyotkṛtya ityādinā vyākriyante
tatra kṛtyaḥ chedanādyupakramopakramaṇīyaḥ, utkṛtyasya tu nātra kiñcitkaraṇīyamasti paraṃ ropaṇīya eva; kiṃvā kṛtyaḥ sādhyaḥ, akṛtyastvasādhyaḥ
kṛtyādayaḥ ṣaṭ saviparyayā evoktāḥ, saṃvṛtādayastu saptoddiṣṭāḥ saviparyayāḥ santaścaturdaśa

suśrute tu “tatrātisaṃvṛtoativivṛttaḥ” (su.sū.a.22) ityādinā yadduṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tadatisaṃvṛtādiviṣayam, iha tu saṃvṛtatvavivṛtatvamātramucyate, teneha duṣṭavraṇena saṃvṛtasya grahaṇamudbhāvanīyam
agniśca yadyapi “agniṃ jaraṇaśaktyā” (vi.a.4) iti vacanādanumānaviṣaya uktastathāapi praśnenāgniravagamyata eveti kṛtveha vacanaparīkṣaṇīyataivoktā vahneḥ

anumānaṃ ca yadyapi parīkṣādhikāre proktaṃ “dvividhā parīkṣā jñānavatāṃ pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca” (vi.a.4) ityādinā, tathāapyatrānumānasya prāyo vyāpārābhāvādanupādānamiti brūte; kintu darśanādipūrvakatvādanumānasya darśanādinā anumānamapyatīndriyādiṣu grāhakaṃ saṅgṛhītamiti yuktaṃ paśyāmaḥ
darśanaśabdaścātra sākṣādupalabdhivacanaḥ, tena vraṇagatagandhenāpi vraṇaparīkṣaṇaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati
darśanaśabdena ca gṛhītoapi sparśa iha bhūyasā vyāpriyamāṇatvāt punaruktaḥ
ropyalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntarādavagantavyaṃ, tathāhi bhojaḥ- “rūḍhā rūḍhāḥ prakupyanti sāntardoṣāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
bahiḥ śuddhā ivābhānti ropyāste samprakīrtitāḥ” iti
eteṣāmeva śvetādīnāṃ bhedakāraṇāntarabhedena caturviṃśatitvaṃ bhavatīti darśayannāha- caturviṃśatirityādi
śyāvagandhaṃ dadhyādestāmraghṛṣṭasamānaṃ gandhamāhuḥ; kecittu ‘śāvaṃ’ iti paṭhanti; śavasya gandhaḥ śāvaḥ
asādhyo nirupakrama iti asādhyatvamabhidhāyāpi nirupakramatābhidhānena sopakramasādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ niṣedhayati
avasaraprāptāyāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupakramarūpāyāṃ cikitsāyāṃ vaktavyāyāṃ saṃśodhanasya prādhānyopadarśanārthaṃ pṛthagagreabhidhānaṃ- vraṇānāmityādinā
ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarmeti pāṭanādi; atraivāharaṇameṣaṇaṃ ca śalyatantroktamadhikaṃ karmadvayamantarbhāvanīyaṃ; kiṃveṣaṇaṃ śastrakarmāṅgaṃ na śastrakarma, tattu pṛthageva
śodhanau ropaṇīyau ca kaṣāyau sapralepanau iti śodhanaropaṇakaṣāyau tathā śodhanaropaṇālepau

dve taile tadguṇe ityatra ghṛtasyāpi snehatvasāmānyāt tailenaiva grahaṇaṃ; tena yadyapi catvāri tailaghṛtāni pratyekaśodhanaropaṇabhedādvakṣyati, tathāapi śodhanaropaṇakarmadvayakartṛtayā dvitvamevātra tailaghṛtayorgaṇanīyam
patraṃ chādane iti patrameka upakramaḥ, chādanaṃ tu dvividhaṃ bāhyāntarabhedena vakṣyamāṇam
kāṭhinyamārdavakare dhūpanālepane iti kāṭhinyakaraṃ dhūpanaṃ, mārdavakaraṃ dhūpanaṃ ceti; evamālepanamapi dvividhaṃ jñeyam
evaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupakramā bhavanti; śalyatantre tu ṣaṣṭirupakramā uktāsteapyatraivāntarbhāvanīyāḥ
kṛcchrasyeti asukumārasya, śastraṃ paraṃ bhedanamiti sambandhaḥ
pāṭanamityādinā prokte ṣaḍvidhaśastrakarmaṇi tisraiṣaṇīyoktādhikadāraṇādiśastrakarmāvarodho boddhavyaḥ, tena na virodhaḥ
tathā ye ca raktajā iti raktagulmāḥ
vraṇapīḍane iti vraṇapīḍanaśca lepo niḥsneho vraṇamukhaṃ varjayitvā kartavyaḥ
samena samamaṅgena kṛtveti samenāvikṛtenānyenāṅgena samaṃ sadṛśaṃ kṛtvā sandadhīteti yojyam
atra balādīni piṣṭāni śarkarākṣīramadhūcchiṣṭatailādibhiḥ samairutkarikāṃ kṛtvā svedaḥ kartavyaḥ; anye tu balādikalkena tailādisnehaṃ caturguṇe kṣīre sādhayitvā snehapādikaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaprakṣepamāhuḥ
dvipañcamūlakvathiteneti ambhasā payasā sarpiṣā tailena veti yojanīyam
nimbakolakapatrāṇītyatra nimba eva mṛdurnimbakolaka ucyate; kiṃvā kulaketi pāṭhaḥ, kulakaḥ paṭolaḥ
ropaṇīyamiti vacanād ropaṇameva ghṛtaṃ kartavyaṃ, natu śodhanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ
savyadakṣiṇa iti vāmadakṣiṇaḥ; vāmaparikṣepaḥ savyaḥ, dakṣiṇaparikṣepo dakṣiṇaḥ
dāhaviśeṣaviditi dāhānāṃ viśeṣaṃ snigdharūkṣādirūpaṃ tathā binduvalayādirūpaṃ jānātīti dāhaviśeṣavit
yadyapyupakrameṣu kṣāraḥ pṛthaṅna paṭhitaḥ, tathāapi śastrāgnivyāpārakartṛtvācchastrāgnyupakramagṛhīta eveti kṛtvā kṣāramapyavacārayediti vacanena kṣāroapi vihitaḥ
kakubhetyādiprakaraṇena tvagjananaṃ tathā savarṇakaraṇaṃ tathā romajananamiti upakramatrayamāha
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśoadhyāyaḥ
trimarmaśabdena hi trimarmāśritā rogāstasyopacāraścābhidhīyate; tena trimarmīyarogānadhikṛtya kṛtaṃ cikitsitaṃ trimarmīyacikitsitam
hṛdayādyupaghātena yasmādviśeṣataḥ prāṇopaghāto bhavati, tasmād hṛdayādyāśritāḥ prāṇā ucyante; yathā bhittyupaghātopahanyamānaṃ citraṃ bhittyāśrayamucyate
tatsaṃśritānāmiti prāṇāśrayāṇāṃ hṛdayādīnāṃ; saṃśritaśabdena hi saṃśraya ucyate

mahānto gadā yeṣu bhavanti teṣāṃ mahāgadānāṃ bastyādīnāmanupālanārthaṃ rakṣāṃ śṛṇu; kiṃvā tatsaṃśritānāmiti bastyādisaṃśritānāṃ prāṇānāmanupālanārthaṃ, mahāgadānāṃ mahāmarmabastyādivyāpakodāvartādīnāṃ, rakṣāmiti cikitsām
nanu kathamapānaḥ kupitoapānasyaiva saṅgaṃ karotīti mārutasaṅgaśabdenocyate? brūmaḥ- ātmanaivāyaṃ duṣṭaḥ samyagapravartamāna ātmanaḥ saṅgaṃ karotītyucyate, yathā mana eva manonigrahaṃ karoti
uktaṃ ca “indriyābhigrahaḥ karma manasaḥ svasya nigrahaḥ” (śā.a.1) iti
guḍenetivacanena yāvatā guḍena vartiḥ kartuṃ yujyate tāvanmāno guḍo deyaḥ
phalaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca virecanoktamiti dīrghañjīvitīye (sū.a.1) mūlinīphalinīvirecanakarmaṇyuktaṃ; kiṃvā kalpe virecanayogeṣu vakṣyamāṇam
hṛdityādinā udāvartasyaiva hetulakṣaṇaviśeṣakṛtāmānāhasañjñāṃ pradarśya tatra bheṣajamāha
tīvrā hi rugityādinā caturṇāṃ pratyekaṃ rūpamāha
tantrāntareaśmaryastu vātapittakaphaśukrajā uktāḥ; yadyapi sarvāśmarīṣu doṣatrayajanyatvamasti, “saṃhantyāpo yathā divyā mārutoagniśca vaidyutaḥ
3) iti suśruta pratipāditaṃ; tathāapyutkaṭaikadoṣābhiprāyeṇa vātajādivyapadeśo jñeyaḥ
vātajāyāmaśmaryāṃ prabalena vāyunā mūtraśoṣe kriyamāṇe tadgataḥ kapha evāśmarīrūpaḥ kriyate, evaṃ pittāśmaryāmapi jñeyam, ata eva suśrute śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvā evāśmarya uktāḥ
aśmaryutpāde dṛṣṭāntamāha- pitteṣviva rocanā goriti; pitteṣviti bahuvacanaṃ pittabahutvāpekṣayā
tatra vātena kadambapuṣpākṛtistripuṭī ca, pittenāśmatulyā ślakṣṇā, mṛdvī kaphena śukreṇa ca
kṣobhāt kṣata iti aśmarīkṣobhānmūtramārge bastau vā kṣate
tena vātena dvidhā tridhā bhinnāanekadhā vāaśmarī mūtrapathena kṣarantī śarkareva bhavati
kṣayādvā prakopitamiti ativyavāyācchukrakṣaye sati vāyunodīrya bastimānītam
evaṃ sūtrasthānoddiṣṭā aṣṭau mūtraghātā mūtrakṛcchraśabdeneha nirdiśya vyākṛtāḥ
ye tu trimarmīyasiddhau trayodaśa mūtrāghātā vaktavyāste sūtrasthāneasūtritā api ekādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhavadantarbhāvanīyāḥ
mūtrāghātamūtrakṛcchrayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ- yanmūtrakṛcchre mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa vahati, mūtrāghāte mūtraṃ śoṣyate pratihanyate vā; suśruteapi ca mūtrakṛcchramūtrāghātayorviśeṣoadhyāyabhedenaivoktaḥ
anye tu mūtrakṛcchraviśeṣāneva mūtrāghātānāhuḥ, yathāyogyatayā vātapittādicaturṣu mūtrakṛcchreṣu mūtrāghātānantarbhāvayanti; tena na pṛthaṅmūtrāghātābhidhānam
tatra śiśirāveva sekāvagāhau yadyapyuktau, tathāapi viśeṣeṇa śiśirasekāvagāhakaraṇārthaṃ punarabhidhānam
etadeva vātādibheṣajaṃ militaṃ tridoṣaprabhave kṛcchre kartavyam

tacca sameṣvapi doṣeṣu vāyoḥ sthānānupūrvyā cikitsitaṃ kartavyaṃ, na jvara iva tridoṣabhave kaphasthānānupūrvyā kartavyaṃ; mūtrakṛcchrasya samatridoṣārabdhatveapi vātasthānabhavatvena vāyureva prathamaṃ cikitsya iti bhāvaḥ
tribhyoadhike iti granthaḥ kaphe tathā pitte tathā pavane ityanena ca krameṇa sambadhyate
kriyā hitā seti yā kaphamārutotthe kṛcchre vihitā sā militaiva śarkarāyāmaśmaryāṃ ca kartavyā
madhvasanākhyaparṇyau madhuparṇī guḍūcī, asanaparṇī aparājitā, ‘dāruparṇī’ ityapare

ghṛtaṃ śvadaṃṣṭretyādau sāhacaryāt kecicchvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasamapyaṣṭaguṇaṃ vadanti; tanna, svarasaḥ snehasama eva sneheṣu bhavati, uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “kalkāccaturguṇaḥ snehaḥ, svarasaḥ snehasammitaḥ” iti; tena kṣīravat sarvasneheṣu svarasavidhānaṃ jñeyam
sthirādikānāmityādau katakādiḥ madhuraskandhe (vi.a.8) “...katakakāśmarya...” ityādinokto gaṇo jñeyaḥ
vidhinaiva teneti pūrvaghṛtavidhinaiva; tena śvadaṃṣṭrāsthāne sthirādīni pratyekaṃ kalpanīyāni
hṛdrogakartRūṇīti yathā “bhīṣmaḥ kurūṇāṃ bhayaśokahartā”, tena “tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari” (pā.a.2

vaivarṇyetyādau hṛdrogajā iti vacanāddhṛdrogānantarakālabhāvitayā vaivarṇyādīnāmupadravatvamicchanti; ye tu vaivarṇyādīnāṃ sāmānyahṛdrogalakṣaṇatvamāhuḥ, te hṛdrogeṇa samaṃ jāyante iti hṛdrogajā iti vigrahālliṅgatvaṃ vyutpādayanti
hṛdrogāśca kiyantaḥśirasīye (sū.a.17) vistareṇoktā api cikitsāprakaraṇādiha saṅkṣepeṇābhidhīyante
kvāthaḥ kṛta ityādau nāgarādīnāṃ kalkaṃ pauṣkarādikvāthe prakṣepamāhuḥ
pathyāśatītyādau yamakena bhṛṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ guḍaprasannālavaṇaiśca peya iti vyākhyeyam
dve triphale ityatra drākṣākāśmaryaparūṣakāṇi dvitīyā triphalā
udumbaretyādau udumbarādikvāthe bhāgatraye trivṛttryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ pādikaṃ prakṣepyam
kalpavidhānadiṣṭamiti rasāyane vihitam; kalpaśabdena ca kṣudrarasāyanamucyate
tridoṣaje ādau laṅghanavidhānaṃ hṛdayasya kaphasthānatayā tadgate tridoṣajeapi kapha evādau laṅghanena jeya iti matvā kṛtam
hīnatvamadhikatvaṃ madhyamatvaṃ ca doṣāṇāmavekṣya yat karma śastamadhikadoṣavijetṛtayā tat kāryamiti vākyārthaḥ
jīrṇeadhikamityādinā anilaśūlaṃ, jīryatyadhikamityanena ca paittikaṃ brūte
atra cānilakope yadyapi bastirucitaḥ, tathāapyāmāśayāpekṣayāaamāśayaśodhanaṃ virecanameva deyam
yadyapi rājayakṣmacikitsite pratiśyāya ukta eva, tathāapi tatra yakṣmapūrvarūpatayoktaḥ, iha tu svatantraḥ pratiśyāya ucyata iti viśeṣaḥ
atra mukharogaṃ ye na paṭhanti te śirorogagrahaṇenaiva mukharogasya grahaṇamiti manyante
eṣāṃ tu duṣṭapratiśyāyakṣavathvādīnāṃ śālākyādiṣu vistaraḥ, atra tu parādhikāratvāt saṅkṣepa eva
kuryāt sapitta ityādinā aruṃṣikāmāha; sā tu śirobhavā jñeyā
bhṛśārtītyādinā yadyapi pratiśyāyotpannatvena śirorogāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate, tathāapi svatantrotpannānāmapi śirorogāṇāmetadeva lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam
saṃsthānaṃ sthānamoṣṭhādi, dūṣyaṃ raktādi, ākṛtiḥ liṅgaṃ, nāma śītādādi, eṣāṃ bhedād vikalpāccatuḥṣaṣṭividhā bhavanti, te ca śālākye evonneyāḥ
suśrute pañcaṣaṣṭimukharogā uktāḥ, tathāapīha vaidehamatānusāreṇādūrāntareṇeyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ
yadyapi rājayakṣmacikitsiteapyarocakā uktāḥ, tathāapi śoṣoktārocakebhyaḥ pṛthagutpannā evārocakā abhidhīyanta iti na paunaruktyam
ete ca śālākye yadyapyaṣṭāviṃśatiruktāḥ, tathāapīha caturṣveva karṇarogeṣu śeṣāṇāmapyavarodho vyākhyeyaḥ, śeṣāṇāmapi vātādijanyatvāt
netrāmayeṣu ācāryāṇāṃ vipratipattiḥ; netrarogāṇāṃ ṣaṭsaptatiṃ videhaḥ prāha, karālastu ṣaṇṇavatim, aśītiṃ sātyakiḥ prāha
teṣu karālamatenaivaitadabhidhānam, uktaṃ ca tatra- “viṃśatiḥ sapta vartmasthā, nava sandhau prakīrtitāḥ
viṃśatiḥ pañca dṛṣṭisthāḥ, ṣoḍaśaiva ca sarvagāḥ” iti
tejaḥśabdena dehoṣmāabhimataḥ; sa vātādyairyuktaḥ khālityādi karotīti yojanīyam
ye tu ‘tejaḥ savātaṃ’ iti paṭhanti, te tejaḥśabdena pittamapi varṇayanti
pratiśyāye dhūmasya niṣedho vairecanikadhūmābhiprāyeṇa kṛtaḥ, teneha snaihikadhūmābhidhānaṃ na virodhi
srotaḥśṛṅgāṭanāsākṣiśoṣe iti ghrāṇaśrotrākṣitarpaṇīnāṃ sirāṇāṃ sannipātaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaḥ
evaṃ niṣpannatailasya daśamūlaniṣkvāthādibhirdaśakṛtvaḥ pākāt siddhaṃ tailamaṇutailaṃ syāt; aṇutā cāsya aṇusrotonusāritvāt, tacceha bhāvanayā pākabhūyastvena niṣpīḍanaviśeṣeṇa ca kriyate
paitte sarpiḥ pibet siddhamityatra śṛṅgaverasiddhameva sarpirdeyam
vyāhate vega iti pīnasasya vege mandībhūte
daśamūletyādau daśamūlādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ tripalamānaiḥ samaṃ mayūraṃ pakṣādivarjitaṃ jaladroṇe eva pacet
jaladroṇo hyatra kvāthārthaṃ pādāvaśeṣaḥ san ghṛtaprasthāccaturguṇo bhavati
kiñca daśamūlādīnāṃ catvāriṃśatpalena mayūreṇaikena samamadūrāntaraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ kvāthyaṃ droṇamāne jale deyam
kiṃvā daśamūlādīnāṃ mayūreṇa ca militvā yāvat kvāthyaṃ bhavati taccaturguṇaṃ jalamutsargaparibhāṣayaiva deyam
madhurairiti jīvanīyagaṇauktairdaśabhiḥ, jīvanīyāni hi madhuratvaprakarṣādiha madhuraśabdenocyante
pūrvayogoktakvāthavidhānaṃ yadyapyetenaiva kaṣāyeṇetyādinā siddhaṃ, tathāapi punaḥ pūrvakalpeneti vacanena yathālābhamitipadena ca yathālābhaṃ karaṇīyatvaṃ kalka eva, na kvāthe iti darśayati

atra prayogabhede jatūkarṇaḥ- “tatkvāthocitaśikhinaṃ daśamūlaśreyasībalāmadhukaistripalaiḥ saha sarpiṣā jīvanīyakarṣaiḥ pacet payasā kvātheasminneva catuṣke prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathālābhaṃ jīvanabṛṃhaṇavātāmākṣoṭatriphalāpūgamadhukaiḥ kharjūratālamastakatvagelāpauṣkaraśvadaṃṣṭrātāmalakībisabhārgīkaseruśṛṅgāṭakamṛṇāla rāsnāsthirāsamaṅgāśṛṅgyajaḍābhiḥ saha tu māyūraṃ catuṣprayogādūrdhvajatrugadeṣvamṛtavat” iti
sarpiśca nasyamityatra avapīḍasya paścāt sarpiṣā nasyaṃ deyam
kaphānilodbhave dāha ityatra kaphodbhave anilodbhave ca suśrutavacanāllalāṭaśaṅkhadeśe dāhaḥ kartavyaḥ
uktaṃ hi suśrute- “śirorogādhimanthaprabhṛtiṣu bhrūlalāṭaśaṅkhapradeśeṣu dahet” (su.sū.a.12) iti
mastuluṅgaṃ prakarṣeṇa tasmātte naiva yojayet” iti
kecid rodhrasthāne lohaṃ paṭhanti; uktaṃ hi śālākye- “pāṭhā rasāñjanaṃ vyoṣaṃ tejohvā triphalāagnikaḥ
gṛhadhūmo yavakṣāro śastraṃ cūrṇaṃ tu kālakam” iti
tāluśoṣe ityādau atṛṣṇasyetipadena tṛṣṇāyuktasya tāluśoṣe auttarabhaktikamapi sarpiḥpānaṃ niṣedhayati
tāluśoṣe ca “tṛṣṇāmūrcchāparītāśca garbhiṇyastāluśoṣiṇaḥ” (sū.a.13) ityādinā yadyapi snehapānaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathāapīha auttarabhaktikaṃ sarpirviśeṣavidhānāt kartavyameva
sirākarmeti sirāvyadhanaṃ; tacca suśrutavacanāt tāluni jihvāyāṃ ca kartavyam
dviguṇāmarimedasa iti viṭkhadirasya tu tule dve eva
gandhatailamiti sugandhadravyakalkayuktaṃ tailaṃ, kiṃvā gandhadravyādhivāsitaṃ tilodbhavaṃ tailam
śuṣkamūlaketyādike kṣārataile madhuśuktaṃ caturguṇamiti madhupradhānaṃ śuktaṃ caturguṇam
dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ śuktaṃ cukraṃ taducyate” iti
anye tu madhuśuktāvubhāvapi dāpayanti; tatra madhu tailasamaṃ, śuktaṃ tu caturguṇamiti vadanti; tannātihṛdayaṅgamaṃ, yato jatūkarṇe madhu na paṭhyata eva, madhunaḥ śuktagrahaṇenaiva gṛhītatvāt
sannipāte tu sarvairiti pratyekavātādyuktabiḍālakadravyaiḥ pralepanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ
netrāñjanaṃ tryahādityatra prāyoakṣirogāṇāṃ tryaheṇa pākāt tryahādityuktam
śilāsame bhāṇḍe iti aśmamaye pātre vā meṣaśṛṅge saṃsthitaḥ
atra bhāgairiti bahuvacanāt pṛthagbhāge siddheapi pṛthagiti padaṃ nyāyasiddhasyāpi triphalāpṛthagbhāgasya dyotanārtham
śeṣeṣvādau ca nirdiṣṭā ityatra śeṣaśabdena anuktatrimarmajarogagrahaṇam
ādau nirdiṣṭā iti sāmānyādihaiva doṣānullekhena trimarmajarogoddiṣṭā cikitsā jñeyā
siddhau cānyā pravakṣyate iti trimarmīyāyāṃ siddhau vakṣyate
vātādisvarabhedalakṣaṇaṃ yadyapīha noktaṃ, tathāapi rājayakṣmacikitsoktameva boddhavyam
yadyapi tatra cikitsoktā, tathāapīha svarabhedasyādhikṛtatvāt punarapyucyate
tatsthānasāmīpyādīti vātādisthāneṣu bastyādiṣu ca vamanādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ madhye yasya karmaṇaḥ samīpadoṣaharaṇarūpaṃ sāmarthyaṃ bhavati tena karmaṇā hartavyā iti
atra dṛṣṭānte industhānīyaḥ śleṣmā, ravisthānīyaṃ pittam
doṣāṇāṃ parasparaguṇavirodhāt sambhūya kāryakaraṇe yathā virodho na bhavati tadāha- viruddhairapīti
- parasparaviruddhairapi, yathā- śleṣmaṇaḥ snehapaicchilyagauravādīnāṃ vātaguṇai raukṣyalāghavādibhirviparītānāṃ ca parasparopaghātakatvaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ tadiha doṣasaṃsarge na bhavati
kuto na ghnantītyāha- sahajasātmyatvāditi; svābhāvikasātmyībhāvādityarthaḥ, sātmyībhāvoanupaghātakatvam

ayaṃ ca svabhāvaḥ karmajanyo vā bhavatu vastusvabhāvādhīno vā ubhayathā vā bhavatu, tathāapyacintya eva; dṛṣṭatvācca nātra yuktibādhā prabhavati; tena parasparaguṇopaghātavyabhicāraścandrikākṛtā suśrute prapañcitaḥ sa na bhavati
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne trimarmīyacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśoadhyāyaḥ

trimarmīye ca bahūn rogān pañcakarmasādhyān dṛṣṭvā pañcakarmāsādhye ūrustambhe jātasmaraṇa ācārya ūrustambhacikitsitamevāha; bhavati hi virodhidarśanāt tadvirodhismaraṇaṃ, yathā nakulasmaraṇāt sarpasmaraṇam
doṣaja iti padaṃ mānasāgantunirāsārthaṃ; tannirāsastu tayoḥ pañcakarmāviṣayatayā prasiddhatvāt
tathā doṣajasyāpyasādhyasya sādhane pañcakarmāṇi na samarthānīti tannirāsārthamāha- sādhyasyetyādi
bhūya ūrustambhasya kāraṇādīni pṛṣṭo gururabravīditi sambandhaḥ
āmaṃ citamiti rasaśeṣarūpaṃ, koṣṭhopalepanāpyāmaṃ sañcitaṃ, medasā saheti medaḥsahitamāmaṃ vātādīnāṃ rodhakaṃ jñeyam
āmaṃ ca ūruṃ gacchat tridoṣasahitameva yāti
doṣo medobalotkaṭa iti doṣa āmasaṃruddho vātādiḥ
sakthigraheṇaiva yadyapi jaṅghorvorgrahaṇaṃ prāptaṃ, tathāapi tayorabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa tatpūraṇopadarśanārtham
avidheyaparispandamiti asvādhīnendriyam, alpavikramamiti alpakriyamakriyaṃ vā karotītyarthaḥ
yadyapi, ūrustambhasya tridoṣajanyatvamiha tathā sūtrasthāneapi “eka ūrustambha āmatridoṣasamutthānaḥ” (sū.a.19) ityanenoktaṃ, tathāapi kaphaprādhānyādatra kapha upadiṣṭaḥ
ata evāgre ūru śleṣmetyādinā ūrustambhaśabdaniruktimutpādasāmagrīṃ cāha
sthairyaśaityābhyāmityanena stambhanakriyāyāṃ sthairyaśaityayoḥ kaphaguṇayoḥ kāraṇatāṃ darśayati
snehasya doṣo yadyapi prāgevoktaḥ, tathāapīdānīṃ yathā taddoṣakārakaṃ snehanaṃ bhavati tathā pratipādyate

kiṃvā bastikarmaviśeṣaṇaṃ snehanamiti padaṃ, tenānuvāsanameva labhyate; nirūhastu virecanaśabdenaiva śodhanābhidhāyinā gṛhītaḥ; ata eva ūrustambhadoṣoddharaṇāsamarthaśodhanavivaraṇe eva nirūhoapyatroktaḥ
uktadoṣaharaṇāsāmarthyaṃ vamanavirecananirūhāṇāṃ krameṇa vivṛṇvannāha- śleṣmasthānagata ityādi
mūlanirjayāditipadaṃ vamanādityanena tathā bastibhirityanena ca yojyaṃ; mūlanirjayāditi mūlacchedāt
vamanādīnāṃ sādhyaṃ viṣayaṃ darśayitvā asādhyaṃ viṣayamāha- śakyā ityādi
kṣapaṇaṃ śoṣaṇamāmakaphayoḥ kuryāditi yojanā; tatra kṣapaṇaṃ sarvathocchedena, śoṣaṇaṃ dravabhāgaviśoṣaṇam
gugguluṃ ca mūtre uṣitaṃ pibediti yojyam
rūkṣaṇādityādinā snehavidhānamāvasthikaṃ, tena sāmānyenātra vihitasnehaniṣedhena samaṃ na virodhaḥ, asya vidherapavādatvāt
aṣṭakaṭvara iti tailādaṣṭaguṇaṃ kaṭvaraṃ yasmin tailaprasthe sa aṣṭakaṭvaraḥ; kaṭvaraṃ takram
nanu jalaprataraṇaṃ kathamasya śleṣmakṣayakaraṃ bhavati? yasmājjalasambandhamātreṇa śleṣmavṛddhireva prāptā
ucyate- jalena bahirnirgacchadūṣmaṇo niruddhasyāntaḥpraveśācchleṣmasaṅghātabhedanaṃ bhavati, tathā prataraṇakriyayā śleṣmā vicchidyate, samānābhimatā kriyāapyatra yogyatvāt kriyata eva
uktaṃ hi- “bhavet kadācit kāryāapi viruddhābhimatā kriyā” (ci.a.30) iti
karmāyogyatvakāraṇamiti pañcakarmāyogyatve hetuḥ ‘vṛddhaye śleṣmaṇa’ ityādinokto jñeyaḥ
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsitasthāne ūrustambhacikitsitaṃ nāma saptaviṃśoadhyāyaḥ

tatra vāta eva vyādhirvātavyādhiriti pakṣe vāta eva tattaddūṣyasamprāptaḥ sarvāṅgaikāṅgarūpatāmāpanno vividhapīḍākartṛtvādvātavyādhirucyate; yadā tu vātādvyādhirvātavyādhiriti pakṣastadā vātadoṣād doṣadūṣyasammūrcchanaviśeṣarūpaḥ sarvāṅgaikāṅgarūpo vyādhirvātavyādhirucyate
jvarādayastu yadyapi vātādutpadyante, tathāapi te doṣāntareṇāpi vātaṃ vinā bhavantīti kṛtvā nātra śāstre vātavyādhiśabdenocyante
yeapi cātra kaphapittāvṛtavātavikārā vātavyādhitvena vaktavyāḥ, teapi pradhānaṃ vātaṃ vinā na bhavantīti kṛtvā vātavyādhirūpā eva

na ca vācyaṃ yathā vātikā nānātmajā vyādhayaḥ pṛthak cikitsayocyante, tathā pittajāḥ kaphajāśca cikitsyantāmiti; yataḥ pittakaphakṛtānāṃ nānātmajānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ na tathā prādhānyaṃ yathā vātajānāṃ; tena vātajānāmevāviṣkṛtatamānāṃ pṛthak cikitsocyate, kaphapittajānāṃ tvāviṣkṛtānāṃ vamanavirecanādikā kaphapittacikitseti jñeyam
yadyapi śarīrendriyasattvātmasaṃyoga āyuḥ, tathāapi tādṛśasaṃyoge pradhānatvāt prakṛtistho vāyurapyāyurucyate
evaṃ balasyāpi heturvāyuriti kṛtvā śarīrādhāratayā balādhāraheturvāyureva balamityuktaḥ
prāṇodānetyādinā vyavahārārthaṃ sañjñopadarśanapūrvakaṃ prāṇādīnāṃ sthānaṃ karma cāha
prāṇodānayoryadyapi samānamuraḥsthānaṃ, tathāapi karmabhedādbheda eva; yathaikagṛhasthitamālākārakumbhakārayoḥ
prayatanaṃ prayatnaḥ, ūrja utsāhaḥ; prayatnādikarmatvena prayatnaurjobalavarṇaniṣpādanamucyate

svedadoṣāmbuvāhīnītyādau svedavāhīni tathā ambuvāhīni ca srotāṃsi srotovimāne (vi.a.5) pṛthagevoktāni jñeyāni, doṣavahāni ca srotāṃsi sarvaśarīracarāṇyeva, uktaṃ hi “vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ punaḥ sarvaśarīracarāṇāṃ sarvasrotāṃsyayanabhūtāni” (vi.a.5) iti
etāni karmāṇi yādṛśāḥ kurvanti tadāha- yuktā ityādi; yuktā iti avyāpannāḥ
svasthānakarmajairiti yasya vāyoryat sthānamuktaṃ tatsthānagataiḥ, tathā ṣṭhīvanādi yadvāyoḥ karmoktaṃ tajjaiśca rogaiḥ śarīraṃ pīḍayanti prāṇān vā mahatā rogeṇa haranti ca
atra ca vāyoreva bhūripradhānarogakartṛtayā bhinnacikitsāprayojakāḥ pañcabhedā uktā na pittakaphayoḥ, anatiprayojanatvāt

tathā hi tantrāntare pittamapi pācaka-rañjaka-sādhakālocaka-bhrājakabhedāt pañcavidhamuktaṃ; teṣāṃ ca yathākramaṃ jaṭharahṛdayadṛṣṭitvaksthānatvamuktaṃ; tathā śleṣmāapi bodhaka-śleṣmaka-tarpakāvalambaka kledakabhedāt pañcavidhaḥ, teṣāṃ ca sthānāni yathākramaṃ hṛdayāmāśayajihvāśiraḥ sandhayaḥ, karmāṇi ca yathākramamavalambana-kledana-rasabodhanākṣatarpaṇa-sandhisaṃśleṣāṇi pṛthaguktāni
kathaṃ punasteaśītinakhabhedādyā upadiṣṭāḥ? ucyate- kevalaṃ vāyumuddiśya kecidgadā vepathvādaya uktāḥ, tathā cāvṛtaṃ vātamuddiśya keciduktāḥ “liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhastṛṣṇā” ityādinā
apataṃsanaṃ gajādibhyaḥ patanaṃ, kiṃvā avataṃsanaṃ dhātūnāṃ karṣaṇam; uktaṃ hi kharanāde- “vilikhatyatitaikṣṇyādyat smṛtamullekhanaṃ hi tat
apāyo laghutā punariti vātavyādhīnāmapāyoapagamanaṃ śarīrasya laghutā vātavyādhiliṅgavigamena, śarīrakalyateti yāvat; kiṃvā apāyo laghutā na sarvathā vātaliṅgābhāvaḥ, yena prakṛtaliṅgāni santyeva
ete ca saṅkocādayo vyādhayoapi bhavanti; uktaṃ hi- “vyādhayaste tadātve tu liṅgānīṣṭāni nāmayāḥ” (ni.a.8) iti

huṇḍanaṃ śiraḥprabhṛtīnāmantaḥpraveśaḥ; anye tu keśabhūmisphuṭanaṃ śaṅkhalalāṭabhedaśca śirohuṇḍanaṃ, nāsāhuṇḍanaṃ ghrāṇanāśaḥ, akṣihuṇḍanam akṣivyudāsaḥ, jatruhuṇḍanaṃ vakṣoparodhaḥ, grīvāhuṇḍanaṃ grīvāstambhaḥ
hetuviśeṣaḥ pittāvaraṇādiḥ, sthānaviśeṣaḥ koṣṭhādiḥ, kiṃvā hetukṛtaḥ sthānaviśeṣaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “prakupitāstu prakopaṇaviśeṣād dūṣyaviśeṣān dūṣayantaḥ” (vi.a.6) ityādi
bhuktasya stambha iti bhuktavato gātrastambho bhavatīti
gurvaṅgamityādi māṃsage medege ca lakṣaṇaṃ samānaṃ, tathā bhedoasthiparvaṇāmityādi asthimajjagayoḥ samānaṃ lakṣaṇam
kṣipraṃ muñcati badhnātīti vyavāyakāle kṣipraṃ muñcati vā ciraṃ dhārayate, tathā garbhamapi kṣipraṃ muñcati vā ciraṃ dhārayati
ekamiti vāmaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vā saṅkocayati bāhuṃ, pādaṃ, jānu ca; vakraṃ ca jihmaṃ karoti
vakraṃ vrajati bhojanamiti na samaṃ mukhena khādati, kintu vakraikadeśena
bādhyete śravaṇāviti yadyapi ekapārśvāśrayo vikāroayaṃ, tathāapi prabhāvāt karṇayorbādhāatra bhavati
kevala iti ardhe eva na kṛtsne

nanu yadā dehārdhavyāpitvamarditasya tadāarditena ardhāṅgasya ko bhedaḥ? brūmaḥ-ardito vegitayā na sarvakālaṃ bhavati, ardhāṅgastu sarvakālaṃ vyāpya bhavati; uktaṃ hi- “svasthaḥ syādarditādīnāṃ muhurvegāgame gate” iti
kiṃvā yathoktaviśiṣṭalakṣaṇoarditaḥ, ardhāṅge tu naitāni sarvāṇi bhavanti
antaryadā nāḍīḥ prapadyate iti manyāsambaddhā eva antargatāḥ sirāḥ prapadyata ityarthaḥ
antarāyāmasañjñitamiti evaṃvidho manyāstambha antarāyāma ucyate; aparastu manyāstambho vakṣyamāṇabahirāyāma iti vaktavyaḥ
pṛṣṭhato nīyate iti pṛṣṭhaṃ prati ākṛṣyate
sarvaikāṅgarogāṃśca kuryāt snāyugatoanilaḥ” ityanena snāyugatānilajanyāvuktau, iha ca sirāgatavātajanyatvenoktau, tenobhayavacanāt sirāsnāyugatavātajanyāveva bhavataḥ
arditādīnāṃ daṇḍakāntānāṃ samānaṃ rūpamāha- svasthaḥ syādityādi
arditahanustambhādiṣu yatra muhurmuhurvegitvaṃ dṛśyate tadarditāntargatameva jñeyam

prathamaṃ sphicaṃ stambharuktodairgṛhṇāti, paścāttu kaṭipṛṣṭhorujānujaṅghāpadaṃ gṛhṇāti sā gṛdhrasī vātāt; vātakaphāttu sā pūrvoktalakṣaṇā satī tandrādyanvitā bhavati; evaṃ gṛdhrasīdvayaṃ “dve gṛdhrasyau vātād vātakaphācca” (sū.a.19) ityanenoktaṃ vivṛtaṃ bhavati
tatra nakhasthānānurūpaṃ bhedasañjñānurūpaṃ ca liṅgaṃ nakhasphuṭanarūpaṃ bhavati
athāvṛtasya vāyoḥ kathaṃ kupitatvaṃ bhavati yāvatā āvṛto durbala eva bhavatītyāha- vāyorityādi
atha bhavatu mārgarodhādvātakopaḥ, āvarakeṇa tu pittena kaphena cāsya kathaṃ na sambandho bhavatītyāha- vātapittetyādi
tritayamelakeapi vāyoḥ prādhānyamāha- vāyureva hi sūkṣmatvāditi; sūkṣmamārgānusāritayā prerakatvāt
tasmāt triṣvapi doṣeṣu vāyurevoktanyāyena pradhānam, ataḥ kupitaḥ pittakaphau samuddhūya tābhyāmāvṛtamārgoapi tatra tatra pradeśe gadān karoti; tathā rasādīṃśca tatra tatra kṣipan saṃśoṣayet
āvaraṇakṛtaṃ vātakopaṃ darśayitvā āvaraṇaviśeṣakṛtaṃ liṅgamāha- liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte ityādi
māṃsagatasya raktādigatasya ca vātasya pūrvameva lakṣaṇamuktam, iha tu raktādyāvṛtasya lakṣaṇamucyata iti viśeṣaḥ
atra kubjatvapaṅgutvādayo yadyapi sākṣānna prapañcitāstathāapi śeṣātideśenaiva tallakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam
sthānasya gāmbhīryāditi gambhīrasthānāśritatvāt; anye tu gāmbhīryaṃ kṛtāspadatvamāhuḥ

yatnāt sidhyanti vā naveti pākṣikasiddhivacanamitaravaidyābhiprāyeṇa jñeyam; ācāryastu ācāryaprakhyo vā vaidyaḥ sādhayatyeva balāt, itaravaidyastu nāvaśyaṃ sarvatrāvyāhatajñāno bhavati, tena saṃśayābhidhānaṃ; tataśca na pāramārthikī sandigdhatā etādṛśānāṃ sādhyatāṃ pratīti jñeyam
upadravāścātra śṛṅgagrāhikayāanuktā api sāmānyopadravalakṣaṇayuktā eva kecidgadā vijñeyāḥ; kiṃvā adhyāyaśeṣe ‘hṛdrogo vidradhiḥ’ ityādinā vakṣyamāṇā upadravā jñeyāḥ
svedādhyāye “snehapūrvaṃ prayuktena” (sū.a.14) ityādinoktoapyayaṃ snehapūrvakasvedaguṇaḥ punaḥ prakaraṇāgatatvāducyate
āśu prayojita iti padaṃ puṣṇātītyanena sambadhyate
anilāmayā na tiṣṭhanti na sthāyino bhavantītyarthaḥ

atra kevalo nirupastambhaśca vāyuścikitsyatvenādhikṛtaḥ, tasya sadoṣatvamanupapannaṃ; tataḥ sadoṣatvaṃ karmaṇi yojanīyaṃ; tena karmaṇoaviśuddhatvād vāyurna praśāmyati, karmaṇaścoktasyāpyatrāśuddhirmalajanakatvāt; vakṣyati hi “snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇādyairāhārairhi malaścitaḥ” ityādi
kiṃvā sadoṣatvādityanenottarakālīnaṃ vāyoḥ saṃśamanamucyate, asaṃsṛṣṭatvamanupastambhatvaṃ ca yaduktaṃ tadupakramārambhakāle jñeyam
sadoṣatvaṃ ca snehaprayogeṇānupaśame saṃśodhanakaraṇe ca hetuḥ
pācanaṃ kiñcinna dīpanaṃ, yathā paṭolaṃ dīpanaṃ; dīpanaṃ kiñcinna pācanaṃ yathā triphalā; uktaṃ hi suśrute- “triphalā kaphapittaghnī mehakuṣṭhavināśinī
cakṣuṣyā dīpanī ca” (su.sū.a.38) iti; ataḥ pācanairityasya dīpanairiti viśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtam
sthānaviśeṣeṇa kriyāviśeṣamāha- viśeṣatastvityādinā adho nābheḥ śasyate cāvapīḍaka ityantena
kṣāraṃ yavakṣāram, uktaṃ hi “yāvaśūkaḥ sraṃsanīyapācanīyārśoghnānāṃ” (sū.a.25); kiṃvā kṣāramiti grahaṇyādinirdiṣṭaṃ dīpanakṣāram
utthāpane iti puṣṭijanane sitādibhiḥ siddhaṃ payo hitam
matsyāniti nābhipradeśe kupite vāte matsyā bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ samaṃ siddhā deyāḥ
nasye pāne ca auttarabhaktikaṃ māṣasaindhavasādhitameva tailaṃ jñeyam
tatra ca māṣasya kvāthaḥ, saindhavasya kalkaḥ
sarpiṣoavapīḍakaḥ yatra sarpiḥ pītvā tatpīḍakamannaṃ bhujyate
balāyā ityādau pṛthakśabdād balādayastrayaḥ sādhanadravyaprayogāḥ, teṣvajaśīrṣādayaścatvāraḥ pṛthak sādhyāḥ, evaṃ dvādaśa rasā bhavanti
tena siddhaṃ tailamityatra samamiti nirguṇḍīrasasamaṃ, natu samaśabdaḥ sahārthaḥ; sahārthasya tṛtīyayaivoktatvāt
nāḍī nāḍīvraṇaḥ; nāḍīvraṇasya suśrutādiṣu pañcavidhatvamuktaṃ jñeyam
mūlakasvarasa ityādau mūlakasvarase samakṣīre dadhi sthāpyaṃ; tasyāmlasyeti mūlarasāderamlatāṅgatasya
atra ca tribhiḥ prasthairiti vacanāt mūlakarasādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ prasthamānatvam
pañcamūlakaṣāyeṇetyādau pañcamūlīkaṣāyaṃ tathā piṇyākakvathitaṃ jalaṃ ca pṛthagdeyamiti kecidvadanti, vayaṃ tu pañcamūlīkaṣāyeṇaiva jalasthānīyena sādhitapiṇyākasya rasamatrecchāmaḥ
paktvā tasya rasaṃ pūtvā’ ityādi paṭhyate; jātūkarṇeapi “piṇyākaṃ bahuvārṣikaṃ sthirādisalile pacet, raseasminaṣṭaguṇena payasā tailaṃ sādhyam” iti
sahācaretyādau mūlakalkāddaśapalamityanena sahacaramūlādeva daśapalaḥ kalko deyaḥ; jatūkarṇe tvatra mūlakasyaiva kalka uktaḥ
jīrṇe taile ityādi pīte taile jīrṇe sati
kaṭuphalā latākastūrī, anye sugandhi dakṣiṇāpathaprasiddhaṃ padyala(?)māhuḥ
patrakalkamiti sugandhitvādasya tailasya gandhaśāsraparibhāṣayā patrakalko deya ityucyate; gandhaśāstre ca “cūrṇasvarasapuṣpāṇāṃ siddhaśīteavatārite
dīyate gandhavṛddhyarthaṃ patrakalko manīṣibhiḥ” iti; tenātra karpūrādipatrakalkoavatārite eva deyaḥ
prāktailāvāpasiddhamiti mūlakasvarasamityādyuktatailakalkena samaṃ vṛṣamūlādikvāthena ca siddham
mūlakatailākhyamitisañjñayā tatra rāsnādīnāṃ mūlenaiva kvāthasādhanaṃ darśayati
anekaśataśastacca siddhamiti anekaśataśastenaiva vidyānena sādhitaṃ sadityarthaḥ
sādhāraṇīti yā vāte sā saṃsargiṇi ca pittādau samānā saṃsargahiteti yāvat; na kevalaṃ saṃsṛṣṭe vāyau sādhāraṇī, kintu vātapittādibhiḥ srotaḥsvāvṛteṣvapi sādhāraṇī kartavyā
kecittu ‘vāte pittādibhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti; ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ sugamaḥ
vyatyāsāditi parivartanena śītāṃ kṛtvoṣṇām, uṣṇāṃ ca kṛtvā śītāṃ kuryādityarthaḥ
pittamādau vinirjayediti vacanena kaphāpekṣayā pittasyāśukāritayā pittajayamevopadiśati
yadyapi doṣāntarasthānagate taddoṣapradhānameva karma vamanaṃ bastirvā yuktaḥ, tathāapyanena virecanamapi tatra yaugikamiti darśayati
‘uraḥsrotogate’ iti kecit paṭhanti, tatra sūkṣmasrotoanugate ityarthaḥ
pūrvavadretasāaavṛte iti śukrasthe vāte yā kriyā pūrvamuktā sā retasāaavṛteapi vāte kāryā
svasthānastha ityādi svasthānastho yasmāt sthānopabṛṃhaṇādbalī doṣo bhavati tasmāt prāk svairauṣadhairjayet
śamaneneti kaphādiśamanenaiva; śamanaṃ ca śodhanānantaraṃ śodhanānarhe vā jñeyam

yadyapi ceha vāyoramūrtatvaṃ vātakalākalīye proktaṃ, tathāapīdamamūrtatvamakaṭhinavācakaṃ na tvavayavapratiṣedhakaṃ; tena vāyoḥ vāyvantareṇa gatihananarūpamāvaraṇamupapannameva; dṛṣṭā ca vāyunā vāyvantareṇopahatena vātakuṇḍalitā bahirapi, tenopapannamāvaraṇaṃ vātānāṃ parasparam
prāṇo vṛṇotyudānādīnityanena catvāryāvaraṇāni, prāṇaṃ vṛṇvanti teapi cetyanena ca catvāri, udānādyāstathāanyonyamityanena dvādaśāvaraṇānyucyante

tatrodānena vyānādīnāṃ trayāṇāmāvaraṇe trīṇi, tathā vyānādyaiścodānāvaraṇe trīṇi, tathā vyānena samānāpānāvaraṇe dve, tābhyāṃ ca vyānāvaraṇe dve, pariśiṣṭayoścānyonyāvaraṇe dve, evaṃ dvādaśāvaraṇāni pūrvāṣṭakayuktāni viṃśatirbhavanti
ulbaṇānāmiti vṛddhānāṃ; kiṃvā ulbaṇānāmiti āviṣkṛtatamānāṃ militānāṃ pañcānāṃ; tenaiteṣāmekadvitryādisaṃsargeṇāvāryāvarakatayā bhedādbahuvidhamāvaraṇaṃ bhavatīti darśayati

atra āvāryāṇāṃ balīyasāaavaraṇāt svakarmahānirbhavati, āvarakasya tūtsargataḥ svakarmavṛddhirbhavati, tathā āvaraṇena ca āvāryaḥ prakupito bhavati tadā svakarmaṇāṃ vṛddhirbhavatīti vyavasthā; anye tu āvaraṇīyasya svakarmahāniḥ, āvarakasya tūtsargato vṛddhirbhavatīti vyavasthāmāhuḥ
uṣṇaṃ kramamanuṣṇaṃ cetyatra yadyapyuṣṇa eva kramo vāte yujyate, tathāapi sthānāpekṣayā raktādidūṣyaṃ kramaviparyayasya kāraṇaṃ jñeyam
tridhā vyānaṃ tu yojayediti ūrdhvamadho madhye tridhā yojayet
prāṇo rakṣya iti sthāne eva yāpanīyaḥ
kutoayaṃ viśeṣarakṣaṇīya ityāha- sthāne tvasya sthitirdhruveti; asya prāṇasya, sthāne samyagavasthāne sati, sthitiḥ jīvanarūpā, dhruvā niścitā
prāṇādīnāṃ pittena kaphena tathā pittakaphābhyāṃ cāvaraṇalakṣaṇānyāha- mūrcchā dāho bhrama ityādi
upaghātastathoṣmaṇa iti atra pittenāpyāvṛte samāne agnyuttejanābhāvādūṣmaṇa upaghāto jñeyaḥ
samyagjñātā apyupekṣaṇād, yāthātathyena jñātā api parisaṃvatsarāstatheti yojanīyam
prasamīkṣyetyādau balādhikye sati sraṃsanaṃ mṛdu kartavyamityabhiprāyaḥ
lehaṃ vā bhārgavaproktamiti cyavanaprāśaṃ, cyavano hi bhārgava ucyate
uktaṃ hi āyurvedasamutthāne “bhārgavaścyavanaḥ kāmī vṛddhaḥ san vikṛtiṃ gataḥ” (ci.a.1pā.4) iti
vātādīnāṃ durvijñeyatāṃ dṛṣṭāntena darśayati- loka ityādi
kṣayamityādau āvaraṇamapi kṣayavṛddhisambandhāntarnirdiṣṭameva, tathāapyāvaraṇasya viśeṣalakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ pṛthagabhidhānam
deśādyapekṣā sūtrasthāneasmābhirvivṛtā deśādibhedena pratarkaṇīyā, vistarabhītyā tu na prapañcyate
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśoadhyāyaḥ
vātaraktābhyāṃ janito vyādhiḥ vātaraktaṃ, kiṃvā vātarakte eva avasthāntaraprāpte vātaraktam
prāyaśaḥ sukumārāṇāmityanena sukumāraśarīre lavaṇādihetusevayā śīghraṃ duṣṭaṃ vātāsraṃ vātaśoṇitaṃ bhavatīti darśayati

atra lavaṇādi yadyapi vātaśoṇitahetutayoktaṃ tathāapi śoṇitaduṣṭikāraṇametat prādhānyājjñeyaṃ, vātaduṣṭikāraṇaṃ tu kaṣāyetyādinoktaṃ, tataśca lavaṇādi kaṣāyādi ca militaṃ sad vātaśoṇitotpādakaṃ bhavati
yattu ‘jāyate vātaśoṇitam’ ityanena lavaṇādīnāṃ vātaśoṇitakāraṇatvamuktaṃ, tadvātaśoṇitajanakaśoṇitaduṣṭikāraṇadvārā jñeyam
kecit ‘abhighātādaśuddhyā ca’ ityasya sthāne ‘aśuddhyā vātavaiṣamyāt’ iti paṭhanti
aśuddhyā ceti cakāreṇa lavaṇādi prajāgarairityantaṃ śoṇitaduṣṭikāraṇaṃ samuccinoti
atra śoṇitavātasya vicchidya hetubahupāṭhena dvayorapyatra svatantraṃ prakopaṃ darśayati
kruddha iti vṛddhoapi svahetorvāyuḥ punaḥ śoṇitenāvaraṇādviśeṣeṇa kruddhaḥ
khuḍadeśaprāptyā khuḍaḥ, khuḍaśabdena sandhirucyate; vātasyāvaraṇena balamastyasmiñ śoṇite iti vātabalāśaḥ; āḍhyānāṃ prāyo bhavatīti āḍhyarogaḥ
karapādagrahaṇenaiva aṅgulīnāṃ grahaṇe prāpte aṅgulīnāṃ bahuparvatayā viśeṣeṇādhiṣṭhānatvopadarśanārthaṃ punarabhidhānam
vātaśoṇitasya dehaṃ sarpato viśeṣeṇa parvāvasthānaṃ sahetukamāha- taddravatvādityādi
pittādisaṃsṛṣṭamiti pittena kaphena ca hetvantarāgatena vāyunā ca yuktam
svedoatyarthaṃ naveti ca yadyapi kuṣṭhapūrvarūpeapyuktaṃ, tathāapyasamānabhūripūrvarūpasambandhādanyatarayogapūrvarūpatve niścayaḥ
ayaṃ ca tṛtīyaḥ prakāro bāhyābhyantaraprakāroktaprakāragṛhīta eveti kṛtvā rogasaṅgrahe dvividhaṃ vātaśoṇitamuktam

“dvividhaṃ vātaśoṇitamuttānamavagāḍhaṃ cetyeke bhāṣante; tattu na samyak, kasmāt? kuṣṭhavaduttānaṃ bhūtvā kālāntareṇāvagāḍhībhavati” (su.ci.a.5) ityanena suśrutena yaddvaividhyaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tadācāryayoḥ paramātmanoḥ suśrutāgniveśayorekasyāpyaprāmāṇyaṃ na saṅgatamiti kṛtvā avirodhamevātra vyākhyānayāmaḥ; tathāhi- suśrutena uttānaṃ vātaśoṇitaṃ kuṣṭhavadgambhīraṃ bhavatītyucyate, na tu sarvamevottānaṃ bhūtvā gambhīraṃ bhavatīti pratijñāyate; tena yo brūte- uttānamevāvatiṣṭhate, taṃ prati suśrutavacanaṃ bādhakaṃ; tanna, carake uttānamevāvatiṣṭhate iti nocyata eva, kintu prathamotpattau kiñciduttānamutpadyate, kiñcittu gambhīramiti, tena na virodhaścarakasuśrutayoḥ
tatra vāteadhike ityādau rakte pitte kaphe vā ‘adhike’ ityanuvartanīyaṃ; tena pittavṛddhiḥ, śoṇitavṛddhiḥ, kaphavṛddhiśca jñeyā
saṃsṛṣṭeṣviti dvitriṣu militeṣu samasteṣviti catuḥṣvapi militeṣvadhikeṣu
dvandvatridoṣajamityatra adhikaśoṇitānubandhoapi gṛhītavyaḥ; tena vātādicatuṣṭayādhikamelakamapi vātaśoṇitaṃ jñeyam
ata eva ekadvitrisarvādhikabhedād dvividhasyāpi vātaśoṇitasya pūrvaṭīkākṛdbhiḥ pañcacatvāriṃśadbhedā uktāḥ
yasya ca syurupadravā iti sādhyatvenoktasyāpi vakṣyamāṇopadravayogādasādhyatā
tridoṣasyāsādhyatveapi yadvakṣyati ‘khajena mathitā peyā vātarakte tridoṣaje’ iti, tadasampūrṇalakṣaṇābhinavatridoṣajābhiprāyeṇa

mohenaikeneti itaropadravāṇāṃ melakādasādhyatvaṃ, mohastu eka eva asādhyatākara ityarthaḥ; ye tu ‘mehenaikena’ iti paṭhanti, te mehavātaśoṇitayorviruddhopakramatayā mehayogenāsādhyatāmāhuḥ; vātaśoṇitasya hi prāyeṇa madhuraśītopakramaḥ, tadviparītastu mehasyeti viruddhopakramatā

raktasya mārgaṃ māruto nihanti śākhāsandhiṣu niviśyeti śākhāsandhiṣu sthitvā, tataśca vāyunā raktanirodhāt, anyonyamāvāryeti raktena vātaṃ vātena ca raktamāvārya, vātaraktaṃ vedanābhirharedasūmiti yojyam
asṛṅmokṣaṇena āvaraṇavyapagamādvāyurapi prasanno bhavati, tataśca vyādhyuparama iti bhāvaḥ
virecanavidhāne snehayuktai rūkṣaurveti vikalpadvaye snehayuktavirecanamīṣatsnigdhaviṣayaṃ, rūkṣaistu virecanamatisnigdhaviṣayam
kaphottare vātottare ca śītapralepadoṣamāha- kaphavātottare ityādi
pittottare raktottare ca uṣṇapralepairdoṣamāha- raktapittottare ityādi
doṣabalaṃ buddhvā ācarediti doṣabalaṃ buddhvā anuguṇāmeva kriyāmācaret; vātakaphottare uṣṇāṃ, raktapittottare śītāṃ, miśre ca miśrāmiti bhāvaḥ
trāyantiketyādau kalkairebhirityanena śatāvaryantānāṃ kalkatvaṃ, kaśerukākaṣāyaḥ, parūṣakarasādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ ghṛtasamānatvaṃ, vidārīrasasyāpi tathāvacanāt samatvam

atra jatūkarṇaḥ- “tulyarasaiḥ parūṣakakāśmaryakakaśerukāvidarīdrākṣekṣūṇāṃ catuṣke payasi dvikākolītāmalakīśatāvaryaḥ piṣṭvā paced ghṛtaṃ, prayogeṇa tadvātāsravīsarpajvarajit sarpiḥ pārūṣakaṃ nāma” iti
kṣīratriguṇa sārdhabhāgā śarkarā yasyāṃ mātrāyāṃ sā kṣīra triguṇāadhyardhaśarkarā
madhuyaṣṭyā ityādau madhukatulāyāṃ jaladroṇaṃ dattvā tailāḍhakamānaḥ kvātho bhavati
guḍūcītyādau guḍūcyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ śatapalatvaṃ, kolādīnāṃ pratyekamāḍhakamānatvam
śatena yaṣṭimadhukādityādau yaṣṭīmadhupalaśataṃ daśaguṇena kṣīreṇa sādhyaṃ, tena caturbhāgasthitena kṣīreṇa tailaṃ paktavyam
tadevaṃ madhukācchate siddhamiti śatadhāpākena madhukapalaśatāt siddhamityarthaḥ
anena ca madhukapalaśatasādhanopadeśena śataṃ kṛtvetyatra śataśabdasya vipulavācitāṃ niṣeṇayati

balākaṣāyetyādinoktaśatasahasrapāke atyarthapākāt snehakṣayaṃ paśyantaḥ śataguṇena sahasraguṇena vā draveṇaikadaiva pākaṃ vyākhyānayanti; kintu tāvatī snehamātrāatra paktavyā yā pākopakṣayeṇa niḥśeṣā na bhavati, kṣīraṃ cātra snehavardhakamasti, tena yathāśrutamevātrācāryavacanaṃ pramāṇamiti paśyāmaḥ
kiñca pratyāsanne eva pāke sadrave snehakalkoddharaṇamatra kartavyaṃ, tena snehāpepakṣayaiapi mātrāanena bhavati
guḍūcītyādau dravāt pādikaḥ sneha iti nyāyāt prasthaṃ tailasya bhavati
samadhūcchiṣṭetyādau madhucchiṣṭādīni kalkaḥ, jalaṃ ca dravaṃ deyam

kintu, āranālāḍhakasādhyataile eva sarjarasasthāne madhūcchiṣṭādīnāṃ prakṣepāt piṇḍatailamanenocyata iti jatūkarṇavacanādunnīyate; uktaṃ hi tatra- “kāñjikasarjarasaśṛtaṃ khajitaṃ bahunā jalena sikthakasarjarasairyuktamabhyañjanam” iti
pulinaṃ nadītaṭaḥ, pulinasparśena śīto mārutaḥ, tena vījite śayane, ‘śayanasya’ iti śeṣaḥ
medasaḥ kaphasya vā ativṛddhyā kṛtāt mārgasaṃrodhādanile kupite sati ādau snehanaṃ tathā bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca na śastamiti ślokārthaḥ
atra snehanabṛṃhaṇaniṣedhe sati kartavyamāha- vyāyāmetyādinā mākṣikasya cetyantena
kaphamedovṛte eva nirjitakaphamedasi vāte vātaraktaprasādinī kriyā atraivoktasnehaprayogādikā kāryā; vātavikāratvād vātavyādhicikitsitena jayet
etacca vātena raktābhibhavanaṃ gambhīra eva vātarakte prāyo bhavatīti darśayituṃ ‘gambhīre’ iti kṛtam
gambhīrānugate hi vātarakte raktaṃ bahu nāsti, yato raktasya dvitīyā raktadharā tvak sthānaṃ; tenottāne eva raktaṃ balavat, bāhyasthānatvādraktasya
hetuḥ sthānānītyādisaṅgrahe doṣādhikyamupadravāḥ sādhyaṃ yāpyamasādhyaṃ ceti ananukrameṇa saṅgrahaṃ karoti, upadravāṇāmabhāvasadbhāvastokabhāvaiḥ sādhyatvāsādhyatvayāpyatvakhyāpanārtham
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne vātaraktacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśoadhyāyaḥ
uktaṃ hi- “na hi vātādṛte yonirnārīṇāṃ sampraduṣyati” iti
divyāni tīrthāni gaṅgādīni, divyāścauṣadhyo brahmasuvarcalaindrīprabhṛtayo yasmin tasya divyatīrthauṣadhimataḥ
tattvajñānena samyagjñānena arthān draṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yasya taṃ tattvajñānārthadarśinam
eteṣāṃ ca yathāyogyatayā kāraṇatvamagre vakṣyamāṇakāraṇatvabhedena yonivyāpatsūnneyaṃ, daivaṃ tu sarvatraiva sādhāraṇakāraṇaṃ viśiṣṭadṛṣṭakāraṇādarśane sati kāryadarśanādunneyam

saśabdarukphenatanurūkṣārtaveti anṛtāvapyevambhūtārtavā bhavati, tena vātikapradararūpeyaṃ yonivyāpat; evameva paittika-ślaiṣmika-sānnipātika-yonivyāpadāmapi paittika-kaphaja-sānnipātikapradaratvaṃ varṇayanti
raktayoniriha asṛgdarasañjñayā cikitsāprastāve vaktavyā; tena saiva pradararūpā
the tu etadvyāpadāṃ pradaraṃ bhinnameva manyante, te pradaracikitsārthaṃ prakaraṇāntaramatrādhyāye paṭhiṣyanti
raktapittakarairityādau garbhe labdheapi raktamatipravartate, tenāsyā garbho na tiṣṭhati; sāsṛjā raktayonirityarthaḥ
ye tu ‘sāaprajā’ iti paṭhanti, te “yasyāṃ labdheapi garbhe asṛgatipravartate, sā tādṛśaraktasrutyā aprajā bhavati; iyaṃ ca raktayonirucyata iti raktātisrutyaiva labhyate” iti vyākhyānayanti
yonau garbhāśaye ca tiṣṭhatīti yonigarbhāśayasthaṃ pittam
akāle vāhamānāyā ityādi aprāpte garbhaniṣkramaṇakāle pravāhaṇaṃ kurvantyāḥ
duṣṭaśoṇitajamiti vacanādiha vāyunāaartavaduṣṭirapi kriyate iti darśayati
atra ca yadyapi sāmānyenaiva garbhavināśa uktaḥ, tathāapi putrasyaiva prādhānyāt ‘putraghnī’ iti vyapadeśo jñeyaḥ
vyavāyamatitṛptāyā ityādau atitṛptāyā vyavāyaṃ bhajantyāḥ vyavāyakāle mithyāsthitāṅgāyā annapīḍito vāyuryonerānanamantarmukhaṃ vakrayati; vakrayatītipadena vakratayāantarmukhanayanamabhipretam
bījadoṣāditi sāmānyavacanenāpi ārtavarūpabījadoṣa eva jñeyaḥ, taddoṣasyaiva garbhāśayopaghātakaratvāt
uktaṃ hi- “yadā hyasyāḥ śoṇite garbhāśayabījabhāgaḥ pradoṣamāpadyate tadā vandhyāṃ janayati” (śā.a.4) iti
viṣamamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā maithunādityarthaḥ
doṣairyonirupadrutetyanena doṣaśabdena yonidūṣakā yathoktā gadā ucyante; uktaṃ hi- “rogā hyapi doṣaśabdaṃ labhante” (vi.a.6) iti
pradarādīṃścetyatra yonivyāpadviśeṣameva pradaramāhuḥ, tena yonivyāpatprakāraṃ pradararūpaṃ doṣotpādaṃ varṇayanti; ye tu yonivyāpadbhinnameva pradaramicchanti, teṣāmatra pradarapāṭhe virodho nāstyeva
samprati ādyavyāpaccatuṣṭayaṃ tyaktvā śeṣaṣoḍaśavyāpatsu vātādiliṅgacikitsājñānārthaṃ doṣavibhāgaṃ darśayannāha- āsāmityādi
tāsāṃ vātādivibhāgenoktayonivyāpadāṃ vātādayo dehaṃ svairliṅgaiḥ pīḍayanti, tena vātādyadhikatvaṃ tāsāmupapannamiti bhāvaḥ; anye tu dehaśabdenātra yonisthānamevocyata ityāhuḥ
atra ca vamanādīnāṃ sarvadehopakārakatayā yonigatarogaharaṇeapi sāmarthyaṃ bhavatyeveti jñeyam
balādroṇadvayetyādau balādroṇadvayasya kvāthe iti, balāyāḥ droṇadvayapramāṇakvāthe iti vā, ubhayathāapi droṇadvayamāna eva kvātho bhavati
mudgapīlumāṣākhyaiḥ parṇīśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate; tatra pīluparṇī moraṭā, kecinmūrvāmāhuḥ
hatāvarīmūlatulā ityādau ārdraśatāvarīmūlapīḍanena yāvadraso bhavati tena samaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ vakṣyamāṇakalkaiḥ pācanīyam
niryāsairiti palāśasyaiva niryāsaiḥ, lākṣā ca palāśavyatirekeṇa bhavatīti jñeyam
ajāmūtre kṣīre ceti ajāmūtrakṣīre pratyekaṃ dviguṇe
pāṭhetyādau ambaṣṭhā pāṭhābhedaḥ; anye tu pāṭhābhāgadvayagrahaṇārthaṃ punaḥ ‘ambaṣṭhā’ iti padaṃ varṇayanti
uktaṃ hi- “ghṛte taile ca yoge ca yaddravyaṃ punarucyate
bhāgato dviguṇaṃ taddhi grahaṇīyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ” iti
virecanamityādau virecanameva trivṛtādi pibet, tathā mahātiktakaṃ ghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ pibediti yojyam
garbhaparisrāve yaccoktamiti jātisūtrīye (vi.a.8) garbhasrāvacikitsitaṃ yaduktaṃ tat kārayet
dhāraṇaḥ smṛta iti vāminyā bījadhāraṇakāraka ityarthaḥ
sarvayonivyāpatsu vātacikitsākaraṇe hetumāha- nahi vātādṛta ityādi
aduṣṭe ityādau prākṛte bīje iti sahajaguṇasampanne śukraśoṇitabīje aduṣṭe sati; evambhūtasaṃsarge jīvopakramaṇe satyeva garbhaṃ yoṣitaḥ vindanti; jīvopakramaṇaṃ pūrvakarmapreritāt suyogādbhavati
yasmāt puruṣasya śukramapyatra kāraṇaṃ garbhe, garbhaścāpekṣitaḥ, tasmācchukrasyāpi parīkṣāpūrvikāṃ cikitsāmāha- pañcakarmetyādi
parīkṣaṇāddoṣāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ varṇairyadi duṣṭaṃ bhavati tadā vātādivarṇayogādvātādiharairbheṣajairupācaredityarthaḥ

atrāntare ‘punareva’ ityādigranthaṃ śukradoṣādilakṣaṇacikitsābhidhāyakaṃ kecit paṭhanti; taccānye anārṣaṃ vadanti, upapattiṃ ca varṇayanti yat- śukradoṣā vājīkaraṇenaiva cikitsitāḥ, klaibyaṃ ca śārīre eva pratipāditam, ataḥ punarnābhidhānamarhati, pradaraścaiveha yonivyāpattau cikitsita iti; ye tu paṭhanti te pūrvoktasaṅkṣepasya vistarābhidhānametaditi varṇayanti
evamasyārṣatvavivādeapi kāśmīrādideśānumatatvāt kiñcid vyākaraṇaṃ kurma eva
vyavāyeṣu harṣa eva yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ tasmādutthitam
pauruṣamiti puruṣacihnaṃ, śukreṇaiva hi puruṣo vyajyate
maithunaṃ na ca gacchata iti ucitamaithunakāle maithunāgamanaṃ śukravegapratīghātādeva darśayati
vakṣyāmīti duṣṭaṃ śukraṃ vakṣyāmi rudhirānvayamiti rudhirayuktam
vāyoḥ kṣayād bījakṣayānupapatteḥ vātādīnāṃ ca saṅkṣayādityatra prākṛtavātādikṣaye śarīravaiguṇyādeva śukrānutpādo jñeyaḥ
etaṃ pañcavidhaṃ kecid dhvajabhaṅgaṃ vadanti; tathoktena vātapittakapharaktasannipātabhedena pañcavidhatvamityarthaḥ
tatra śvayathurvedanā meḍhre ityādi vātena, sphoṭāścetyādi pittena, māṃsavṛddhirityādi kaphena, jvarastṛṣṇetyādi raktena, agninevetyādi sannipātena
prāyaśaḥ kṣīyata iti vacanāt kadācit pravayasāmapi śukrasārāṇāṃ vṛṣyasevināṃ ca na kṣīyate śukramiti darśayati
ete ca rasakṣayādayo hetavo vārdhakyasvabhāvādeva bhavanti
vṛṣaṇotpāṭanena cetyantena dhvajabhaṅga uktaḥ, kṣayajaṃ tu mātāpitrorityādinocyate
tatrairaṇḍapatrādiḥ “eraṇḍamūlapalāśāt” (si.a.12) ityādinā granthe vakṣyamāṇaḥ siddhau, mustādiśca yāpanābastiḥ

yaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ pradara ityādau upadravarūpatayā pūrvamuktaḥ pradara iti vadanti; kintu raktayonicikitsite asṛgdarasañjñayaiva raktayonikathanena nirdiṣṭadoṣabhedena ca tatraiva raktayonirasṛgdararūpā vyākṛ(hṛ)tā, teneha punarasṛgdaralakṣaṇābhidhānaṃ pūrvaṭīkākṛtāmasammatam
iha yeapyamuṃ granthaṃ paṭhanti, te tasyaivāyaṃ prabhedaḥ prapañco vāabhidhīyata iti varṇayanti
vayaṃ tu bhūripustakeṣvevaṃ pāṭhadarśanādasya vyākhyānaṃ kurmaḥ

raktaṃ pramāṇamutkramya iti raktaṃ pramāṇādhikaṃ kṛtvā raktamādāya tadrajo yasmādvivardhayati (vṛddhena raktena yojayitvā rajo vivardhayati yasmāt) pavanastasmādasṛgrajomelakarūpatvādayaṃ vyādhirasṛgdara ityucyate
‘pradīryate iti vistārito bhavati’ iti pradaraḥ, ‘asṛg dīryate yasminniti asṛgdara’ ityeṣāapi niruktiratra boddhavyā
pañcarātrānubandhīti udbhūtatayā pañcarātramanubadhnātīti pañcarātrānubandhi, dvādaśarātrānubandhitvādārtavakālasya; kiṃvā dvādaśarātraparyantaṃ garbhārambhakatvamārtavasya natu pravṛttiriti jñeyam
samprati pradaraṃ sacikitsitamabhidhāya strīrogābhidhānaprasaṅgādaparamapi strīrogaṃ stanyadoṣamabhidhitsurāha- dhātrīstanastanyetyādi
trividhāstu yato śiṣyāstato vakṣyāmīti trividhaprabhedeṣu śiṣyeṣu mandabuddhiśiṣyāṇāṃ sukhapratipattyartham
kvāthaṃ caiva sanāgaramityatra nāgarakṛta eva kvātho jñeyaḥ
duṣṭakṣīrasevanādutpannabālavikārāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ darśayitvā yathākartavyaṃ bheṣajamāha- doṣetyādi
doṣā vātādayaḥ, dūṣyāṇi raktādīni, malāḥ śakṛnmūtrasvedādayaḥ
ete doṣādayo ya eva mahatāṃ ta eva bālānāmapi bhavanti, kintu bālān prāpya teṣāṃ doṣādīnāṃ mātrā tvalpatareti viśeṣaḥ; tena doṣādimātrāpekṣā bheṣajamātrāapyalpā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ

dvividhā bālā bhavanti- svatantravṛttayaḥ, paratantravṛttayaśca; tatra paratantratvaṃ bāleṣu vīkṣya vamanādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ kartavyā, vākceṣṭayośca bālasya sāmarthyaṃ vīkṣya svatantratāyāṃ jātāyāṃ vamanādīnāṃ mṛdutvaṃ śāstravidvaidyaḥ prayojayet, tathā saṃśamanamapi bheṣajamalpamātraṃ yathāvyādhi bāleṣu prayojayediti vākyārthaḥ; kiṃvā bāleṣu mṛdutvaṃ paratantratāṃ ca vīkṣya vamanādīnāṃ nivṛttirvidhātavyā, vākceṣṭayośca bāleṣu sāmarthyaṃ vīkṣya saṃśamanaṃ bheṣajamalpamātraṃ yathāvyādhi prayojayediti yojanīyam
rahasyamiti atyantopayuktacikitsābhidhāyakatayā gopyaṃ, na kasmaicit pāpiṣṭhāya prakāśanīyamiti
saptadaśādhyāyā iti cikitsāsthāne saptadaśādhyāyāḥ; te ca carakasaṃskṛtān yakṣmacikitsitāntānaṣṭāvadhyāyān, tathāarśoatīsāravisarpadvivraṇīyamadātyayoktān vihāya jñeyāḥ
etadevetyādi etaccikitsāsthānādyuktaṃ bheṣajam; etadeva hi bheṣajaṃ nāmarūpādinā viśeṣeṇānuktānāṃ sāmānyataśca vātādijanyatayoktān rogānapekṣya tathāyuktaṃ sad bheṣajaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ
atha kathametadbheṣajamanuktānāṃ gadānāṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavatītyāha- doṣadūṣyetyādi

doṣā vātādayaḥ, dūṣyāṇi raktādīni, nidānāni rūkṣādīni, eṣāṃ vyastānāṃ samastānāṃ vā yad viparītaṃ, hitamiti bheṣajaṃ, tat samyagyuktaṃ saduktānuktān gadān dhruvaṃ niyacchati; uktāniti nāmarūpādibhiḥ, anuktāniti nāmarūpādiviśeṣeṇānuktān
etena yadevaitad doṣādiviparītatayā pratipāditaṃ bhavati tadaivānuktānāmapi gadānāṃ doṣādīn buddhvā samyagyuktaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavatīti darśayati

yadyapi ca yannidānaviparītaṃ bheṣajaṃ taddoṣaviparītenaiva grahītuṃ pāryate, yato nidānena doṣaprakopaḥ kriyate, tasya ca doṣasya viparītaṃ yathā rūkṣanidānavṛddhe vāyau rūkṣe yo viparītaḥ snehaḥ sa nidāneapi viparīta eva; tathāapi doṣasyaivāṃśavaiparītyena bheṣajaprayogopadarśanārthaṃ nidānaviparītopādānamiha

yathā- yadi vāyuḥ sarvātmanā prakupitastadā tasya vāyoryadviparītaṃ tailaṃ tat kartavyaṃ, yadā tu śītena vāyurvṛddhastadā sarvātmanā viruddhaṃ tailamutsṛjya yadeva śītatve hitaṃ tasyaiva śītaguṇasya praśamārthaṃ hetuviparītamuṣṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ prayujyate
ata evoktaṃ- “śītenoṣṇakṛtān rogāñ śamayanti bhiṣagvidaḥ” (vi.a.3) ityādi
iha tu doṣādīnāṃ grahaṇād doṣadūṣyasamudāyātmā vyādhirapi labhyate, tena vyādhiviparītamapi bheṣajamavaruddham
viparītaśabdena ceha pratikūlamucyate, na viparītaguṇamātraṃ; tena viparyastārthakāriṇāmapi bheṣajānāṃ grahaṇaṃ bhavati

yattu samānameva kṣīṇānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ dhātūnāṃ vā bheṣajaṃ bhavati tad doṣādikṣayavyādhivṛddhijanakatayā viparītameva, yena tatra na doṣādayaḥ pratikartavyāḥ kintu tatkṣayāḥ, tena kṣaye doṣādiviparītaṃ samyagyuktaṃ saddoṣādīn niyacchatītyuktaṃ, tato doṣādisamānameva viparītamiti na kaściddoṣaḥ
atha yena samyagyogena yuktaṃ bheṣajaṃ kāryakaraṃ bhavati tameva samyagyogamāha- deśakāletyādi
eṣāṃ tu deśādiyogānāmudāharaṇānyācāryeṇaiva kṛtāni ‘āsyādāmāśayasthān’ ityādinā ‘nātidoṣaṃ ca bahvapi’ ityantena
tatra deśa āturarūpa evoktaḥ, bhūmirūpadeśāpekṣā tu yojanā sātmyāpekṣayojanābhidhānenaiva gṛhītā
pramāṇamauṣadhasya trividham- alpaṃ, bahu, samaṃ ca
sātmyaṃ dvividhaṃ deśaśarīrayoḥ; vyādhisātmyaṃ tvauṣadhāntarniviṣṭameva; ṛtusātmyaṃ ca kālagṛhītaṃ; pramāṇasātmyagrahaṇaṃ samyagyogenaiva kṛtam
viparyaye doṣamāha- anyathā hyeṣāṃ pathyamapyanyathā bhavet; eṣāṃ deśādīnām, anyatheti asamyagyoge, pathyamapīti bheṣajaṃ doṣādiparītamapi, anyatheti apathyaṃ bhavati
yāni cāparāṇi balasattvādīni daśavidhadoṣādyantargatāni parīkṣyāṇi nehoktāni tāni doṣādiṣvantarbhāvanīyāni
āsyādityādau tṛtīyāsthāne pañcamī; tenāsyena dattamauṣadhaṃ vamanādyāmāśayasthān gadānāśutaraṃ nihanti
rogyavekṣa iti rogiṇo viśeṣaṃ balavattvamabalavattvaṃ cāvekṣya bhavatītyarthaḥ
atra bhuktādāvityanena kāladvayamucyate; yathā prātareva nirannaṃ, tathā prāgbhojanaṃ ca
tathā paścādityanena ca kāladvayameva prātarbhojanottarakālaṃ, aparaṃ tu sāyaṃ bhojanottarakālam
madhyebhuktaṃ tu yadardhaṃ bhuktvopayujyate, paścāt punarardhaṃ bhujyate
sāmudgaṃ nāma yadbhaktasyādāvante ca bhujyate, tatsamudgavadāhārāvaraṇāt ‘sāmudgaṃ’ ityabhidhīyate
antarābhaktaṃ nāma yadannena saṃyogāt saṃskārādvā tadvimiśritaṃ bhujyate
grāsagrāsāntaraṃ tu bhuktaṃ nāma yad grāsānāṃ madhyeṣu bhujyate
anye tu ‘grāsagrāsāntare’ iti paṭhanti, ekaṃ ca bheṣajakālaṃ vadanti; bhuktamitipadena ca bheṣajakālāntaramabhidhāya daśauṣadhakālapūraṇaṃ kurvanti
ata eva ‘vāyau prāṇe praduṣṭe tu grāsagrāsāntariṣyate’ iti vacanena cācāryeṇaika eva kāla uktaḥ
tatra grāsasya grāsāntaramadhye yadauṣadhaṃ tad grāsagrāsāntaramucyate
bhuktamityasya lakṣaṇaṃ- bhuktaṃ laghunāannena saṃyutamiti; laghunā peyādinā annena saṃyutaṃ yadbhujyate tadbhuktamucyate
sambhojyaṃ tvauṣadhairityādinā tu yadauṣadhasaṃskṛtamannamupayujyate alaghu laghu vā tat sambhuktaśabdenocyate

ye tu ‘grāse grāsāntare’ iti paṭhanti, te prāṇe praduṣṭe grāse grāsāntare vā bheṣajopayogena kāladvayaṃ varṇayanti, laghunāannena saṃyutamitipadaṃ sambhojyamityasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ varṇayanti; bhuktamiti tu padaṃ vivaraṇagrantheapi sarvātmakālopayojanīyabheṣajaviśeṣaṇamiti vyākhyānayanti
evaṃ vyavasthite ‘apāne viguṇe’ ityādibheṣajakālavivaraṇaṃ vyaktameveti na punarvyāhriyate
ete ca kālā yadyapi rogaviśeṣaviṣayatayā vihitāḥ, tathāapi bheṣajasyaivāmī viguṇāpānādividheyasya kālā bhavanti
tenāpāne viguṇe yadauṣadhaṃ tasyāpyete kālā ityādinibandho boddhavyaḥ
yastu vyādhyavekṣaḥ kālaḥ sa vyādhyavasthārūpa iha vaktavya iti viśeṣaḥ
auṣadhāvekṣaṃ kālamabhidhāya vyādhyavekṣaṃ kālamāha- jvare peyā ityādi
atra ca peyākaṣāyasarpiḥkṣīravirecanānāmutsargavidhayā jvarāhādārabhya ṣaḍahe yathākramaṃ deyatvamucyate
ṣaḍahātikrame peyādānaṃ na virodhamāvahati, sāmānyavidhervirodhavidhinā bādhanasya sarvatraivānumatatvāt

tena laṅghitasya kaṣāyaṣaḍahe peyādānaṃ yat prasajyate “laṅghitaṃ vamitaṃ kāle yavāgūbhirupācaret” (ci.a.3) iti vacanena, tadapi na virodhi; tasya ca ślokasya prapañco jvaracikitsita eva kṛta iti neha kriyate
kālaṃ vīkṣyāmayasya tviti avasthārūpaṃ kālaṃ jvaralakṣaṇasyāmayasya vīkṣya ṣaḍahe peyā deyetyarthaḥ
kṣuditi bubhukṣā bhavati, vegamokṣa iti purīṣādinirgamaḥ
etacca jīrṇalakṣaṇaṃ yadyapi rasavimāneapyabhihitaṃ, tathāapīha kālāvekṣayā prakaraṇāgatatvādabhidhānaṃ na punaruktadoṣakaram

tadā bheṣajamādeyamiti vacanena prātaryadauṣadhamanannaṃ dīyate tadbheṣajaṃ pratyavamṛśati, yadannottarakālaṃ tadajīrṇa eva prātarāśe dīyate; kiṃvā bhojanottarakālamapi yadauṣadhaṃ dīyate tadapi dināntarabhukteanne jīrṇa eva dīyate
anyathā syāddhi doṣavadityatra kecid ‘dvidoṣavat’ iti paṭhanti, tena jīryati jīryamāṇe ca doṣadvayayuktaṃ syādityarthaḥ
te ca cayādayo yathā- kaphasya hemante cayaḥ, prakopo vasante, grīṣme praśama ityādisvabhāvaḥ
varjyaṃ sevyaṃ ca ṛtāvuktaṃ, tatraiva ca gurvannādi varjyamuktaṃ, tena tatraiva tajjñeyam
upakramāṇāmityādikaṃ sārdhaṃ ślokaṃ kecit paṭhanti; tamanārṣaṃ vadanti
yathā sasyasyākālavarṣeṇa pīḍā maraṇaṃ vā bhavati, tadvadauṣadhamapi ṣaḍvidhamakālānavekṣamupayuktaṃ kleśāya vināśāya vā bhavati
punaranyathā kālāvekṣaṃ yogaṃ darśayantaḥ kecit paṭhanti- vyādhīnāmṛtvahorātraniyamādiślokacatuṣṭayam, etadapi nātiprasiddham
yadyapi ceha bheṣajasya pramāṇaṃ śṛṅgagrāhikayā noktaṃ, tathāapīha “doṣapramāṇānurūpo hi bhaiṣajyapramāṇavikalpo balapramāṇaviśeṣāpekṣo bhavati” (vi.a.8) ityādinoktaṃ madhyabheṣajapramāṇaṃ jñeyam
aucityāditi abhyāsāt, apathyamapi yadyasya puruṣasya sātmyaṃ tadekāntāt tyajan na sukhaṃ labhate iti yojanā
etenāpathyamapi sātmyamekāntāt tyajataḥ sukhaṃ na bhavatīti darśayati; pathyasya sātmyasya parityāge tu nitarāmeva duḥkhaṃ bhavatīti darśayati
tena deśasātmyaśabdena taddeśajātatvenaiva puruṣairyat sevyate tat sādhāraṇaṃ sātmyaṃ gṛhyate
puruṣasātmyagrahaṇena tu yat pratiniyatapuruṣasyaivābhyāsāt sātmyatāṃ yāti tat puruṣapratiniyataṃ sātmyaṃ gṛhyate

sātmyamicchanti” (sū.a.6) ityanena deśasātmyamuktaṃ, taddeśaviparītaguṇatvena taddeśanivāsināṃ puruṣāṇāṃ sātmyamuktam; idaṃ tu deśaviparītaguṇaṃ bhavatu mā bhavatu vā, tathāapi taddeśanivāsināmabhyāsena sātmyaṃ tadiha sātmyamucyata iti viśeṣaḥ
puruṣasātmyasya prāyaḥ pratipuruṣaṃ bhinnatvenāniyatatvācchṛṅgagrāhikayā udāharaṇaṃ na kṛtam
uktadeśādiparīkṣāvyatirekeṇa kevalaṃ yathoktayogaireva cikitsāṃ kurvato doṣamāha- yogairevetyādi
deśādyajña ityanena deśādyajñānād deśādiviguṇacikitsākārakaṃ puruṣaṃ lakṣayati
yasmādvayobalādibhedā bahavaścikitsāvekṣaṇīyāścikitsakānāṃ matāḥ santi, tasmād deśādinirapekṣā cikitsā kriyamāṇā na īpsitaṃ sādhayatīti bhāvaḥ
gūḍhacāriṇāmiti antaḥsandhigatatvenāvyaktagatīnāṃ doṣāṇāṃ viruddhābhimatāapi kriyā kadācidbhavati, viruddhābhimatā viparītatvena khyātā

kiṃvā na kevalaṃ vayobalādibhedā bahavo matāḥ kintu antaḥsandhimārgāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ gūḍhacāriṇāṃ bhedā bahavaścikitsāvekṣaṇīyā matā iti; tato gūḍhacāriṇo doṣabhedena cikitsābhedo bhavet kadācidityādi yojanīyam
tatheti tathā uktena prakāreṇa uṣṇaṃ pittamuṣṇaiḥ svedādibhiḥ śamayanti
tvaggatasyoṣmaṇo rodhāditi tvaṅmārgeṇa nirgacchata ūṣmaṇo rodhāt
śītakṛccānyathāaguroriti aguroruṣṇasyāpi piṣṭoaghanaśca lepaḥ śītakṛt syādityarthaḥ

dravyeṣu svinnajagdheṣvevaṃ teṣveva vikriyeti anena makṣikāviṣṭhārambhakeṣu dravyeṣu makṣikājaṭharāgnisvinneṣu evaṃ vikriyā makṣikāśarīragatatayā viṣṭhāgatatayā ca viruddhā kriyā yathoktā bhavatīti vākyārthaḥ; svinnajagdheṣviti khāditānantaramagnipakveṣu, vikriyeti viruddhakriyā
asmin pakṣe ‘jagdheṣu’ ityasya sthāne ‘dagdheṣu’ iti paṭhanti
tatra lājasaktūnāṃ siddhapiṇḍeṣu svinnatayā lājaviparītā gurutvenāgnivadhādikārikā kriyā; tathā utpalanāleṣu dagdheṣu kṣāratayā śītaviruddhā kriyā chedanādikriyā ityādyudāhāryam
yadā ‘yasmin jagdheṣu’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tadāapi svinnānantaraṃ jagdheṣviti kṛtvā saktusiddhapiṇḍaka evodāharaṇaṃ jñeyam

doṣauṣadhādīni upakalpanīye (sū.a.15) ekādaśa paṭhitāni, vimāne ca dvādaśa paṭhitāni, tena tadgrahaṇenehoktaṃ daśasaṅkhyatvaṃ vyāhanyate; tena dṛḍhabalenaiva nirūhaprastāve yāni doṣauṣadhādīni daśa nirdiṣṭāni “samīkṣya doṣauṣadhadeśakālasātmyāgnisattvaukavayobalāni” (si.a.3) ityanena, tānyevātra daśa gṛhyante
etaddaśaka evopakalpanīyoktaikādaśakasya parīkṣyasya tathā vimānoktadvādaśakasya cāvarodhaḥ

tathāhi- upakalpanīye etaddaśata anye prakṛtiśarīrāhārā uktāḥ; tatra śarīrasya prakṛteśca deśaśabdena bhūmyāturagrāhiṇā grahaṇam, uktaṃ hi- “deśo bhūmirāturaśca” (vi.a.8) iti; āhārasya tu sātmyagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇam
vimāne ca yo dvādaśo vikāraḥ paṭhitaḥ, sa doṣagrahaṇagṛhītaḥ
yattu āṣāḍhavarmaprabhṛtibhiratadguṇabahuvrīhipakṣāśrayeṇopakalpanīyoktānāmeva daśatvaṃ vyākhyātamiha, tad hyaśābdamasaṅgataṃ ca
samprati cikitsayā nivṛtte vyādhau kartavyaṃ darśayannāha- nivṛttoapi punarityādi
nivṛtta iva nivṛttaḥ, kiñcidavaśiṣṭadoṣarūpamūlaḥ; na tu sarvathā nivṛttaḥ, tasya tulyahetunā pratyāgamanavirodhāt, tathā sūkṣmānaladṛṣṭāntavisadṛśatvācca
apiśabdena nivṛttoapi yadā svalpena hetunā āyāti tadā praśamābhimukho nitarāmevāyātīti darśayati

ūnabhāvāt acayaprakopāt; acayeapi ca doṣāṇāṃ prakopo bhavatyeva; yathā- balavadvigrahādibhirvāyoḥ, pitasya krodhādibhiḥ, śleṣmaṇaśca divāsvapnādibhiḥ; ayaṃ cācayaprakopo ghanāvayavopacayākartṛtvāt ‘ūnabhāvāt prakopa’ ityucyate
doṣoantaḥkupito mahānityatra kāṭhinyāt kupita ūnabhāvācca kupito mahān bhavatīti vyavasthā
kāṭhinyāddhi acayakopoantareva prāyo bhavati, ūnabhāvāttu acayaprakopaḥ prasaraṇasvabhāvatvāttu laghucayabandhasāro(?)api mahān bhavati
mṛdvalpatāṃ nīta iti yathākramaṃ, tena yaḥ kāṭhinyādantaḥkupitaḥ sa mṛdutāṃ nītaḥ, sthūlabhāvānmāhān kupitoalpatāṃ nītaḥ; mṛdudoṣakara iti alpavikārakaraḥ
kiṃvā kāṭhinyāditi doṣadūṣyasambandhakṛtasthairyāt, ūnabhāvāditi yathoktakāṭhinyaṃ vinā
upajāyata iti mṛdutayā alpatayā vā anuvartate

jñātvaivamiti pathyamidamasya bheṣajam, ayaṃ tu vyādhiriti, mahattvādgambhīratvādvā sarvathā na nivartate magnaḥ, evaṃ jñātvā tathaiva pūrvaprayuktaprayogasya vṛddhiṃ vā abhyāsaṃ vā kārayet, na tatprayogāśrayaprayogāntaraṃ kuryāt; vṛddhirmātrādhikyam, abhyāsaḥ satatopayogaḥ
ayamarthoanyatrāpyuktaḥ- “abhyasyamānāḥ kramaśastu yogā jayanti rogān balinaḥ sthirāṃśca

uktasatatopayoge yadi pathyaṃ sātatyāt satatopayogāddhetordveṣyatvamāgataṃ bhavati, tathā svādvabhāvādvā aniṣṭatvāddveṣyatvamāgataṃ bhavati, tadāapi tadeva pathyaṃ taistaiḥ kalpanāvidhibhiḥ svarasaśṛtakalkādibhiḥ sūdaśāstroktaiśca vidhānaiḥ punarāturasya priyatvamāpādayet
svādvapi satatopayogādapriyaṃ bhavatīti dṛṣṭam, asvādu tu svabhāvādevāpriyam
atra cātitṛṣṇādibhyaḥ sukhopabhogānte virecane arucau kartavyamabhidhāya ruciviśeṣe kartavyatāmāha- laulyāditi

atra laulyādeva hi kasyacitpuruṣasya kasmiṃścidviśeṣe rucirbhavati; doṣakṣayādapi kvacidrucirbhavati; tathā vyādhiyuktasya ca peye rucirbhavati; vyādhimahimnā kvacidrucirbhavati, yathā- pāṇḍuroge mṛttikāyāṃ; vaidharmyācca rucirbhavati, yathā- snigdhasya rūkṣe, madhurasya cāmle; yaduktam- “amlena kecidvihatā manuṣyā mādhuryayoge praṇayībhavanti” (su.sū.a.46) iti; kiṃvā vyādhivaidharmyādityeka eva hetuḥ; atrodāharaṇaṃ yathā- śleṣmajvareamlakaṭukecchutā
etairlaulyādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ janitā ruciḥ, āsu ruciṣu laulyādijanitāsu pathyopacāraḥ syāt, pathyameva deyaṃ nāpathyamityarthaḥ
atra yadi pathyaṃ ca bhavati ruciviṣayaṃ ca bhavati tadā sādhveva, yadā tu ruciviṣayamapathyaṃ syāt tadā kartavyamāha- yogenādyaṃ vikalpayediti

anyaistu laulyādidoṣajā trividhāatrārucirucyate; tatra laulyajāyāmarucau pathyopacāraḥ, doṣakṣayajāyāmarucau yogeneti samyagyogenopacāraḥ, vyādhivaidharmyajāyāṃ cādyamadanīyaṃ vyādhipratyanīkaprayogairupakalpayediti vyākhyātam
iti śrīnārāyaṇadattātmajaśrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne yonivyāpaccikitsitaṃ nāma triṃśoadhyāyaḥ
cikitsitasthāne tu tatra tatra vihitavamanavirecanayoḥ prayogān vistareṇābhidhātuṃ cikitsādhikṛtayogasthānarūpakalpasthānamucyate

yadyapi cikitsāyāṃ basterapi pratipāditatvādbastyabhidhāyakaṃ siddhisthānamapi cikitsāṅgatayāabhidhātavyaṃ, tathāapi pañcakarmaṇāmautsargikapravṛttau vamanavirecanapūrvikaiva bastikarmapravṛttirbhavatīti kṛtvā vamanavirecanābhidhāyakaṃ kalpasthānameva bastyabhidhāyakasiddhisthānādagreabhidhīyate
kalpābhidhāneapi virecanasyautsargikapravṛttau vamanapūrvikaiva pravṛttirbhavatīti vamanapūrvakatvādvirecanasya vamanakalpā evāgreabhidhātavyāḥ
vamanakalpeṣvapi vamanadravyaśreṣṭhatvānmadanaphalasyaivādau kalpoabhidhīyate; śreṣṭhatvaṃ ca madanaphalasya ‘vamanadravyāṇāṃ madanaphalāni śreṣṭhatamānyācakṣateanapāyitvāt’ ityanenātraiva vakṣyati
atra sukhāyopabhogo yeṣāṃ te sukhopabhogāḥ, na tadātvasukha upabhogo yeṣāṃ te sukhopabhogāḥ, tathāhi tadātveasukhopabhogānāṃ kovidārādīnāmagrahaṇaṃ syāt

kalpanārthamiti padasya kriyayā sambandhamadarśayitvaiva tadvyākhyānapratyayanārthaṃ vyākaroti bhedārthaṃ vibhāgārthaṃ cetyartha iti; tatra bhedārthamiti vamanavirecanadravyaprayogabhedārthaṃ, te ca prayogabhedāḥ “trayastriṃśadyogaśataṃ praṇītaṃ phaleṣu” (sū.a.4) ityādikāḥ; vibhāgārthamiti atra ‘phalapippalīnāṃ dvau bhāgau kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa’, ityādivakṣyamāṇadravyavibhāgārtham

kriyāyā itikartavyatāyā vidhiḥ kriyāvidhiḥ, svarasādirūpatayā karaṇānīti yāvat; tasya kriyāvidherviśeṣaṇaṃ- sukhopāyasyeti; sukhārthaḥ sukho vā upāyo yasya sa sukhopāyaḥ, tasya samyagupakalpanārthamiti samyagupadeśārtham
ūrdhvaṃ mukhena doṣanirharaṇaṃ bhajata iti ūrdhvabhāgam
adho gudena doṣanirharaṇaṃ bhajata iti adhobhāgam
na caivaṃ sati vamanavirecanavannirūheapi virecanasañjñāprasaktirudbhāvanīyā, yataḥ paṅkajaśabdavadiyaṃ virecanasañjñā vamanavirecanayoreva yogarūḍhyā vartate

samprati dvayorapi vamanavirecanadravyayoḥ sādhāraṇoṣṇatīkṣṇatvādiguṇayogakṛtadoṣaviṣyandanādisādhāraṇakāryadarśanapūrvakamagnivāyvātmakatvādiviśiṣṭadharmayogakṛtaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca kāryaṃ vamanavirecanarūpaṃ darśayannāha- tatroṣṇetyādi
dhamanīranusṛtyeti sakaladehagatā dhamanīranusṛtya; sakaladehagatadhamanyanusaraṇaṃ ca vīryeṇa jñeyaṃ, na sākṣāt
aṇupravaṇabhāvāditi aṇutvāt pravaṇabhāvācca; pravaṇatvamiha koṣṭhagamanonmukhatvam, aṇutvaṃ ca aṇumārgasañcāritvam
iti lakṣaṇoddeśa iti anantaragranthena vamanavirecanadravyasvarūpābhidhānaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ

atra ca prakaraṇe sāmānyenaiva vamanavirecanadravyāṇām ‘āgneyatvādviṣyandayanti’ ityanenāgneyatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ; punaśca viśeṣeṇa ‘agnivāyvātmakatvāt’ iti padena vamanadravyasyāgnyātmakatvaṃ pratipādyate; tena, sāmānye viśeṣe ca vamanadravyāṇāmāgneyatvapratipādanāt prakṛṣṭamāgneyatvaṃ bhavati; virecanadravyāṇāṃ tu sāmānyoktāgneyatvasambandhād viśeṣaguṇakathanaprastāve ca salilapṛthivyātmakatvābhidhānādvamanadravyāpekṣayāapakṛṣṭamāgneyatvaṃ bhavati
vamanaṃ ca hareddoṣān prakṛtyā gatamanyathā” (su.ci.a.33) ityanena

yaccātrocyate-vamanaṃ yadyūrdhvabhāgaharatvaprabhāvādūrdhvayati, tadāagnivāyvātmakatvāditi hetuvarṇanaṃ na yujyate; yataḥ, yat sopapattikaṃ kāryaṃ na bhavati tat prabhāvakṛtamiti vyapadiśyate; uktaṃ hi- “prabhāvoacintya ucyate” (sū.a.26) iti

tanna, yataḥ prabhāvasyaiveha vamanakārye vāyvagnyātmakaguṇatayā vāyvagnyātmakatvaṃ heturupadṛ(di)śyate, na tu vāyvagnyātmakatvaṃ svatantro vamanahetuḥ; tathāhi sati yadanyadapi vāyvagnyātmakamūrdhvabhāgadoṣaharatvaprabhāvarahitaṃ, tadapi vamanakaraṃ syāt; yathā- kaṭukarase dravye tat syāt; tasmāt prabhāvaguṇatayaiva hetuvarṇanam
samprati kalpasthānavaktavyatayā ṣaḍvirecanaprayogaśatānyanatisaṅkṣepavistaraprayogopadarśanapūrvakaṃ pratijānīte- tatra phaletyādinā ṣaḍvirecanayogaśatāni vyākhyāsyāma ityantena
tatra kṛtavedhanāntānāṃ vicchedapāṭhena vamanaprayogaprayojyatvaṃ, śyāmādīnāṃ virecanaprayogaprayojyatvaṃ ca darśayati

atraiva vamane virecane caikaikeṣāṃ punarvastūnāṃ madanaphalādīnāṃ śyāmādīnāṃ ca bahavaḥ prayogā abhidhīyante, na punarekaikameva dravyaṃ vamanakārakaṃ virecanakārakaṃ vā; svalpasaṅkhyāprayogeṇa grahaṇasukhatā vamanavirecanayogasya bhavati, kāryaṃ ca sidhyatītyāśaṅkyāha- nānāvidhetyādi yāvadrogāvasthādīnāṃ nānāprabhāvavattvācceti

asyārthaḥ- yasmānnānāvidhadeśakālasambhavāḥ, nānāvidhāsvādāḥ, nānāvidhavīryāḥ, nānāvidhavipākāḥ, nānāvidhaprabhāvāśca madanaphalādikā oṣadhyaḥ, tathā tatsaṃskārakāḥ kovidārādikā oṣadhya upalabhyante; puruṣāśca deha-doṣa-prakṛti-vayo-balāgni-bhakti-sātmya-rogāvasthābhinnā nānāvidhā dṛśyante; tena naikaṃ dravyaṃ sarvasmin dehadoṣādau yaugikaṃ, sarvatra kāle vā prāpyate sarvatra deśe vā; tasmāddehadoṣādinā bhedavati puruṣe bahūnyeva dravyāṇi bahubhiśca prayogairupakalpitāni yathāyogyatayā yathāprāpti ca prayoktuṃ śakyante; ato bahunāmeva madanādidravyāṇāṃ bahuprakāraprayogāṇāmupanyāso yukta iti bhāvaḥ
deho nānā sthūlakṛśādibhedena, bhaktiḥ icchā, avasthāśabdeneha rogāvasthaiva grāhyā, ādiśabdeneha sattvāhārayorgrahaṇam
atha kiṃ prabhedānmadanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṭprayogaśatāni bhavanti, yenādhikāḥ prayogā nābhidhīyanta ityāśaṅkyāha- asaṅkhyeyetyādi

vikalpamārgopadarśanārthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanāsamarthān bhiṣajaḥ prati etat ṣaṭprayogaśatopadarśanaṃ kartavyādhikaprayogakalpanāmārgopadarśakaṃ, tenāpareapyatra prayogāḥ kalpanīyāḥ; granthe niḥśeṣaprayogānabhidhānaṃ prayogāṇāmasaṅkhyeyatvenāśakyatvādeva
uktaṃ hyanyatra- “etāvanto hyalamalpabuddhīnāṃ vyavahārāya, buddhimatāṃ ca svālakṣaṇyānumānayuktikuśalānāmanuktārthajñānāya” (sū.a.4) iti
samprati vamanavirecanadravyāṇāṃ deśādisampattyā guṇotkarṣaṃ darśayannāha- tānītyādi
deśādi samyag vyākurvannāha- tatra trividha ityādi
atra kecijjāṅgalādideśalakṣaṇagranthaṃ na paṭhanti, tattu janapadoddhvaṃsanīye paṭhitamiti kṛtvehānārṣaṃ vadanti
yaistu janapadoddhvaṃsanīye jāṅgalādilakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhyate, tairatra paṭhanīya evāyaṃ granthaḥ
tatra yāni kālajātānītyanenaiva kālasampaducyate; kālajātānīti svakālabhūtāni

grīṣme mūlāni śiśire veti kathanena yānyāgneyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni grīṣme, yāni saumyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni śiśire, grāhyāṇīti vyavasthāṃ sūcayati; uktaṃ hyanyatra- “saumyānyauṣadhāni saumyeṣvṛtuṣvādadīta, āgneyānyāgneyeṣu” (su.sū.a.36) iti
saṅkṣepeṇa madanaphalādīnāṃ vātādibhedena bhāvanāloḍanadravyāṇyāha- tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjītetyādi
antare iti madhye, sa ca grīṣmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinānyeva madhyo jñeyaḥ
maitre muhūrta iti śivabhujagamitrādīnāṃ madhye mitradevatāke, evaṃ maitre muhūrte
madhuvadiṣṭagandho yeṣāṃ tāni, yāni madhviṣṭagandhāni bhavanti tāni grāhyāṇīti darśayati

dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannamityanena abhyaṅge kriyamāṇe snehasahacaritasvedopapādanaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā vidhīyate, “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ” (si.a.1) ityanena pānaprayujyamānasnehasya saptarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā prakarṣa ucyate iti na virodhaḥ
