etaccābhyaṅgasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraṇaṃ pānasnehāntadivasamārabhya kriyate, tena snehapānaviśrāmadinena samaṃ dvyahatryahapūraṇamabhyaṅgasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati
snehapānācca yadviśrāmadinam, “ekāhoparatastadvadbhuktvā pracchardanaṃ pibet” (sū.a.13) ityanenoktaṃ, tathaivehāpi
anatisnigdhamityādinā vamanadina eva ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānapūrvakaṃ vamanamanatisnigdhapuruṣaviṣayaṃ brūte
anye tu pūrvadina evānatisnigdhasya ghṛtamātrāṃ pītavata eva yavāgvāḥ pānamāhuḥ, “peśalairvividhairannairdoṣānutkleśya dehinaḥ
athāparedyuḥ pūrvāhṇe sādhāraṇe kāle vamanadravyakaṣāyakalkacūrṇasnehānāmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityādi suśrutokteḥ
yaṣṭīmadhukasya kovidārādiṣu vicchedapāṭha uttaraprayogeṣu kovidārāderyaṣṭīmadhuvirahitasya grahaṇārthaḥ
kovidāraḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ, sa śaradi puṣpati; karbudārastu kāñcanāraḥ, sa vasante puṣpati; nīpaḥ kadambaḥ, vidulaḥ vetasaḥ, śaṇapuṣpī ghaṇṭāravā, sadāpuṣpī arkapuṣpikā, pratyakpuṣpī apāmārgaḥ
rātrimuṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtamiti śṛtakaṣāyāt kaṣāyāntaropadarśakaṃ pakṣāntaraṃ; kiṃvā, kaṣāyapāna eva śītakaṣāyavidhānamihocyate
punaḥ punariti yāvat pittāgamanaṃ na bhavati tāvat punaḥ punaḥ kaṣāyaṃ pibedityarthaḥ
yadyapi ca ghreyādivamanayogeṣu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathāapi ‘sarveṣu’ iti padaṃ bāhulyārtham
vamanārthakaṣāye uṣṇe madhuprakṣepo virodhitvānna yujyate, uktaṃ hi- “madhūṣṇamuṣṇārtamathavā” (sū.a.27) ityādi, evamāśaṅkya samādhānamāha na coṣṇavirodho madhuna ityādi
doṣanirharaṇācceti madhūṣṇaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uṣṇe iṣyate, tasya doṣanirharaṇādeva na virodho bhavatīti darśayati
phalapippalīnāṃ dvau bhāgāvityādau phalapippalīnāṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kartavyaṃ; tatra bhāgadvayaṃ ṣaḍguṇena kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa kṣāraparisrāvaṇavidhivadekaviṃśativārān parisrāvaṇīyam
kovidārādīnāṃ cāṣṭānāmaṣṭau kaṣāyāḥ pṛthak parisrāvaṇe prayoktavyāḥ

yena ca kaṣāyeṇa phalapippalībhāgadvayaṃ parisrāvya haritakyādiparimāṇā mātrā tṛtīyabhāgaphalapippalīkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ; evamaṣṭau harītakyādimātrayā nirdiṣṭāḥ phalapippalīyogā bhavanti
phalapippalyā kṣīrapākavidhinā sādhitaṃ kṣīraṃ phalapippalīkṣīram; ayameko yogaḥ
ete kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayena ghṛtayogena ca samaṃ pañca yogā adhyāyasaṅgrahe vaktavyā
phalapippalīcūrṇānītyādau phalādiṣaṭkaṣāyabhedena kṛtatvāt ṣaḍ vartiprayogā jñeyāḥ
atrāpi ca tathā lehādau ca sāmānyoktena madhuprakṣepo yuktaḥ; taṃ caike madhunaḥ pākavirodhānnānumanyante
vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, svādukaṇṭakaḥ vikaṅkataḥ, śārṅgeṣṭā guñjā, suṣavī kāravellakaṃ, dvīpikā hiṃsrā, ‘kaṇṭakārī’ ityanye
corakaḥ gandhadravyaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, paripelavaṃ kaivartamustakaṃ, sthauṇeyakaḥ granthiparṇakaṃ, pārāvatapadī jyotiṣmatī, aśokarohiṇī aśokasadṛśapatrā latā, ‘kaṭurohiṇī’ ityanye
kecidatra sthauṇeyakaṃ parityajyāpākīpādyā viṃśatiṃ pūrayanti, apākīpādī svanāmakhyātā
etenaiva ca kalpenetyādinā sumukhādipañcadaśadravyakaṣāyeṇa pṛthak śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ karaṇāt pañcadaśa yogā bhavanti
evaṃ militvā śaṣkulīpūpayoḥ pṛthak ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti
poṭā ikṣugandhā; daṇḍairakā gundrākhyagulmaḥ, nalo vā
tasya kalpaneti ya evambhūtaiḥ paryāyairvyākhyātastasyeyaṃ kalpanā
madanaphalayogānāṃ navādisaṅkhyotkarṣanirāsārthaṃ sukhasmaraṇārthaṃ ca tān saṅgraheṇāha- nava yogā ityādi
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamoadhyāyaḥ
evaṃ yathāyathaiṣāmanapāyitvaprakarṣaḥ, tathā tathā pūrvaniveśanaṃ jñeyam
phalapuṣpāśrayamiti vacanena jīmūtasya patranālādiṣu vamanaprayogaṃ niṣedhayati
tridoṣaghnamiti yathāsvaṃ vātaharādidravyayuktaṃ, tathā vātādiharadravyakalpitaṃ ca sat tridoṣaghnaṃ bhavati
nirvṛtte iti utpannamātre phale, tatra phalaiḥ kṣīraṃ sādhayitvā tena kṣīreṇa peyā sādhanīyā
romaśe iti upagataromṇi phale, atrāpi romaśaphalasādhitakṣīrāt santānikā jñeyā
ete ca yogāḥ kṣīrasambandhena avidhīyamānakṣīrākārā api kṣīraprayogatvenaiva saṅgrahe ‘ṣaṭ kṣīre’ ityanena saṅgrahītavyāḥ
atra yoge pakvajīmūtakaphalamevādhikṛtaṃ; tathā, uttarayogeṣvapi pakvameva phalamadhikṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ, “phalaṃ paryāgataṃ grāhyaṃ” ityautsargikavacanāt
phalavaditi madanaphale yathā aṣṭau mātrāyogā uktāstathehāpi kartavyāḥ, viśeṣatastu etāḥ kolamātrāḥ kartavyāḥ, na tu phalavaddharītakyādipramāṇāḥ kartavyā ityarthaḥ
ṣaṭ kṣīre ityādinā saṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva yathāsthānam
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyoadhyāyaḥ
muṣṭiṃ prādeśasammitamiti pradeśinyā mūlaparyantakṛtamuṣṭiparimāṇam; evaṃ ca nātra muṣṭiśabdaḥ palavacanaḥ
kṣīraprasthe śṛtamiti vacanāt kṣīraprasthe yathoktamānamikṣvākumāvāpya caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ dattvā kṣīraṃ sādhanīyam
jīmūtake yathā “payaḥ puṣpeasya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā
romaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaramaromaśe” (ka.a.2) ityanenoktaṃ, tathehāpi yogacatuṣṭayaṃ karaṇīyam
haritapāṇḍūnāmikṣvākuphalānāṃ surāmaṇḍe jīmūtakavadyogaḥ kartavyaḥ; jīmūtakavidhānātideśena “āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe muditvā prasrutaṃ pibet” (ka.a.2) iti granthoktavidhānamihāpi bhavati
triguṇakṣīrasādhitamiti triguṇena kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ; tacca caturguṇena toyena sādhanīyam
gandhasampatsukhocita iti gandhasampat sugandhavattvaṃ, tayā gandhasampadā sukhamucitamabhyastaṃ yena saḥ; avacūrṇitekṣvākuphalarasapuṣpaṃ mālyamāghrāyaiva vamatyanabhyastadurgandha iti bhāvaḥ
pūrvavaditi jīmūtakavat, tena “tathā jīmūtakakṣīrāt” (ka.a.2) ityādinoktavidhānena jīmūtakasthāne ikṣvākuphalaṃ dattveha ghṛtaṃ sādhanīyam
tāni ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmanyatamakaṣāyeṣvāsutya vimṛditāni pātavyāni
anye tu daśabījādārabhya pañcāśadbījaparyantaṃ doṣādyapekṣayā pātavyaṃ; tatra madanādikaṣāyabhedādeva yogabheda ityāhuḥ
kaṣāyairityādinā madanaphalasadṛśavidhā aṣṭau mātrālakṣitāḥ prayogā ucyante
bilvetyādinā eko lehaḥ, tathā ‘kalpa’ ityādinā catvāro lehā ante draṣṭavyāḥ, evaṃ pañca lehāḥ
atra ca “tataśca kuḍavaṃ yāvattoyamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet” iti vacanādbilvamūlakaṣāyasyāṣṭāvañjalayo deyāḥ, tataścaturbhāgāvaśeṣeṇa kuḍavadvayam
‘caturthaḥ phāṇitasya ca’ ityasya sthāne ‘trayastrikaṭukasya ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti
mahājālinī pītakoṣātakī, kṛtavedhanaḥ ghoṣakabhedaḥ ‘jyotsnikā” iti khyātaḥ
yāvat syāttantumadityādinā lehapākalakṣaṇamāha; etacca lakṣaṇaṃ lehāntareṣvapi pācanīyeṣu jñeyam
pramathyāṃ ca pibedanviti atīsāracikitsite “pippalī nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ” (ci.a.19) ityādinoktapramathyānāṃ madhyeanyatamapramathyākṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ pibedityarthaḥ
‘pramathyāṃ ca’ ityasya sthāne kecit ‘manthaṃ cāpi’ iti paṭhanti
ghṛtaṃ yadyapi vardhamānapūrvapaṭhitaṃ, tathāapi chandonurodhādiha paścāt paṭhitam
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyoadhyāyaḥ
sthirāśca guravaśca ye ityatra ‘gadāḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ
puṣpādiṣvityādinā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena nirdiṣṭāścatvāraḥ kṣīraprayogāḥ, pañcamaśca surāyogoatidiśyate; te ca ‘payaḥ puṣpeasya’ (ka.
jīrṇaśuṣkāṇāmityādinā navakaṣāyayogānāha, tathā ‘jātyāḥ’ ityādinā ekādaśa kaṣāyayogān vakṣyati; evaṃ viṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogāḥ saṅgrahe vakṣyamāṇāḥ pūryante
bījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalamiti yatra bījāni baddhāni santi sa bījakaṇṭha uddhṛto yasmin tadbījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam
evambhūtaṃ ca phalaṃ kaṣāyeṇa saguḍena pūritaṃ rātrivyuṣitaṃ kartavyam
uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- dhāmārgavakalpe- “dhāmārgavaphaleṣūddhṛtabījamadhyeṣu saguḍoṣitāḥ kovidārādikaṣāyā nava” iti
gulmināṃ cāvasthāyāṃ vamanaṃ hitameva, teneha gulmaviṣayatayā vamanopadarśanaṃ na virodhi
utpalādīnāṃ cātra bhedoavivakṣitaḥ utpalasyaika eva ghreyayogaḥ
tathā pṛṣatetyādidaśayogaiḥ samaṃ śakṛdrasayogasambandhāddvādaśa śakṛdyogā ucyante
pṛṣataḥ binducitritahariṇaḥ; ṛṣyaḥ nīlāṇḍaḥ, kuraṅgaḥ cañcalagatiḥ, aśvataraḥ vegasaraḥ, śvadaṃṣṭraḥ caturdaṃṣṭro mṛgaviśeṣaḥ
atra leheṣu dhāmārgavāditaradravyacūrṇasya samānatvaṃ; madhuśarkarayośca tāvatī mātrā yāvatyā lehatvāpattirbhavati
pittoṣmasahite kaphe iti udyatoṣmaguṇena pittena yukte kaphe; anye tu pittoṣmaśabdena pittoṣmaṇā kṛtaṃ jvaramāhuḥ
uktaṃ hi jatūkaṇa “dhānyatumbururasena kalko viṣanut” iti
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturthoadhyāyaḥ

atra vatsakastrīpuruṣabhedena yadyapi guṇabhedaḥ prayogabhedo vā na pratipāditaḥ, tathāapi strīrūpavatsakeapuṣpaphalatvādiviśiṣṭalakṣaṇayukteapyaviśeṣeṇobhābhyāmevāmayanivṛttiḥ syādityetadarthamubhayorapi samānaguṇatā jñātavyā
kṣaudrasaindhavayogo yadyapi sarvavamaneṣveva sāmānyena vihitaḥ, tathāapīha ‘lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam’ iti vacanādutkarṣo lavaṇasaindhavayorabhidhīyate
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamoadhyāyaḥ
ete ca saṅgraheakṣīrarūpā api kṣīravikāratayā kṣīraśabdenaiva gṛhītāḥ ‘kṣīre dvau dvau’ iti vacanena
kusumādīnāmiti kṛtavedhanasya puṣpādīnāṃ “payaḥ puṣpeasya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā
surā caiteṣu pūrvavaditi yathā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena kṣīrādayaḥ kartavyāstathā surā ca kartavyā
phalavaditi madanaphalaṃ yathā yaṣṭīmadhukādibhiḥ pīyate, tathaitadapi pātavyamityarthaḥ
eke navakaṣāyaprayogeṣu śeṣavidhipratyāyakaṃ lehaṃ paṭhanti- “kvāthayitvā rasaṃ tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet” ityādi, tacca saṅgatārtham
uktaṃ ca jatūkarṇe- “atra jīrṇabījānāṃ madanaphalavat kaṣāyairlehā bhavanti nava” iti

śālmalīmūlamādiḥ yeṣāṃ te śālmalīmūlāḥ śālmalyādayo vimānapaṭhitā daśa śālmalīśālmalakabhadraparṇyelāparṇyupodikoddāladhanvanarājādanopacitrāgopyantāḥ (vi.a.8); eṣāṃ cūrṇānāṃ picchābhiryuktyā kṛtatvenaiva daśa yogā jñeyāḥ
śālmalakaḥ śālmalībhedaḥ, rohitako vā; bhadraparṇī gambhārī; elāparṇī nāgabalā, ahiṃsretyanye; rājādanāṃ kṣīrikā, upacitrā dantī, gopī sārivā
vartikriyāḥ ṣaṭ phalavaditi “phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat” (ka.a.1) ityādinā granthena yā vartikriyā uktā madanakalpe, tadvadihāpi kṛtavedhanacūrṇānāṃ ṣaḍvartikriyāḥ kartavyāḥ
phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathetyanena kṛtavedhanasādhitakṣīrādutthitaṃ navanītaṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyaṃ madanaphalaghṛtavadityarthaḥ
atraiva kvāthapādike kalke kartavye kṣveḍasya pūrṇo bhāgo deyaḥ, phalādīnāṃ ca pratyekaṃ kṣveḍādardhabhāgikatvam
siddhamiti ikṣurasena miśritaṃ sat sādhitaṃ pibedityarthaḥ uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “kṣveḍamikṣurase śṛtam” iti
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭhoadhyāyaḥ
vamanārthakalpanānantaraṃ virecanakalpeṣu vaktavyeṣu trivṛtāyā virecanadravyeṣu sukhavirecanatayā pradhānatvāt trivṛtkalpa evābhidhīyate
trivṛtābheda eva ca śyāmā, tena śyāmāyāstrivṛtāyāśca kalpaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaḥ
yadyapi cāruṇamūlaiva trivṛdatrotkṛṣṭā vaktavyā, tathāapyadhyāyasañjñāyāṃ śyāmāyā agre pāṭhenāśudoṣahantṛtayā śyāmāyāḥ prakarṣaṃ darśayati
ye cātra yogā vaktavyāstearuṇayā vā śyāmayā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā doṣaśarīrādibalābalamavekṣya kartavyāḥ
virecane ityādau trivṛnmūlaśabdena śyāmamūlāyā aruṇamūlāyāśca sāmānyena mūlaṃ gṛhyate
vātāpahauṣadhayogena vātahantṛtvamavidyamānaṃ bhavati, kaphapittahantṛtvaṃ vidyamānamadhikaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam
sukumārāḥ śiśavaśca yadyapyavirecanīyā uktāstathāapi teṣāṃ vidhīyamānavirecane hitamiti jñeyam
yadyapi madanakalpa eva guṇavadbhūmijātatvādi sāmānyena bheṣajānāmuktameva, tathāapi gambhīrānugatatvādiviśeṣasya tatrānuktasyehābhidhāne sati tatprasaṅgāt tatkiñciducyate- guṇavatyāmityādi

peyāmātroṣita iti pūrvadine peyāmātrāhāratayā uṣitaḥ; yadyapi cānyatra virecanapūrvadineṣu tathaivāhāro niyamitaḥ- “snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca tryahaṃ bhuktvā rasaudanam” (sū.a.13) ityanena, tathāapi trivṛdvirecanaprayoge pūrvadine viśeṣavidhānāt peyādānaṃ jñeyam
kiñceyameva tadvacanāt snigdhoṣṇamāṃsarasasādhitā ca kriyamāṇā na pūrvoktasnehavaddravauṣṇamāṃsarasaudanaviruddhā bhavati
etayośca militayoḥ pratyekaṃ ca prayogā iti prāgeva pratipāditam
sanāgaramiti nāgarasahitaṃ sat pratyekaṃ saindhavādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ dviguṇatrivṛtācūrṇayuktaṃ pātavyam
ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ iti dvayoranyataraḥ
īśvarāṇāṃ virecanamiti vacanena sukumāratvādasnigdhaviṣayatāmasya darśayati, īśvarā hi prāyeṇa sukumārāḥ snigdhāśca bhavanti
atra trivṛccūrṇamanirdiṣṭamānaṃ, tacca prakṣepanyāyāllehāt pādikaṃ kartavyam
bhṛṅgailābhyāmityādinā tarpaṇayogaṃ prathamamevāha, dvitīyastu tarpaṇayogo bhaviṣyatīti
tatra ca “modake dviguṇo guḍaḥ” iti vacanāt guḍaśarkarāṃ cūrṇāddviguṇāmicchanti
trivṛcchāṇā ityādineha modake ca yadyapi paṭhyate yogaḥ, tathāapyasya lehenaiva grahaṇādayamaṣṭamo leho bhavati
madhu ca tāvanmātraṃ yāvatā modako bhavati
trivṛtāṃ kauṭajamityādinā ṣaḍṛtuvihitān yogān rūkṣāṇāmapi śasyate ityantenāha
hemante yadyapi prabalaśītavāte virecanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathāapi vyādhiviṣayavihitaṃ virecanametajjñeyam
sarvartukayogau anukte ṛtau vasantādau ca jñeyau
evaṃ sarvartukayogena samaṃ dvau tarpaṇayogau bhavataḥ
tulyāmlamityekaṃ ghṛtaṃ, śyāmetyādi dvitīyaṃ, śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇetyādi tṛtīyam
ghṛtena kṣīreṇa ca ghṛtena kṣīreṇa vaikena militvā catvāro ghṛtakṣīrairbhavanti
trivṛnmuṣṭīnityādinā prathamā surā, surāṃ vetyādinā dvitīyā, evaṃ dvau surāyogau bhavataḥ
samprati daśottaraṃ yogaśatamabhidhāya vāntinirāsārthaṃ kṛtyatrayeṇa samaṃ virecanaprayogānāha- tvakkeśaretyādi
yaṣṭyāṃ dvāviti ‘yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā’ iti jīvakādāvekaḥ, madhuketyādinā cāparaḥ
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamoadhyāyaḥ
adhikaṃ pathya iti jvarādiṣu viśeṣeṇa virecanaprayoge hitaḥ
caturvarṣamukhe bāle yāvaddvādaśavārṣike ityanenāsya prayogasya caturvarṣādarvāgūrdhvaṃ ca dvādaśavarṣādavaśyatayā yaugikatvaṃ niṣedhayati
trivṛto vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibediti saptamaḥ
saṅgrahe ca kariṣyati- ‘kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ca’ iti
antarvalkalavarjitāmiti tilvakasyāntarvalkalaṃ kaṭhinaṃ bhavati, tadarthaṃ tadvarjanam
ścotayediti vacanena ṣaḍguṇadraveṇaikaviṃśativārān srāvayediti jñeyaṃ, madanaphalakalpe evambhūtasyaiva srāvaṇasya dṛṣṭatvāt
tenātra tilvakakvāthena guḍānvitatrivṛccūrṇaṃ paktvā lehaḥ kartavyaḥ
samabhāgatve tu lodhraprayogatvasya kena viśeṣaḥ syāt, tasmād yathāvyākhyātameva sādhu
caturaṅgulaghṛte ca “caturaṅgulasiddhāt” (ka.a.8) ityādinā, tathā “tadeva daśamūlasya” (ka.a.8) ityādinā prokte jñeye; tathā ca caturaṅgulakalpena lodhrādinā dve lodhraghṛte bhavataḥ
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamoadhyāyaḥ
sati mārgaparikrama iti upakramamārgāntare sati na sudhā prayoktavyā, tena gatyantarāsambhava eva sudhā prayoktavyetyarthaḥ

pāṇḍurogetyādau madhumehaśabdena pramehā evocyante; viśiṣṭastu vātikamadhumehoasādhya eva, tena taṃ prati virecanopadeśoanarthaka eva syāt; madhumehaśabdaśca yathā pramohamātra eva vartate tat pratipāditameva pramehacikitsite
doṣavṛddhyā vibhrāntaṃ ceto yasmin tasmin doṣavibhrāntacetasi unmāde
pravaro bahukaṇṭaka iti anatitīkṣṇatayāalpakaṇṭakamahāvṛkṣataḥ śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ
yadyapi madanakalpe “śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi” (ka.a.1) ityuktaṃ, tathāapi sudhāyā atra śiśirānte kṣīragrahaṇamapavādarūpaṃ jñeyam
aṅgāreṣu śoṣayediti aṅgāroparisthitapātrasthaṃ tat sudhākṣīraṃ bilvādīnāmanyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa samānaṃ śoṣaṇena kaṭhinaṃ kuryāt; tataḥ kolamātrā guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ, tataḥ sauvīrakādīnāmanyatamena pātavyā
evaṃ sauvīrakādibhedāt sapta yogā bhavanti; tathāatra bilvādikaṣāyasya bhedena bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ
śyāmādigrahaṇenaiva sātalāyāmapi labdhāyāṃ pṛthak sātalābhidhānamekayāapi sātalayā kṛtasudhāyogasya prādhānyakhyāpanārtham
gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtveti rajanīṃ vyāpya gomūtre sthāpayitvā
āmalakaiścaturaṅgulavaditi vacanādāmalakarasayuktaṃ yaccaturaṅgulakalpe “caturaṅgulasiddhādvā” (ka.a.8) ityādinoktaṃ tasya vidhānamatidiśati
surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre iti snukkṣīrabhāvitamityādividhinā surāṃ kuryāt
ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacedityatra pūrvavadityanena tilvakakalpe pūrvaṃ yat “lodhrakalkena” (ka.a.9) ityādigranthavihitaṃ, tadvidhireva pratyāsannatvādatidiśyate
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamoadhyāyaḥ
iha cādhyāye ye yogā abhidhīyante te saptalayā vā śaṅkhinyā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā sampādyante śyāmātrivṛdyogavat
akṣamātramityādinā kalkasya prasannālavaṇayuktasya priyālādikaṣāyeṣu ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti
atra yadyapi maireyaikṣavau na kaṣāyau tathāapi bahukaṣāyāntargatatvāt kaṣāyāveva vaktavyau, saṅgrahe ‘kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ’ ityanena vyapadiṣṭau
tailaṃ tatpīḍitamiti śaṅkhinīcūrṇaṃ tilacūrṇaṃ ca harītakīkaṣāyeṇa sandhāya pīḍitaṃ tat tailaṃ pibediti
atasyādiṣveṣa saṃvidhiriti vacanena tilasthāneatasyādīnāṃ prayogaṃ vidhatte
dantīdravantyorityādinā dvidvidravyakalkena saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkārdhena pūrvaghṛtavatpākācca pañcaghṛtayogā apare
lodhravaditi lodhrakalpavat; lodhrakalpe yathā trayo lehāḥ “caturaṅgulakalpena” (ka.a.9) ityādinoktāḥ, tena lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīyogaḥ kartavyaḥ
tathā surāyogaḥ kampillayogaśca lodhravaditi atrāpi lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīprakṣepaḥ kartavyaḥ
etat sandhānacatuṣṭayaṃ pūrvasurāyogena samaṃ ‘pañca madye” iti vacanena saṅgrahagṛhītaṃ; sauvīrakādīnāṃ ca madyaśabdenābhidhānamihāsūtatvasāmānyājjñeyam
dantīdravantyoḥ kalpeneti anāgatāvekṣaṇena dantīdravantīkalpe sauvīrakatuṣodake ye vaktavye tadvidhānamihāpyatidiśati
tatra “ajagandhākaṣāyeṇa sauvīrakatuṣodake” (ka.a.12) iti vaktavyaṃ, tenehāpyajagandhākaṣāyayuktasaptalāśaṅkhinyoḥ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye
gauḍaḥ kāryoajaśṛṅgyā ca sa vai sukhavirecanaḥ” (ka.a.12) ityanenoktasya gauḍāriṣṭasya dantīdravantīkalpoktasya vidhānamatidiśati
svedayenmṛtkuśāntara iti pippalīmadhukakalkābhyāṃ parilipya kuśaiḥ pariveṣṭya tato mṛdāvaliptāni svedayet
- eṣāṃ dantīdravantīmūlānāṃ vikāśitālakṣaṇaṃ guṇaṃ svedopaśoṣaṇābhyāmagnyarkau hataḥ; tena nātidoṣāṇi dantīdravantīmūlāni syuriti bhāvaḥ
anayoḥ kalkakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlarasatulyabhāgena ghṛtaṃ pacedvisarpādiṣu, tailaṃ tu pūrvavanmehādiṣu, catuḥ snehaṃ tu śakṛcchukravātasaṅgādiṣu
sa evājagandhayetyanena pūrvoktalehe evājaśṛṅgīsthāneajagandhādānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ khyāpayati
cakoraścopacakraśca kakubho raktacarmakaḥ” (sū.a.27) iti granthenāṣṭāvuktāḥ; teṣāṃ pratyekayogādaṣṭau rasā bhavanti
evametairdravaiḥ pūrvayogaiśca militvā dvitīyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet
tathā ajaśṛṅgyā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye gauḍoariṣṭaḥ kārya iti sambandhaḥ
atra tayordantīdravantyoścūrṇakvāthābhyāṃ tathā māṣāmbunā kiṇvakaraṇapūrvakaṃ yā surā kṛtā tatsurodbhavā madirā kartavyeti vākyārthaḥ

lodhravacca tayoriti yathā lodhrakalpeṣu “surā lodhrakaṣāyeṇa” ityādinā surā proktā, tathā “kampillakakaṣāyeṇa” (ka.a.9) ityādinā kampillakayoga uktaḥ, tathā tayorapi dantīdravantyorlodhrasthāne prakṣepāt surāyogaḥ sauvīrakatuṣodakavidhānenaiva kartavyaḥ
bhaktidoṣāmayān prati uktānāṃ nānāvidhānāṃ yogānāṃ trayaḥ ṣoḍaśakāḥ proktā iti yojanā
prādhānyataḥ samāśrityeti prādhānyena madanaphalādīni dravantīparyantāni pañcadaśadravyāṇi yogavyapadeśatayāaaśritya
athātra vamanādiyogeṣu dravyāntarāṇāṃ surādīnāmapi vidyamānatvāt kathaṃ madanaphalādyāśrayavattvenaivāmī yogā vyapadiśyanta ityāha- yaddhītyādi
yadyapi madanādibhiḥ surādibhiśca militvaivāmī yogāḥ kriyante, tathāapi phalādīnāṃ prādhānyāt phalādīnāṃ yogā ete iti vyapadeśo bhavati, na surādiyogā iti
surādīnāmaprādhānya eva hetumāha- te hi tānyanuvartanta iti; surādayo hi madanādīni vamanavirecanaprakārakāryānuguṇatayāapratīghātena cānuvartante

nanu ye tāvadanuguṇā madanādīnāṃ te guṇabhūtā bhavantu, viparītā ye dantyā ugratāyā māṃsarasādayaḥ, tathā elādayo hṛdyatayā vamanapratikūlā madanādīnāṃ te kathaṃ guṇabhūtā ityāha- viruddhavīryamapyeṣāṃ pradhānānāmabādhakamiti
yadi hi viruddhavīryaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ na syāt tadā madanādīnāṃ kāryaṃ pratihanyāt; viruddhasyāpi ca kāryāpratīghātoavaśyamabādhakatvameveti bhāvaḥ
viparītasya kāryābādhanarūpaṃ sāhāyyamabhidhāya tulyavīryasya kāryamāha- adhikamityādi
atha tulyavīryaṃ tāvat kriyāsāmarthyādhikyakārakaṃ, tena tatsaṃyogoastu, viruddhavīryasaṃyogāstu kimarthaṃ kriyanta ityāha- iṣṭetyādi
iṣṭavarṇatvādisampattyartham; ato madanaphalāderviruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayogastathā viruddhāmayaṃ ca prati viruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayogo vamanavirecanahartavyāmayaviśeṣe yaugika ityarthaḥ
tatrālpamātrasya samānavīryasaṃyogānmahārthatvaṃ bhavati, tathā viruddhavīryasaṃyogāt prabhūtamātrasyāpyalpakarmatā kartavyā
iyaṃ cālpakarmakatā prabhūtabheṣajasya dīptikāraṇakoṣṭhavyāptyādiprayojanāt kriyate, tena na niṣprayojanā
viśleṣādapyalpasya mahārthatvaṃ viruddhavīryaviśleṣādboddhavyaṃ; samādhikaviśleṣāttu prabhūtasyālpakarmatā jñeyā
alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ yathā snigdhealpamātramapi śodhanaṃ bahudoṣaharaṇāya bhavati, tadviparyayeṇa prabhūtasyālpakarmatā udāharaṇīyā
atha kasmānniḥśeṣeṇa naiva yogā abhidhīyanta ityāha- bahudravyetyādi
atha vamanavirecanānāṃ tadupodghātācca nirūhāṇāṃ tīkṣṇamadhyamṛdutāyā lakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ cāha- tīkṣṇetyādi
nātiglānikaraṃ pāyāviti virecanasya nirūhasya ca, hṛdaye na ca rukkaramiti tu vamanasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam
virecanamiti vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca; uktaṃ hi- ubhayaṃ hi śarīradoṣamalavirecanādvirecanaśabdaṃ labhate (ka.a.1) iti
te madhyālpaśuddhī balīyasāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kṛtsnadoṣaṃ yasmānna nirharataḥ, tasmādaśuddhī
akṛtsnadoṣaharaṇāditi hetuvarṇanena yadā balīyasoalpadoṣatayā kṛtsnadoṣaharaṇakārike madhyālpaśuddhī bhavataḥ, tadā samyakśuddhī eva te iti sūcayati
madhyetyādi madhyabale madhyā, avarabale tu mṛdvī śuddhiḥ prayojyeti vākyārthaḥ
tatra prayojyabhāṣayā asamyakśuddhī api balāpekṣayā kartavye, madhyāvarau prati tayoḥ samyakśuddhikartṛtvaṃ bhavatīti darśayati
vyādhitīkṣṇatvādivibhāgena viśuddhau tīkṣṇatvādividhānamāha- tīkṣṇo madhya ityādi
sarvamadhyālpalakṣaṇa iti yathāsaṅkhyaṃ tīkṣṇādivyādhilakṣaṇaṃ; sarvalakṣaṇaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ, madhyalakṣaṇaḥ madhyaḥ, alpalakṣaṇaḥ mṛdurvyādhiḥ
balāvekṣītyanena vyādhestīkṣṇatve yadi balaṃ mahadbhavati tadaiva tīkṣṇaśodhanaṃ kartavyamiti darśayati
evaṃ pīte vamane sati anirhṛte doṣe paścāt punaḥ punarvamanārthīyaṃ bheṣajaṃ deyam
āpittadarśanāditi yāvat pittaṃ na dṛśyate tāvat punaḥ punarvamanaṃ deyam
balavati doṣe puruṣeapi punaḥ prayojyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ, hīnabale doṣe puruṣe ca sarvaśo vā bheṣajaṃ śodhanārthaṃ vivarjayet, śodhanaṃ na kuryādityarthaḥ
vāśabdena ca madhyamabale puruṣe doṣe ca na sarvathā vivarjanenaikavāraprayogaṃ śodhanasya darśayati
nirhṛte ityādau doṣanirharaṇe iti doṣanirharaṇakaprayojane bheṣaje
jīrṇe veti yena vamanamadhikṛtyaitaducyate, tena vamanasya pākakālāpratīkṣaiveti ‘apakvaṃ vamanaṃ’ ityādinā vaktavyam
jīrṇasadṛśatā ca vamanasya kṣobhākartṛtayā pākonmukhatayā ca jñeyā
vamanaprayogeṣvayogapratīkārārthaṃ bheṣajāntaraprayoge kartavye pākakālāpratīkṣaṇaṃ sopapattikamāha- apakvamityādi
vamane āvaśyakaṃ kartavyamabhidhāya virecaneapyāha- pīte prasraṃsane ityādi
dṛḍhasnehaguṇamityanena snehalakṣaṇo guṇo dehe yadā dṛḍho nāsti tadāasya bheṣajaṃ na dātavyaṃ, kintu sneha eva tāvat kartavyaḥ; asamyaksnigdhe hi punarapi kriyamāṇaṃ virecanamasamyagyogāyaiva bhavati
śvobhūte, dināntare bhūte, kiṃvā ‘śvo bhūyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ
ye tu ‘pramāṇataḥ’ iti paṭhanti, te samyakśuddhāvapi koṣṭhopalepakadoṣapraśamanārthaṃ bhojanāntarapānaṃ vyākhyānayanti
śodhitaṃ pūrvamiti pūrvaśodhitasya durbalatayā mṛdu bheṣajaṃ deyaṃ, tīkṣṇena hi balabhraṃśoatiyogaśca syāt
na cātitīkṣṇamiti na cātitīkṣṇaṃ durbalādīnāṃ deyaṃ; yasmādatitīkṣṇaṃ durbalādīn prāpya kṣipraṃ prāṇasaṃśayaṃ janayet
evambhūtānāṃ mahādoṣanirharaṇe hetumāha- doṣā hanyurhyenamanirhṛtā iti
yasyetyādāvānulomikaṃ virecanamauṣadhamūrdhvaṃ yāti yasya, taṃ pāyayet ‘virecanamauṣadham’ iti śeṣaḥ
etena samyagvirecane bhūteapi yadauṣadhaṃ tiṣṭhati tattaddine evollikhet
atra kartavyaṃ yadyapi noktaṃ, tathāapi śleṣmaṇā nirodhaṃ bheṣajasya gauravādibhirupalabhya rātriparyantaṃ bheṣajasyāyogapravṛttirupekṣaṇīyeti kartavyamūhanīyam
rūkṣetyādāvayogājjīrṇe viṣṭabhya ūrdhvaṃ gate vā bheṣaje anyadvirecanaṃ sasnehalavaṇaṃ dātavyam
tena laṅghanena doṣapākādeva prabalaśleṣmopaśamo doṣasaṅgopaśamaśca kriyata ityarthaḥ

bastiṃ purā dattvetyatra bastiśabdena snehabastimicchanti, nirūhastu vātakopakatayā tathā nirūhānantaraṃ virecanasya niṣiddhatvādiha neṣyate; uktaṃ hi “nirūhadānāt pavanādbhayaṃ syāt” (si.a.1) iti, tathā “naro viriktastu nirūhadānaṃ vivarjayet saptadinānyavaśyam

śuddho nirūhena virecanaṃ tu” (si.a.1) iti; kintu bastiśabdena nirūhaḥ snehabastiśca gṛhyate; nirūhasya yadvātakartṛtvamuktaṃ tadekasyaiva snehabastirahitasyābhyāsāt, utsargatastu vātahantṛtvaṃ “bastirvātaharāṇāṃ” (sū.a.25) ityanenaivoktam

nirūhānantaraṃ virecananiṣedhastvautsargikaḥ, tena viśeṣavidhinā tasyāpavādo yujyata eva; kiñca, iha bastyanantaraṃ yadvirecanaṃ vidhīyate tacca bastidānādūrdhvaṃ saptāhānantarameva bhaviṣyatīti na kaścidvirodhaḥ
rūkṣāśanā ityādinā snehyā api na vyādhivyatirekeṇa śodhanīyā ityāha
viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇān doṣān sahantīti viruddhāśanādayo doṣarūpā na teṣāṃ vikāraṃ janayantītyarthaḥ; viruddhādhyaśanādayaśca doṣajanakatayā doṣaśabdenocyante
nāvyādhāviti avidyamānasaṃśodhanaikasādhye vyādhau na tān viśodhayediti; anyatrāpyuktoayamarthaḥ “anīritānāṃ doṣāṇāmīraṇaṃ na praśasyate
nanu viṣatulyavibhraṃśametacchodhanaṃ tatkimanenācaritenetyāha- kāleṣvavaśyaṃ peyaṃ ceti; saṃśodhanasādhyavyādhāvavaśyaṃ peyam
tena, avasthāviśeṣeavaśyakartavyatayā na śodhanaṃ parihartuṃ pāryata iti bhāvaḥ
samprati yadetacchodhanasya kvacit karṣādimānamuktaṃ na tat sarvapuruṣaviṣayaṃ, kintu madhyeṣu koṣṭhavayobaleṣu tanmānaṃ jñeyamiti darśayannāha- dravyetyādi
vikalpārthamāha- teṣāṃ vikalpyoabhyadhikonabhāva iti; bheṣajapramāṇasyādhikabhāva ūnabhāvaśca vikalpya ityarthaḥ
pramāṇopodghātāt sarvaśāstravyavahriyamāṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ nirūpayannāha- ṣaḍ dhvaṃśya ityādi
dhvaṃśīṃ trasareṇukaṃ vadanti; anye tu dhvaṃśīṃ dhūlimāhuḥ
aṣṭau te sarṣapā raktāstaṇḍulā ityatra raktā iti sarṣapāṇāṃ viśeṣaṇam
taddvayaṃ dhānyamāṣa iti taṇḍuladvayaṃ dhānyamāṣo bhavet
te tu catvāra iti yavacatvāraḥ; anye tu māṣāścatvāraḥ aṇḍikā iti vadanti

atra māne aṣṭacatvāriṃśanmāṣakamānaṃ palaṃ bhavati, tadeva daśaraktimānena catuḥṣaṣṭimāṣakapalena tulyaṃ bhavati, yataścaturviṃśatidhānyamāṣairdaśaraktikāstulyā bhavanti; tataśca daśaraktimānāścatuḥṣaṣṭimāṣakāścaturviṃśatidhānyamāṣairguṇitāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikapañcadaśaśatadhānyamāṣā eva bhavanti; tena daśaraktikacatuḥṣaṣṭidhānyamāṣapalamānena saha dvātriṃśaddhānyamāṣapramāṇāṣṭacatvāriṃśanmāṣakṛtapalamānasya tulyatā
suśruteapi “tatra dvādaśa dhānyamāṣāḥ svarṇamāṣakaḥ, te ca catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ palam” (su.
tena catuḥṣaṣṭimāṣakā dvādaśadhānyamāṣairguṇitāḥ santoaṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikasaptaśatadhānyamāṣā bhavanti; evaṃ dṛḍhabaloktamānādardhena suśrutapalādimānaṃ bhavati; evaṃ suśruteapi pañcaraktikamāṣo bhavati
atra yadyapi sāmānyenaiva dravasya dvaiguṇyamuktaṃ, tathāapi tantrāntaradarśanāt kuḍavādāveva dravasya dvaiguṇyam
uktaṃ hi “raktikādiṣu māneṣu yāvanna kuḍavo bhavet
śuṣke dravārdrayoścaiva tulyaṃ mānaṃ prakīrtitam” iti

ihāpi suniṣaṇṇakacāṅgerīghṛte “triṃśatpalāni prasthoatra vijñeyo dvipalādhikaḥ” (ci.a.14) iti vacanena dravadvaiguṇyaṃ pāribhāṣikaprasthe draḍhayatāaacāryeṇa raktikādau dvaiguṇyaparibhāṣāvyabhicāraḥ sūcyata ityupapāditameva prāk
ārdradvaiguṇyaṃ ca tasyaiva bhavati yasya dravyasya śuṣkasya cārdrasya copayogaḥ sambhavati, yacca nityamārdramevopayujyate na tatra dvaiguṇyam
nityamārdrāḥ prayoktavyā na teṣāṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet” iti
anyeṣāṃ ca dvaiguṇyaṃ kṛtvā mānasya vāradvayagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ
snehādisādhane dravasampādye yatra dravaṃ noktaṃ tatra salilaṃ deyamityarthaḥ
yataśca pādanirdeśaścaturbhāgastataśca sa iti asyārtho lokata eva siddhaḥ, tathāapi spaṣṭārthaṃ punarabhidhīyate
jalasnehauṣadhānāmityādau auṣadhāt snehaścaturguṇa iti kalkāt snehaścaturguṇaḥ
yatra tu viśiṣṭaṃ mānaṃ jalādīnāmuktaṃ tatra tathaiva kartavyaṃ, “nirdiṣṭe tattadeva tu” (su.ci.a.31) itivacanāt
tulye kalkena niryāsa iti prathamaprakṣiptakalkatulyatāṃ gate pākena niryāse sati
saṃyāva iveti atra saṃyāvaśabdena samaghṛtaguḍagodhūmakaṇikākṛtapiṇḍa ucyate
kāliṅgamityādikaṃ ślokaṃ kecit paṭhanti, taṃ cānārṣaṃ vadanti
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne dantīdravantīkalpo nāma dvādaśoadhyāyaḥ

siddhiśabdena ceha vamanādīnāṃ vamanādyasamyagyogajanyānāṃ vyāpadāṃ bheṣajasya sādhyatārūpā siddhirucyate, evambhūtasiddhikāraṇābhidhāyakatayā caitat siddhisthānamucyate; kiṃvā kāryakāraṇayorabhedopacārāt siddhiśabdeneha siddhikāraṇānyeva vamanādīnyucyante, uktaṃ hi “samyakprayogaṃ caiva karmaṇāṃ vyāpannānāṃ ca vyāpatsādhanāni siddhiṣūpadekṣyāmaḥ” (sū.a.4) iti
na caivaṃ siddhisthānasañjñāvyutpattyā cikitsāsthānādīnāmapi siddhisthānasañjñāprasaktirudbhāvanīyā, yata iyaṃ sañjñāatraiva yogarūḍhyā vartate nānyatra
atra ‘kā kalpanā’ ityādīn śiṣyasya dvādaśapraśnānabhiniveśya tān yathākramaṃ vyācaṣṭe praśnānuguṇagurubuddhiprakāśārtham
śiṣyeṇa samyak pṛṣṭasya gurorbuddhiḥ prakāśate” iti

atra ‘kā kalpanā pañcasu karmasūktā’ iti prathamaḥ praśnaḥ, ‘kramaśca kaḥ’ iti dvitīyaḥ, ‘kiñca kṛtākṛteṣu liṅgaṃ tathaivātikṛteṣu’ iti tṛtīyaḥ, ‘saṅkhyā kā’ iti caturthaḥ, ‘kiṅguṇo bastiḥ’ iti pañcamaḥ, ‘keṣu ca kaśca bastiḥ’ iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ, ‘kiṃ varjanīyaṃ pratikarmakāle’ iti saptamaḥ, ‘kṛte kiyān vā parihārakālaḥ’ ityaṣṭamaḥ, ‘praṇīyamānaśca na yāti kena bastiḥ’ iti navamaḥ, ‘kenaiti śīghraṃ’ iti daśamaḥ, ‘sucirācca kenaiti’ ityekādaśaḥ, ‘sādhyāḥ’ ityādiko dvādaśaḥ
sādhyā ityādipraśnasya yadyapyavakāśo nāsti, yato hi nāsādhyā gadāḥ proktena yathāsvaṃ kriyamāṇena bheṣajena praśāmyanti, tathāapyasamyagbheṣaje eva yathāsvaṃ bheṣajābhidhānādayaṃ praśnoboddhavyaḥ
tryahāvaramiti tryaheṇa tryahaṃ vā vyāpya kriyamāṇasnehanena avaraṃ yathā bhavatīti tryahāvaraṃ snigdhaḥ
tataśca kālotkarṣāt kriyamāṇaśodhanāṅgasnehanapakṣe saptadinaṃ yāvat snigdhaḥ, kālāprakarṣapakṣe tu tryahaṃ snigdhaḥ saṃsvedayitavya ityarthaḥ

saptadināt pareṇa kriyamāṇasnehaḥ saptarātraprayogeṇa sātmyībhūtatvānna snehanamadhikaṃ śarīre karotītyarthaḥ; tena yāvanmātrasnehaprayogeṇa saptadinopayuktena snehanaṃ vṛtaṃ, sā mātrā sātmyībhūtaiva; adhikamātrā yā sātmyatāṃ na gatā sā saptarātrāt pareṇāpi kartavyaiva; vedyāstu saptarātrādasnigdhe puruṣe kiñcidviśrāmaṃ kṛtvā punaradhikamātrayā snehaṃ prayuñjate

nanu yadi krūrakoṣṭhastu saptarātreṇa snihyatīti vyavasthā, tat kathamiha ‘nātaḥ paraṃ snehanamādiśanti’ ityanena saptarātreṇāpyasnehanamucyate; brūmaḥ- satyaṃ, krūrakoṣṭhaḥ saptarātreṇaiva snihyati, paraṃ krūrakoṣṭhatāmapekṣya kṛtayā snehamātrayā snihyati, yadā tu hīnamātrā prayujyate, tadā saptarātreṇāpi na snihyati

yattu tantrāntare- “triṣaṭkanavarātreṇa snehapānaṃ vidhīyate” ityanena saptarātrādūrdhvamapi snehanaṃ vihitaṃ, tadācāryānabhimatameva; kiṃvā, saptarātrādūrdhvamasātmyībhūtādhikamātrāprayogābhiprāyeṇa tadvarṇanīyam
atra ca saptarātrādūrdhvaṃ snehaprayogasya niṣedhāt, tryahādarvāk prayogasya vā niṣedhāt, sadyaḥ snehaprayogeṇaikadinenāpi snehanamanujānīta iti bruvate
madhyakoṣṭhāntaraṃ prati snehanaprakarṣakālo yadyapi noktaḥ, tathāapi madhyavidhayā pañcadinena madhyakoṣṭhasya snehanaṃ jñeyam

yattu kaiścit ‘mṛdukoṣṭhaṃ prati tryahādūrdhvaṃ na snehanaṃ kartavyaṃ sātmyībhāvāditi cārtho labhyate’ iti vyākhyāyate, tanna naḥ prīṇāti; yataḥ sātmyībhāvaḥ saptadinanirvartyatayaivācāryeṇoktaḥ, tenātyalpamātrāprayuktena snehena tryahādyadi na snihyati mṛdukoṣṭhastadāadhikadinānyapi tatra snehaḥ kartavyaḥ
samprati snigdhasya vāmanīyasya vamanānuguṇaṃ virecanīyasya ca virecanānuguṇaṃ bhojanaṃ pṛthagāha- grāmyaudaketyādi
atra ca utkleśanīya iti yadā sambandho bhavettadā utkleśanaṃ pittasyaiva jñeyaṃ; kiṃvā ‘utkleśanīyaḥ’ iti nānuvartata eva, tena kaphāvṛddhikarai rasairyūṣaiśca ‘bhojanīya’ iti śeṣaḥ
etadvirecanārthaṃ pratibhojanaṃ tryahaṃ jñeyaṃ, vamanārthaṃ tu pratibhojanamekāhameva; uktaṃ hi ‘snehāt praskandanaṃ jantustrirātroparataḥ pibet
vāmanīyasya śleṣmottaratve kartavye virecanīyasya cālpakaphatve sampādye upapattimāha- śleṣmottara ityādi
kaphealpe sati vamanaṃ pītaṃ vamanamakṛtvaivādho yāti; vṛddhe kaphe tu virecanaṃ prayuktamūrdhvaṃ yāti, vamanāya sampadyata ityarthaḥ

samprati kramaśca ka iti praśnasyottaramāha- snigdhāya deyaṃ vamanamiti; vamanapānadineabhyaṅgena snigdhāya vamanaṃ deyamityarthaḥ, pānajanitasnehastu pūrvamevoktatvānna punarabhidhānamarhati, anye tu ‘upajātasnehaguṇāya’ iti vadanti
ayaṃ ca virecanāṅgaḥ snehasvedakramo vamanānantarabhāvivirecaneapi peyādikramottarakālaṃ kartavyaḥ; yaduktaṃ- ‘vilepyāḥ kramāgataṃ cainaṃ punareva snehasvedābhyāmupapādya virecayet’ iti
snehānantaraṃ ca yattryahaṃ virecanārthaṃ pratibhojanaṃ, tadupakramābhidhānānuṣaṅgapratipāditameveti na punariha pratipādyate
yogyatamamiti śarīradoṣādyapekṣayā yadvirecanaṃ yaugikaṃ bhavati taddeyam
uktaṃ hi- ‘sikthakai rahito maṇḍaḥ, peyā sikthasamanvitā
atra akṛtayūṣaḥ snehalavaṇādyasaṃskṛtaḥ, kṛtayūṣaḥ snehalavaṇādisaṃskṛtaḥ; evaṃ raseapi kṛtākṛtavyavasthā
tririti annakālatrayaṃ vyāpya, dviriti annakāladvayam, ekaśa iti ekānnakālam; etacca trirityādi pratyekaṃ peyādibhiḥ sambadhyate
etacca trirityādi pakṣatrayaṃ pradhānaśuddhiśuddhādyapekṣayā yathākramaṃ jñeyam

tena, pradhānaśuddhiśuddhe pratyekaṃ triḥ peyādi kartavyaṃ, tenānnakālatraye peyā, tataḥ pareṇānnakālatraye vilepī, tataḥ pareṇānnakālatraye kṛtākṛtayūṣasahitamannaṃ, tatoapi ca pareṇa kṛtākṛtarasenānnamannakālatraye deyam; evaṃ dvādaśabhirannakālairvamanadinasāyāhnāt prabhṛti saptarātreṇa peyādikramaḥ
ayameva krama upakalpanīyeapi- “tataḥ sāyāhne lohitaśālitaṇḍulānāṃ” ityādinā, yāvat “dvādaśe cānnakāle” (sū.a.15) ityanenoktaḥ
atra yūṣarasayostu yadyapi kālavibhāgo na pratipāditastathāapi yūṣakālatraye rasakālatraye ca prathamamakṛtasya uttarakāle ca kṛtasya yūṣasya, evaṃ rasasyāpi kālavibhāgaḥ kathanīyaḥ
evaṃ dviḥpeyādikramastathā ekaśaśca peyādikramo varṇanīya iti
ekakāle tu peyādikrame yadyapi kṛtākṛtayūṣarasayoḥ kālavibhāgo na prāpyate, tathāapyekasminneva kāle stokasaṃskāreṇa yūṣarasayostatra kṛtākṛtatvaṃ jñeyam
pradhānaśuddhe bhūridoṣagamanakṣobhādagnimāndyaṃ sambhavati, tena tatra peyādikramaściraṃ kriyata iti jñeyam
caturbhirvegairyacchodhanaṃ vamanaṃ tajjaghanyaṃ, yattu ṣaḍbhistanmadhyamaṃ, yattvaṣṭabhistat pravaram
vireke jaghanye daśa, madhye tu virecane dviguṇā daśaviṃśatirityarthaḥ, pravare tu virecane triguṇā daśa triṃśadityarthaḥ
vegasaṅkhyāvibhedena jaghanyādibhedamabhidhāya doṣamānabhedenāpi virecanasya jaghanyamadhyapravaratāṃ yathākramamāha- prasthastathetyādi
dviguṇaḥ prastho jaghanye virecane, triguṇaśca madhyame, caturguṇastu pravare
atra ca prasthaśabdena sārdhatrayodaśapalānyucyante; uktaṃ hi tantrāntare “vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe

pittāntamiṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekādardhamiti vireke yanmānaṃ jaghanyamadhyapravaravibhāge proktaṃ yathākramaṃ tathā vamaneapi jaghanyamadhyapravaravibhāge tadardhaṃ jñeyaṃ, paraṃ tu yat pittāntatvaṃ vamanasya, kaphāntatvaṃ virekasya, tat trividhaśuddhāvarthāgataṃ jñeyam

yadā caturbhirvegaiḥ prasthamāne doṣe gate pittāntatvaṃ samyagvamanaśuddhijalakṣaṇamupalabhyate tadā jaghanyā śuddhiḥ, yadā ca vireke daśabhirvegerdviprasthamānadoṣagamane kaphāntatvaṃ virecanasamyagyogalakṣaṇamupalabhyate tadā virecanasya jaghanyā śuddhirbhavati; evaṃ madhyapravaraśuddhāvapi vamane pittāntatvaṃ, virecane kaphāntatvaṃ, samyagyogalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam

vegasaṅkhyādoṣamānābhidhānānantaraṃ samyakśuddhilaiṅgikaśuddheḥ pittāntatvādilakṣaṇapratipādanārthamihābhidhānaṃ, tena yaducyate āntikī, vaigikī, mānikī, laiṅgikī ceti caturvidhā śuddhirihocyate vamanavirecanayoḥ, tadasmākamasammatameva; kintu laiṅgikī caikā śuddhiḥ
tatra ca pittāntatvaṃ tathā ‘kramātkaphaḥ’ ityādigranthavakṣyamāṇaṃ ca liṅgaṃ vamane, virecane ca kaphāntatvaṃ tathā ‘srotoviśuddhīndriya’ ityādigranthavakṣyamāṇaṃ ca liṅgaṃ jñeyam
tena yadatra āṣāḍhavarmaṇā “samyagviśuddhiliṅgaṃ lakṣaṇatoatha mānācca vegācca doṣāgamanāccoktaṃ, kimidaṃ vyastaṃ samastaṃ vā” ityādināaakṣiptaṃ, tadanabhyupagamanirastameva
jaghanyādiśuddhilakṣaṇeapi yadvegena jaghanyādiśuddhilakṣaṇābhidhānaṃ, tat prāyobhāvitayā jñeyam

doṣamānabhedena jaghanyādimānabhedaḥ pāramārthikaḥ; tena yatra vamaneaṣṭābhirvegairdviprasthadoṣasrutirbhavati tatra pravaraiva śuddhiḥ, yatra vamane ṣaḍbhireva vegaiḥ sārdhaprasthadoṣasrutirbhavati tatra madhyaiva śuddhi;, yatra ca caturbhirapi vegairekaprasthadoṣasrutistatra jaghanyaśuddhireva; evaṃ virecaneṣvapyudāhāryam
pittapravṛttirante yasmin tat pittāntam, evaṃ kaphāntamapi vyākhyeyam

tena ‘kramāt kaphaḥ pittamathānilaśca’ ityanena yat samyagvamanalakṣaṇaṃ vaktavyaṃ, tathā ‘prāptiśca viṭpittakaphānilānāṃ’ ityanena ca samyagvirecanalakṣaṇaṃ yadvaktavyaṃ, tadanena sahāviruddhaṃ bhavati

tatra ca yadanilāgamanamante vaktavyaṃ tat pittāntasya kaphāntasya ca sūcakatayā jñeyaṃ, niḥśeṣakṛte hyāśayagate pitte kaphe ca vāyuḥ kevalaḥ sarati; tena ca kevalavāyusaraṇena pittāntatā kaphāntatā ca jñāyate

nanu yadi ‘kramāt kaphaḥ” ityādinaiva granthenāyamarthoabhihitastat kathamiha pittāntaṃ ca vamanaṃ, kaphāntaṃ ca virekamāhuriti kṛtaṃ? būmaḥ- vegasaṅkhyādoṣamānabhedapratipādyamānajaghanyādiśuddhitraye pittāntatvādyanugatipratipādanārthamihābhidhānam; evaṃ tadvamanavirecanasamyagyogalakṣaṇānabhidhāne hi śiṣyasya prabaladoṣeapi puruṣeayogaśuddhāveva jaghanyaśuddhigatavegamānodaye sati atha pittāntatvādyanudaye jaghanyaśuddhibhramaḥ syāt evamnyadapyudāhāryam
vamane ca vireke ca yathā doṣamāpanaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha- dvitrānityādi
dvitrānityavyavasthitabhāṣaṇena malabhāgasyāmeyatāṃ darśayati; vamane tu pītamiti vamane pītamauṣadhaṃ varjayitvā śeṣo meyaḥ
samprati ‘kiṃ ca kṛtākṛteṣu’ ityādipraśnasyottaraṃ yathākramamāha- kramādityādi

kramādityanena vacanena yathoktakramalaṅghanena kaphādyāgamanaṃ na samyagyogalakṣaṇamiti darśayati; yataḥ kaphādūrdhvaṃ gataṃ yadā pittaṃ bhavati tadā tu pittāgamaneapi sati na śuddhiḥ, kintu yadaivāmāśayādhobhāgagataṃ pittaṃ vamanamānayati tadaiva śuddhiḥ, tat pittānayanaṃ ca kaphānayanānantarameva bhavati; evaṃ samyakkṛtavirecanalakṣaṇeapi kramāditipadasyārthoatra vyākhyeyaḥ

saptabhirdinaiḥ kṛtasaṃsarjanakramasyāṣṭame bhuktamupayuktasya navameahni sarpiḥpānamanuvāsanaṃ vā deyam; atra vikalpadvaye yadi vamanānantaraṃ virecanaṃ kartavyaṃ tadā navameahni sarpiḥpānam, atha virecanānantaraṃ yadā bastirdeyastadāanuvāsanaṃ navameahni deyamiti vyavasthā
vamamānantaraṃ navamadivase sarpiḥ pānaṃ pūrvaṃ noktaṃ tenedānīṃ virecanānantarakartavyanirūhāṅgānuvāsanasamānakālatayā sarpiḥ pānamapi darśitaṃ, tena na nirūhāṅgatā sarpiḥpānasya kalpanīyā
navamaśca divasoatra śodhanadinamārabhyaiva jñeyaḥ; uktaṃ ca jatūkaṇa- ‘śodhanānantaraṃ navameahni snehapānamanuvāsanaṃ vā” iti, tathā suśruteapyuktaṃ- “virecanāt saptarātre gate jātabalāya ca

uttarabasticikitsite ca yaḥ peyādikramānantaraṃ rasasaṃsarjanakrama uktaḥ, sa sarvakarmāvasāne prakṛtibhojanagamanārthaṃ kartavyaḥ, na vamanavirecanakarmaparisamāptāveva, tenehākṛtarasasaṃsargasyaiva navame dine sarpiḥpānamanuvāsanaṃ copapannam

saṃśuddhaḥ parato māsādanuvāsyastato naraḥ” ityuktaṃ, tat prāganuvāsanaviṣayaṃ rogaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ veti naitadviruddhaṃ bhavati; bahūni cātra vyākhyānāni ṭīkākṛtāmaṅgiri-saindhava-jejjaṭeśvarasenādīnāṃ santi; anyaistu tadvyākhyānāni doṣoddhārādeva nirastāni
dadyātryahāditi anuvāsanadinādūrdhvaṃ tryahāt, tena yathāvakṣyamāṇakrameṇa ekāhād dvyahādadhikādvā snehāttadaharvā nirūho deyaḥ
nātibubhukṣitāyetyanena atibubhukṣitasya nirūhoatiyogāyordhvagamanāya ca bhavatīti sūcayati
tatra dhanvarasena pratibhojanaṃ virecanavadagnimāndyābhāvādbalāvahatvācca yuktameva; yaduktaṃ bhoje- “āmastakādviśuddhasya nirūheṇa rasādikam
na tu bastistathā tasmādyayonnayati pāvakam’ iti
nirūha eva doṣāgnibalāpekṣayā rasādinā peyādinā vā bhojanaṃ darśayannāha- samīkṣya vā doṣabalaṃ yathārhamiti; balamiti agnibalam

niśītyanena nirūhānantaraṃ taddine kriyamāṇamanuvāsanaṃ niśyeva kartavyamiti darśayati, na śīte vasante ca sadyonirūḍhasya rātrāvevānuvāsanaṃ na deyamiti anye tu niśītyanena tadahareva nirūḍhāya sāyamanuvāsanaṃ deyamiti darśayati, tena yathāvakṣyamāṇavibhāgena rātrau divā vā deyamityāhuḥ
anuvāsanārha iti vacanena yadi sāmatā mando vā pāvako bhavati tadā tadaharanuvāsanaṃ na deyamiti sūcayati
ata eva jatūkarṇe dvitīyadivasa evānuvāsanamuktaṃ- “tatastryahānnirūhe vyuṣite bhuktavatoanuvāsanam” iti; hārīteapi- “vyuṣṭaṃ rajanyāṃ prasamīkṣya tasmādbalābalaṃ vāapyanuvāsanīyaḥ” ityuktam
niśītyanena yanniśāsamīpeanuvāsanaṃ vihitaṃ tadeva kālabhedena bhinnakālaṃ darśayannāha- śīte ityādi
diveti niśāsamīpe divābhāge, rātrāvapi ca dinasamīpāyāṃ rātrau

doṣān parirakṣatā doṣān dṛṣṭvā, antaraṃ ca doṣavarjanena parirakṣatā; ye snehasya pāne parikīrtitāḥ snehādhyāye- “śleṣmādhiko divā śīte” (sū.a.13) ityādinā granthena, ya evākālapītasnehadoṣā bhavanti ta eva yathoktakālaviparyayakṛtānuvāsaneapi doṣā bhavantītyuktaṃ bhavati
snehādhyāye yadvātapittādhikatvādiviśeṣeṇāpi rātrau divā ca snehapānaṃ vihitaṃ tadihāpi samānanyāyatvādekadeśābhidhānenāparaikadeśānumānācca jñeyam
vyuṣitāyeti nirvikāraṃ rātrivyuṣitāya divā bhojyaṃ deyaṃ, tathā sāyaṃ ca bhojyaṃ deyam
atrāpi tryahapañcāhavyavasthā pūrvavat; ayañcānuvāsanakālo nirūhadina eva dātavyānuvāsane parijñeyaḥ

anye tu paṭhanti yat- ‘parato dvyahe vā tryaheanuvāsyoahani pañcame vā’ iti; vyākhyānayanti ca- parato dvyahe vā tryaheanuvāsyoahani pañcame veti; atra tu dvyaheanuvāsanamatiprabalavātasya, anativṛddhavātasya tryahe, pañcame tu pravṛddhakaphapittasyeti vyavasthā
dvitīyadinānuvāsanaṃ hārīteapyuktaṃ; vacanaṃ hi- “dṛṣṭvāativṛddhaṃ pavanasya rūpaṃ dine dine bastimudāharanti” iti; suśruteapyuktaṃ- “rūkṣasya bahuvātasya snehabastiṃ dine dine

ihāpi ‘rūkṣanityastu” ityādinā, ‘vātārtāśca dine dine” (si.a.4) ityantena dvyahe dānaṃ vidhāsyati, tena ‘dvyahe vā tryahe vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ; ‘dvyahaśabdena cātra dinadvayasambandhamātramucyate, na dvyahapūraṇaṃ; tena prathamadivasadattānuvāsanāt prabhṛti pūrṇe tṛtīye divaseanuvāsanaṃ prāpnoti’ iti yaducyate, tannirastam; evaṃ tryaheapi tṛtīyāhasambandha eva vivakṣito jñeya iti
etacca ‘saṅkhyāḥ kati’ iti praśnasyottaram; aparaṃ saṅkhyāpraśnasyotaraṃ ‘triṃśanmatāḥ karmasu’ ityādinā bhaviṣyati
punarvetyanena vāte nava ekādaśa vā kuryāt

ayugmānityanena dvicatuḥṣaḍādisaṅkhyayā yugmadānaṃ niṣedhayati, ayugmadānaṃ prabhāvādevātropakārīti maharṣivacanādbodhyaṃ, yathā- “yugmeṣvahaḥsu putrakāmau saṃvasetām” (śā.a.8) iti; upapattiścātrātiprasaṅgabhītyā na kathitāaacāryeṇa

yattu- “trīn pañca vāaahuścaturoatha ṣaḍ vā” ityādinā yugmabastidānaṃ vakṣyati, tannirūhāṅgatayā snehanārthakriyamāṇānuvāsanaviṣayayugmabastidānaṃ jñeyam, iha tu pradhānatayā kriyamāṇānuvāsanaviṣayamayugmadānamiti na virodhaḥ
etena, yaduktamāṣāḍhavarmaṇā- “nirūhakāryakāraṇamayugmadānamasminnoktaṃ niṣiddhapūrva ca, yogasyānte kramādekaṃ tathā trīnityādīn snehān prāha” (?) iti, tannirastaṃ jñeyam
kiñca, ayugmānityanena punarvetyanena ca yatrānuvṛttyāanuvāsanaṃ deyaṃ tatrāyugmakaṃ nirūhāntaritaṃ ca kartavyamityarthaḥ, tena yathoktasaṅkhyākānnirūhān dattvā yathoktasaṅkhyayā sneho deyaḥ
viṣamasaṅkhyopādānaṃ tu madhyavidhayāapi dvyahacaturahādigrāhakaṃ bhavati, tenottaratra vakṣyamāṇasaṅkhyānuvāsanaṃ na virodhīti brūte
jatūkarṇeapyuktaṃ- “nirūhe vyuṣite bhuktavatoanuvāsanaṃ paraṃ dvitīyeahani pañcame vā tathaikādaśāheapakarṣato dvitricaturādi(?) vātādiṣūcyate” iti
avaśyamiti vacanādekāhasādhyeapi vyādhāvavaśyaṃ saptadinacchedaḥ kartavya iti darśayati
yadyapivirecanānantaraṃ niṣiddha eva nirūhaḥ pañcakarmīyāyāṃ siddhau, tathā nirūḍhasya virecanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathāapi tatkālameva sa niṣedhaḥ; tena tricaturādidineapi prasaktinirāsārthamidaṃ vacanam

yattu virecanānantaraṃ navameahnyanuvāsanakālāduttarakālameva nirūhavidhānaṃ, tenārvāgbasteḥ prasaktirapi na syādityucyate; tanna, yatoanuvāsanaśuddhyapekṣasaṃsarjanakramasyeyaṃ vidhā, yadāavaraśuddhyā tryaheṇaiva peyādikramaḥ samāpyate, tadā caturthadineanuvāsanadānāt pañcame ṣaṣṭhe vā dine nirūhaḥ prasajjyeta, atastannirāsārthametadvacanam
nirūhānantaraṃ tu saṃsarjanakramo nāstyeva, tena tryahaṃ snehaṃ dattvā virecanaprasaktirastyeva
saptāhādarvāk saptāhaṃ yāvacca nirūhavirecanavarjane hetumāha- taddhyasyetyādi
yattu “āsaptāhādvireko vā tataścāpi nirūhaṇam” iti tantrāntare proktaṃ, tacca saṃsargavidhayā kriyamāṇasaṃśodhanakrame jñeyam
ayaṃ cāsthāpanaguṇaḥ, anuvāsanasya tu dehe nirūheṇa’ ityādinā granthena guṇān vakṣyati
vayaḥ sthāpayatīti vayaḥsthāpayitā; vayaḥsthāpanatvaṃ cāsya srotaḥśuddhikaratvāt
śiśuvṛddhayūnāṃ niratyaya ityanena vamanavirecanābhyāmutkarṣa ucyate, te hi śiśuvṛddhayorniṣiddhe
sarvagadāpahatvaṃ saṃśamanena jñeyaṃ, sarvān vikārān śamayedityanena doṣasaṃśodhanadvārā sarvagadāpahatvamucyata iti na paunaruktyaṃ; kiṃvā sarvān vikārāniti sarvāvasthān vikārāniti viśeṣaḥ
nirūheṇa viśuddhamārge iti vacanānnirūhaśodhita eva mārge saṃsarjadanuvāsanaṃ yathoktaguṇakartṛ bhavatīti darśayati

na tailadānādityatra tailaśabdena snehopalakṣaṇena kecidghṛtamapi grāhayanti, kintu tailamevātra vātaharapradhānatayā brūte iti yuktaṃ paśyāmaḥ; tathā hyatra auṣṇyācchaityamityuktam, auṣṇyaṃ ca na sarpiṣīti; snehā majjavarjitā anuvāsanādhikṛtā apyapradhānatvānnātra ghṛtamanumanyate
paramastītyādau dravyamiti kāraṇaṃ, tacca kāraṇamanilapraśamanena jñeyam, ‘nānvāsanāt kiñcidihāsti karma’ iti kecit paṭhanti
tailaṃ cānuvāsane pakvameva jñeyam; apakvasya tu ‘na cāmaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ sa hyabhiṣyandayedgudam’ (si.a.4) ityanena niṣiddhatvāt

atra tailānilayorviparītaguṇayormelake dravyaprabhāvāttailameva vātaṃ hanti, na vātastailam; aṇutvaṃ guṇo yadyapi taile vāte cāsti, tathāapīha prabhāvādvātasūkṣmāvayavasambaddhaṃ tailaṃ snehādinā vātaṃ jayati, tena samānamapyaṇutvamiha viruddhārthakāryeveti
mūladṛṣṭāntena cānuvāsanena sākṣāttarpaṇīyasya gudasya dehamūlatvaṃ darśayati, uktaṃ hi parāśare- “mūlaṃ gudaṃ śarīrasya sirāstatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ
sarvaṃ śarīraṃ puṣṇanti mūrdhānaṃ yāvadāśritāḥ” iti; tathāanuvāsanādapi naro balavīryādyupetoapatyavāṃśca syādityarthaḥ
bhagnā iti bhagnakāyāḥ; rugṇā iti sandhimuktāḥ
atra śuddhavātādiṣvanuvāsanaṃ, bhaktānabhinandanaprakāreṣu ca nirūha ityādyarthoanusaraṇīyaḥ
samprati keṣu ca kaśca bastiriti praśnasyotaram- uṣṇābhibhūteṣvityādi
uṣṇābhibhūte tathā śītābhibhūte iti vaktavye, yena ‘sarvatra’ iti karoti, tena snigdharūkṣaguruladhvabhibhūteapi tadviparītauṣadhasampādito vastirdeya iti darśayati
yeṣāṃ ca doṣeṣu nibaddhamāyuriti ye saṃśodhanaharaṇamātreṇaiva prāṇāñjahati
basterbahuviṣayāṃ stutimācakṣāṇaḥ ‘kiṅguṇo bastiḥ’ iti praśnasyaivottaraṃ punarāha- śākhāgatā ityādi
śākhākoṣṭhamarmagatā ityanena trividhaśākhādirogamargo gṛhītaḥ; marmajaśabdena hi madhyamarogamārgāśrayiṇāṃ sandhijānāmapi sāhacaryādgrahaṇam; iha marmāsthisndhayo hi madhyamo rogamārga uktaḥ
sarvāvayavāṅgajaśabdena ca prādeśikasarvāṅgabhedādapyuktagrahaṇam; vāyoḥ paramiti vāyoḥ paro na kaścit śreṣṭha iti yāvat
etena yadyapi kaphapitte api rogakāraṇe bhavataḥ, tathāapi vāyureva śreṣṭha ityucyate
pittādītyatrādiśabdena kaphasya grahaṇaṃ, (na ca malaśabdena kaphasya grahaṇaṃ,) malaśabdena cetaradhātumalānāṃ khamalādīnāṃ ca grahaṇam
vikṣepasaṅghātakara iti viyogamelakakaraḥ; etena, yasmādvāyureva doṣamaladhātūnāṃ saṃyogavibhāgau karoti, tena doṣadūṣyaviṇmalamelakarūpanikhilavyādhikaraṇe vāyureva pradhānaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ
kiṃvā āśayaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ viḍādibhiḥ sambadhyate, sthānena ca sthānino labhyante, viḍādisaṃyogavibhāgenaiva ca sarvavyādhikaraṇaparigraho bhavati
ato bastāvardhacikitsārūpatā tathā sarvacikitsārūpatā ca yuktaiva
saṃsnehya kāyamiti vīryarūpeṇa sāreṇa kāyaṃ vyāpya, uktaṃ hi- “vīryeṇa bastirādatte doṣānāpādamastakāt” (su.ci.a.35) iti
snehaśabdena ca sāroabhidhīyate; yathā- “dehaḥ snehaparikṣayāt” (ci.a.8) iti
‘āśayalāghavāni’ ityatra ‘āmayalāghavāni’ iti pāṭhe rogopaśāntirityanantaraṃ vāśabdo jñeyaḥ, tena rogopaśāntiriha nirūhasādhyavikārāṇāmupaśāntiḥ
āśvāgate iti śīghraṃ pratyāgate, anyastu vidheya iti tadaivānyaḥ sneho deyaḥ
punaḥ snehadānopapattimāha- sneho na saṃsnehayati hyatiṣṭhanniti
kālastatoardhenetyatra ardhaśabdo na samaprativacanaḥ; tena triṃśadadha ṣoḍaśa bhavanti
ekamanuvāsanaṃ dattvā dīyanta iti sānvasanāḥ, evamanuvāsanena pratyekaṃ yogād dvādaśa nirūhāścaturviṃśatirbastayo bhavanti
nirūhāntaritāśca ṣaṭ syuriti nirūheṇāntarī kṛtāḥ, evaṃ ca dvādaśa bastayaḥ pūraṇīyāḥ
pañcaiva parādimadhyā iti pañca snehā ante madhye ādau ca yeṣāṃ vibhaktāste tathā; atra cādau snehadvayam, ante ca snehadvayaṃ, nirūhatrayamadhye caikamanuvāsanam, evaṃ pañca snehā bhavanti
ye tu nirūhadina evānuvāsanaṃ vadanti tanmate ādāveka eva, anteapi dināntare ekaḥ, evaṃ pañca bhavanti; evaṃ karmakālayorapi nirūhadina eva dināntare vāanuvāsanaṃ vyākhyeyam
atra caikasnehāntaritānāṃ nirūhāṇāṃ dāne vātakṣobho nāśaṅkanīyaḥ, karmādiṣu nirūhā yāpanābastirūpā dīyante, te snigdhā eveti kṛtvā na vātakṣobhakā bhavanti

ete ca karmādayo yadyapi śāstrapradeśeṣu na vyavahriyante, tathāapi tadvidyavyavahārārthameveyaṃ karmādisañjñā, yathā yamakamahācchapānādisañjñā; tena karmādisañjñāyāḥ śāstre vyavahārādarśanāt karmādipratipādako granthoanārṣa iti yaducyate, tannirastam

tathāhi jatūkarṇaḥ- “bastayastriṃśat ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca karmakalayogāḥ; nirūhāḥ snehāntaritā dvādaśa ṣaṭ trayaḥ; ekasnehārambhāḥ pañcatryekāntāḥ” iti; hārīteapi- “triṃśakaṃ karma budhā vadanti” ityādyuktam
atra ye ‘vātādikānāṃ’ iti paṭhanti, teṣāmādiśabdena pittakaphayorapi grahaṇaṃ; bahuvacanaṃ tu tadguṇasaṃvijñānabahuvrīhiṇā vātasya grahaṇādbahutvasaṅkhyāyogādupapannam
yathoktaṃ kuṣṭhanidāne- ‘vātādiṣu praduṣṭeṣu” (ni.a.5) iti, tathā kiyantaḥśirasīyeapi “vātādīnāṃ rasādīnāṃ” (sū.a.17) iti bahutvaṃ nirdiṣṭam

atra caturṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ ca snehānāṃ yugmarūpāṇāmapi dānamaviruddhameva, etadanuvāsanasya nirūhāṅgatayā snehanārthaṃ kriyamāṇatvāt; ayugmadānaṃ tu ‘bastīnayugmān’ ityanena svapradhānatayāanuvāsanasya vihitamiti bhinnaviṣayatayā na virodhaḥ; yataḥ snehanaprayojanamanuvāsanaṃ snehe bhūta evāyugmadānena nivartanīyaṃ; kiṃvā, ayugmā tantrato vyākhyānena saṅkhyaivocyate, tathāhi- trīn, pañca, trīn catura iti sapta, pañca catura iti nava, pañca ṣaḍityekādaśa, iti pañca vikalpā iha vidhīyante
tantrāntare snehasya yugmadānamuktaṃ, yathā- “rūkṣasya bahuvātasya dvau trīn vāapyanuvāsanān
dadyāt snigdhatanuṃ jñātvā tataḥ paścānnirūhayet” (su.ci.a.37) iti
viśuddhadehasyeti etacca pañcakarmasampādanīyanṛviṣayatvaṃ śuddhipūrvakatvaṃ śirovirecanasyehocyate; tena vamanādināaśuddheapi śirovirecanaikasampadyi puruṣeayaṃ kramojñeyaḥ
trirdvirathaikaśa iti taddina eva doṣāṇāmutkṛṣṭatvādibalatraividhyamapekṣya yathāyogyatayā yojyam
timiraṃ ca paśyediti tamovyāptaṃ sarvaṃ paśyedityarthaḥ
tīkṣṇaṃ tu punarna yoge iti ayoge śirovirecanasya punastīkṣṇaṃ śirovirecanaṃ deyam
āturasvasthasukha iti vacanena āture āmayasyāpahantṛtayā, svasthe ca balāyurvṛddhikartṛtayā yathoktapañcakarmaprayogaḥ sukhaheturbhavatīti jñeyam
svasthe ca pañcakarmapravṛttiḥ “mādhavaprathame māsi” (sū.a.7) ityādinā sūtrasthāne proktaiva jñeyā
tāvān bhaveddviḥ parihārakāla iti bastyādiprayoge yāvān kālo vyāpyate, tataḥ kālāddviguṇaṃ kālaṃ yāvat parihāryatvenoktaṃ parihartavyam
atra ādiśabdena vamanavirecanaśirovirecanānāṃ grahaṇaṃ, bastestvādau vyutpādanena prādhānyaṃ darśayati
eta āviṣkṛtatamā ihoktāḥ; tena krodhāticintanādayo yeapyupakalpanīyādau vamanādiprayoge niṣiddhāsteapi na sevyā eva
netre baddhe viṣamaṃ praṇīte ca gudāvayavaruddhatvānna yāti
tathā ‘na sukhaṃ nireti’ ityādinā ‘sucirācca kena’ iti praśnasyottaram
na sukhaṃ niretīti cireṇa duḥkhaṃ kṛtvā cāgacchatītyarthaḥ
vāteativṛddhe sneho gude vātena pratihatatvānna yātyāśayaṃ, tataḥ śīghramāgacchati; alpabale gude snehaṃ dhārayituṃ na śaknoti puruṣaḥ, alpabalatvaṃ gudasya saṃvaraṇīvalīdārbalyāt
atra śūlādīnnirīkṣya śuddhavātabhrāntyā snehaṃ prayuṅkte, nāvaraṇaṃ jānāti, ata eva ‘abudhaḥ’ iti kṛtam
ativṛddheanile nādau śastaṃ snehena bṛṃhaṇam” iti

paraspareṇa pratibaddhamārgā ato durgrahā bhavanti, tathā dhātubhiśca raktādibhiḥ sandūṣitāḥ sammūrcchitāḥ santo durjñeyā bhavanti, avijñātāśca svairbheṣajairna praśamaṃ vrajanti; svairbheṣajairiti mārgāvarodhādikāraṇadoṣadhātvantaranirapekṣakairekadoṣabheṣajaiḥ; taddhi tathābhūtānāṃ bheṣajaṃ yaugikaṃ na bhavatyeva, atoanupaśamo yukta evaḥ evaṃ ca doṣāṇāṃ parasparāvarodhān tathā dhātusammūrcchanaviśeṣāṃścāvagamyaiva vyādhau prapañcoanusaraṇīyaḥ
mithyopacārācceti bheṣajānāṃ tathāakaraṇāt, yathā- bheṣajasya samyakpariṇāme sati bhoktavyam
yadyaugikaṃ bheṣajaṃ tat samyak prayuktaṃ sidhyatīti siddhāntaḥ
pañcakarmāṇi yeṣāṃ na kāryāṇītyanena vyastāni samastāni ca yeṣāṃ na kāryāṇi, tāni pṛthagvakṣyante
yadyapi ca vimāne janapadoddhvaṃsanīye (vi.a.3) rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) ca anapavādapratīkārādayoanupakramaṇīyatvenoktā eva, tathāapīha prakaraṇāgatatvāt punarucyante
caṇḍādiṣu pravṛttirbheṣajasyāśakyatvānniṣidhyate; kṛtaghnādiṣu cādharmavaśādeva bheṣajaṃ na sidhyati, pratyutādhārmikapratikriyayāadharma eva bhavatīti nivṛttirvidhīyate
sato rājñaḥ bhiṣajaśca dveṣṭīti sadrājabhiṣajāṃ dveṣṭā, kiṃvā saditi rājño bhiṣajaśca viśeṣaṇam
vairī vaidyāpakārakaḥ, vaidyadveṣṭā tu nāpakāraka iti viśeṣaḥ
śrāntādīnāṃ vicchedapāṭhena prāṇoparodhasya pūrvāpekṣayā hīnamātratvaṃ darśayati
yadyapi cātrādhyāyānte sarveṣveva nirdiṣṭeṣvavasthāyāṃ niṣiddhamapi vakṣyati, tathāapīha vidhānenātrāvaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ vamanamiti bodhyam
śeṣāstu vamyā ityabhidhāyāpi pīnasādīn punarvamanaviṣayatayā darśayan teṣu viśeṣeṇa vamanasya yaugikatāṃ darśayati; evamuttaratrāpi punarvirecanādiviṣayopadarśane vyākhyeyam

pradhānatamamityanena mahārogādhyāye “kedārasetubhede” (sū.a.20) ityādinaikadeśenoktaṃ prādhānyakhyāpakaṃ granthaṃ grāhayati; tena yaduktaṃ tatra- “vamanaṃ khalu sarvopakramebhyaḥ śleṣmaṇi pradhānatamaṃ manyante bhiṣajaḥ, taddhyādita evāmāśayamanupraviśya kevalaṃ vaikārikaṃ śleṣmamūlamapakarṣati, tatrāvajite śleṣmaṇyapi śarīrāntargatāḥ śleṣmavikārāḥ praśāntimāpadyante, yathā- bhinne kedārasetau śāliṣaṣṭikādīnyabhiṣyandamānānyambhasā praśoṣamāpadyante, tadvat” (sū.a.20) iti granthakhaṇḍakaṃ, tadiha sambadhyate; evaṃ virecanaprādhānye tathā bastiprādhānyeapi yadihaikadeśaṃ mahārogādhyāyoktaprādhānyakhyāpakagranthakhaṇḍakaṃ vakṣyati, tatra tadgranthādhyāhāreṇa yojanīyam
subhagakṣataguda iti subhagagudaḥ, kṣatagudaśca; anye tu subhagaṃ sukhasaṃvardhitamāhuḥ
atra cāpravṛttiḥ stokapravṛttiścāyoga eva; uktaṃ hi- “ayogaḥ prātilomyena na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam” (si.a.6) iti

baddhodarādāvādhmātānāṃ bastirniṣidhyate; tena “snigdhāya baddhodariṇe” ityādinā yāvacca “nirūhaṃ sānuvāsanam” (ci.a.13) iti granthena nirūhavidhānamaviruddhaṃ bhavati; anye tu udarādhyāya eva ‘baddhodariṇe’ ityanena savibandhodariviṣayaṃ nirūhaṃ varṇayanti, tenātra sāmānyena baddhodare nirūhaniṣedho na viruddhaḥ

ananuvāsanaviṣayopadarśane anāsthāpyeṣu bhuktabhaktaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tavdyudāsārthamabhuktabhaktopādanam; anuvāsanamabhuktasyānāvṛtatvādūrdhvaṃ yāti, na tu nirūha iti viśeṣaḥ; anuvāsanaṃ tu snehasya sūkṣmatayā visaraṇaśīlaṃ sāyaṃ dīyate; tena tāṃvatkālamabhojanācchūnyaśarīrasyordhvaṃ yāti

anuvāsanaṃ ca “śūle ca bhaktānabhinandane ca” (si.a.1) ityanena yadyapi vihitaṃ, tathāapīha bhaktānabhinandanahetvantarbhūtāyāmarucau tanniṣedho na viruddhaḥ; anabhinandanaṃ hyaśraddhāmātraṃ vātakṛtam, arucistu sarvadā anicchā; kevalavātarogaścāśraddhā, śuddhavātarogayuktoanuvāsanārhaḥ

nirūhaprādhānyakhyāpane vanaspatimūlocchedanavadityanena mahārogādhyāyoktabastiprādhānyakhyāpanagranthopadarśanaṃ; “yathā vanaspatermūle cchinne skandhaśākhāvarohakusumaphalapalāśādīnāṃ niyato vināśastadvat” (sū.a.20) iti, mūle drumaprasekavaccetyanena kalpanāsiddhyuktaṃ- “mūle niṣikto hi yathā drumaḥ syāt” (si.a.1) ityādiyathoktānuvāsanaprādhānyakhyāpanagranthagrahaṇaṃ karoti
pātukāma iti snehādipānakāmaḥ, pānaklānto dināntareapi pānajavyādhipīḍitaḥ
kṛte pibatāmiti śirovirecane kṛte snehān pibatāmityarthaḥ
anṛtau durdine cetyādau śītadoṣānityanena śītakāle dīyamānasya durdine ca kṛtasya pūtināsākartṛtvaṃ, grīṣmavarṣākṛtasya tu śirorogakartṛtvam; anye tu, anṛtudurdinamityanena avārṣikaṃ durdinamāhuḥ
pīnasoatra pakvapratiśyāyaḥ, taruṇe ca pratiśyāye śirovirekaniṣedha iti na virodhaḥ
apatantrakaḥ apatānakabheda eva niḥsañjñaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “niḥsañjñaḥ soapatantrakaḥ” (si.a.9) iti
muñjādīṣikāmivāsaktāmiti muñjāccharāvayavādyathā īṣikā śarikā āsaktā ākṛṣyate muñjānupaghātena, tathā śirasi pakvo doṣo hriyata ityarthaḥ
anṛtau śirovirecanaṃ niṣiddham, avasthāvaśena tadvidhānamāha- prāvṛḍityādi
ātyayikeapi śītādipratīkārārthamāha- kṛtrimaguṇopadhānāditi; kṛtrimaguṇopadhānaṃ rogabhiṣagjitīyoktaṃ kartavyam
grīṣmādiṣveva kālaviśeṣeṇauṣṇyādipratikriyāṃ darśayannāha- grīṣme pūrvāhṇe ityādi
adhyāyārthasaṅgrahamabhidhāya vamanādyaviṣayatvena tathā vamanādiviṣayatvena ca pratipādite vamanādinivṛttipravṛttiniścayaṃ niṣedhayannāha- na caikāntenetyādi
buddhimatetivacanena abuddhimatāmanuktohaṃ niṣedhayati; uktaṃ hi- “tasmādbuddhimatāmūhāpohavitarkāḥ, alpabuddhestu yathoktānugamanameva śreyaḥ” (vi.a.8) iti
atha kimarthaṃ yathoktānugamanameva śreya iti, tathā kimarthamekāntatāvadhāraṇaṃ na kartavyamityāha- utpadyatehītyādi
kāryamakāryaṃ syāditi kartavyatayoktamakaraṇīyaṃ syāditi, tathā varjitaṃ ca yat karma tat kāryaṃ syādavasthāviśeṣāt
avasthāṃ prāpya nirdiṣṭamityanena avasthāviśeṣa eva niṣiddhavidhānamutsargāpavādata ityavirodhaṃ darśayati; evamanyatrāpyapavādaviṣaye vamanādividhānamavasthāviśeṣaparatayā samādheyam
śāstropadeśe satyapi svabuvdyaivaśāstrānugatayāanuktamapi kartavyaṃ; yaduktaṃ- “pracaraṇamiva bhikṣukasya bījamiva karṣakasya sūtraṃ buddhimatāmalpamapyanalpajñānāya bhavati” (vi.a.8) iti
pūrvādhyāye vamanādipravṛttiviṣayādikamabhidhāya kalpanāsiddhyuktabastikalpanāyāḥ prapañcenābhidhānārthaṃ bastisūtrīyā siddhirucyate
kiṃyoniguṇaśca bastirityatra bastiḥ bastipuṭakaḥ, yoniḥ prabhavasthānam
snehasya vā keti anuvāsanasya kā praṇidhānamātrā

anuvāsanasya cātra prapañcoabhidhātavyaḥ; tenānuvāsanasya kalpamātrapraśnoatra boddhavyaḥ; yadā tu ‘snehasya vā kaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tadā snehasya nirūhadinadīyamānasya ko vidhirityarthaḥ, sa cottaragranthena saṅgatārtha eva
ke bastayaḥ keṣu hitā iti kebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ kiṃyonayā hitā bastaya ityarthaḥ

atra doṣādayo ye daśa parīkṣaṇīyāḥ proktāsteṣveva upakalpanīyoktadoṣabheṣajādyekādaśakasya tathā rogabhiṣagjitīyoktadaśaparīkṣyasyāvarodho vyākhyeyaḥ; anuktāvarodhaścāyaṃ yonivyāpattika evāsmābhiruktoanusaraṇīyaḥ
sarvakarmāṇi ceti vamanādīni ca doṣādīnapekṣya prayuktāni guṇakarāṇi bhavanti
sukarṇikānīti susamāhitakarṇikāni; ‘trikarṇikāni’ iti kecit paṭhanti, trikarṇikatvaṃ cāgre vakṣyamāṇam
tatra ṣaḍaṅgulamekavarṣāt prabhṛti yāvat ṣaḍvarṣaṃ, dvādaśavarṣasyāṣṭāṅgulaṃ netraṃ bhavati, viṃśativarṣasya dvādaśāṅgulaṃ netraṃ bhavati

atra vyutkramābhidhānena ṣaḍvarṣādarvāgviṃśativarṣādūrdhvaṃ ca netramānavikalpo nāsti, ṣaḍvarṣādūrdhvaṃ netramānavikalpoastīti darśayati; tena ṣaḍvarṣādūrdhvaṃ pratyabdamaṅgulatṛtīyabhāgavṛddhirbhavati, dvādaśādūrdhvaṃ pratyabdamardhāṅgulavṛddhiḥ, evamuktamānapūraṇaṃ bhavati
suśrute netramānabheda uktaḥ, sa nātivirodhakāritayā upekṣaṇīya eva
uktaṃ hi tatra- “sāṃvatsarikāṣṭadviraṣṭavarṣāṇāṃ ṣaḍaṣṭadaśāṅgulaṃ netraṃ, pañcaviṃśativarṣādūrdhvaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam” (su.ci.a.35) iti
karkandhuśabdeneha śṛgālabadarī svalpā gṛhyate; uktaṃ hi suśrute- “kolāsthimātracchidraṃ” (su.ci.a.35) iti
bṛhadbadarīgrahaṇe tu kaniṣṭhāpramāṇāgraṃ tadvahanaṃ nārhati; kecidevaṃ virodhaṃ paśyanto badarāsthimajjānamiha karkandhūśabdena grāhayanti
yathāvaya iti yasmin vayasi netraṃ vihitaṃ, tadvayaḥsthasyaivāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mūleagre ca tulyapariṇāhaṃ netraṃ kartavyam
ekā karṇikāagre kartavyā netrasyāntaḥpraveśanirāsārthaṃ, bastinibandhane dve iti bastinibandhanaprayojanake dve
vayo vīkṣya yathānurūpamiti vayobhedena yathoktena yo bastiryasyocitapramāṇo bhavati, sa tasya netre nibandhanīyaḥ
plavaja iti prasevakagalaḥ pakṣī ‘plava’ iti khyātaḥ
aṅkapādaḥ carmacaṭakaḥ, tasya carma grāhyaṃ bastyartham

śuklapakṣe iti śuklapakṣasya sarvārambheṣu praśastatvāt, hārītena tu kṛṣṇapakṣa evātra vihitaḥ; uktaṃ hi- “kṛṣṇapakṣe kāryaṃ, janmani sarvarogā hatāḥ suhatā bhavantīti vadanti śāstrajñāḥ; śukle devā jātāḥ, kṛṣṇeasurāśca sarvarogāśca; tasmādrogacikitsā kṛṣṇe sadaiva kartavyā” iti

atra balādīnāmauṣadhānāmautsargikakvāthavidhināaṣṭamadanaphalādhikaṣaṭṣaṣṭipalatvaṃ “kvāthaḥ kvāthyasamaḥ” itivacanād bahukvātho bhavati; bastau ca puṭatrayadāneapi pratipuṭake daśapalakvāthadānaniyamāt triṃśatpalāni paramupayujyante, śeṣastu yadyapi niṣprayojanastathāapi maharṣivacanādyāvatpramāṇamuktaṃ tāvataiva kriyamāṇaḥ kvāthoatra guṇavān bhavatīti, tena na mīmāṃsyametat; uktaṃ hi- “yathā kurvanti, sa upāyaḥ” (sū.a.26); iti kiṃvā, upayuktakvāthyadravyamānavibhāgodāharaṇārthametaduktaṃ, tena tadanusāreṇopayuktakvāthasādhanayogyamānameva kvāthyaṃ grahītavyam
yavānyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ pratinirūhaṃ picumānatvaṃ; picuḥ karṣaḥ
etacca snehamānaṃ prakṛtisthe puruṣe vakṣyamāṇavyavasthayā jñeyam

‘yuktyā madhusaindhave ca’ ityanena madhusaindhavayoḥ prakṛtyādyapekṣayāaniyataṃ mānaṃ darśayati; cakāro māṃsarasakṣīragomūtrādīnāṃ cāniyataṃ mānaṃ darśayati; eṣāṃ ca mānavyavasthāmagre kaṣāyamānaprastāve darśayiṣyāmaḥ
tailāktagātramiti abhyaṅgasāhacaryāt svedoapi jñeyaḥ, tenābhyaktasvinnamityarthaḥ; uktaṃ hyanyatra “anuvāsitamāsthāpayedabhyaktasvinnaśarīram” (su.ci.a.38) iti
sameathaveṣannataśīrṣake veti vikalpadvayamāturecchayā kartavyaṃ; kiṃvā, unnatakaṭīdeśasya puruṣasya samaṃ, tucchakaṭīkasyonnataśīrṣaṃ śayanaṃ vidheyam, evaṃ hi tayoḥ samyagbastirdehānusārī bhavati
savyeneti vāmena; vāmapārśvaśayanaprayojanaṃ ‘vāmāśraye hi’ ityādinā vakṣyamāṇam
manuṣyaṃ yathoktasarvaguṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ praṇayediti sambandhaḥ
svabhujopadhānaṃ yathā bhavati tathā śayānam; upadhānaṃ gaṇḍuḥ
vāmaṃ sakthi prasārya, tadupari dakṣiṇaṃ sakthi saṅkocya, visṛtasavyasakthisaṅkucitadakṣiṇasakthītyarthaḥ
snigdhe gude netracaturthabhāgamiti karṇikāvacchinnaṃ sarvaṃ caturthabhāgamiti
akampanetyādau kampanaṃ calanaṃ, vepanaṃ vepathuḥ, lāghavaṃ śīghrakriyatā; ādiśabdena bastigrahaṇapīḍanādi gṛhyate
prapīḍya caikagrahaṇena dattamityanena viśramya punaḥ pīḍanaṃ vāyujanakaṃ niṣedhayati
na yāti dhāreti tiryakpraṇidhāne sati gudavalīrodho bhavati, tena dhārā na yāti
‘pūrvaṃ hi dadyād’ iti granthaṃ kecidanārṣamāhuḥ; tantrāntareṣu tvasyārthasya dṛṣṭatvādyukta evāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ; ucyate hi suśrute “dattvāaadau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaśca paladvayam
vāmapārśvaśayanaṃ yaduktaṃ tasya prayojanamāha- vāmāśraye ityādi

vāmāśraye yasmād grahaṇīgude, tena vāmapārśvasuptasya grahaṇīgude prakṛtisthe bhavataḥ, prakṛtisthe ca gude gudasya bastinā samyagupaśleṣād vyāptirbhavati, tathā valayaśca līnā bhavanti, tena sukhaṃ bastiryāti, grahaṇīgudayoḥ prakṛtisthatayā ca bastirvyāpya sukhaṃ grahaṇīṃ bhāvayatīti boddhavyam
viḍvātetyādau niṣkṛṣya mukte iti nalikāmākṛṣya viḍvātavege mukte
datte tu bastau uttānadehaḥ kṛtopadhānaśca syāt

etadvātādibhedena ekādibastidānavidhānaṃ; na tu tridoṣe prathamo vātaṃ jayati, dvitīyaḥ pittaṃ jayati, tṛtīyaḥ kaphamityādi vyākhyeyaṃ; yataḥ, “snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane samāṃsaḥ” ityādinā pavanādibhedenaiva saṅkhyāniyamaṃ kariṣyati
evaṃ svamārgāccānilameko bastirapakarṣati, pittaṃ dvitīyastu svamārgāditi pittaṃ dvāveva jayataḥ, kaphaṃ traya eva jayantīti jñeyaṃ; svamārgāditi svasthānāt

yadyapi ca bastiḥ pakvāśayagatameva doṣaṃ jayatītyuktaṃ, tathāapi pittādisthāneapi viśeṣabastividhisāmarthyāddoṣaharaṇamucyate; tena, utsargatastadgatadoṣaharaṇaṃ viśiṣṭavidhānena ca sthānāntaragatadoṣaharaṇaṃ bhavati

atra dvitīyaḥ pittamapakarṣati, tṛtīyaḥ kaphamapakarṣatītyucyate; tathāapi prathamadvitīyayorapi pittakaphāpahatvamastyeva, paraṃ dvitīyena pittāpaharaṇaṃ, tṛtīyena ca kaphāpaharaṇaṃ sthānapratyāsattyā kriyata iti kṛtvā dvitīyaḥ pittaṃ harati, tṛtīyaḥ kaphaṃ haratīti coktam

pittakaphayośca yadyapi sukhaṃ cikitsitaṃ bastirna bhavati, tathāapi vātāvarake vātānubandhe vā pitte kaphe caitadbastidānaṃ jñeyam; uktaṃ hi suśrute- “bastirvāte ca pitte ca kaphe rakte ca śasyate” (su.ci.a.35) iti
śālyannamityādau jīrṇe iti āsthāpanopalepe koṣṭhasthe jīrṇe
tanumāṃsarasādibhojanaṃ ceha nirūheṇa manāgupahatasya vahneḥ paripālanārtham
peyādikramastvatra na kriyate, virecanavadihāmasyābhāvāt; ata eva suśrute peyādikramaṃ tyaktvā rasādikrama uktaḥ
paribṛṃhaṇārthamityanena lekhanārthaṃ kriyamāṇe nirūhe paribṛṃhaṇārthamanuvāsanaṃ tadahaḥ kartavyamiti darśayati
ata eva kalpanāsiddhāvapi- “narastato niśyanuvāsanārhaḥ” (si.a.1) ityanena tadaharanuvāsanasyāvaśyakatvamuktaṃ; jatūkarṇeapyuktaṃ- “jīrṇe sāyaṃ kṛtānnaṃ ca puṣṭyarthamanuvāsayet” iti
nirūhapādāṃśasamena taileneti nirūhapādapramāṇena, caturviṃśatipale nirūhe ṣaṭpalena snehenetyarthaḥ; iyaṃ cottamā mātrāanuvāsanasya; uktaṃ hyanyatra- “uttamā ṣaṭpalī proktā madhyamā tripalī bhavet
kanīyasī sārdhapalā tridhā mātrāanuvāsane” iti; suśruteapyetāvanmānameva snehasyānuvāsana mātrābastivibhāgenānuvāsane uktam
nirūhe tu triṃśanmātrākālaṃ yāvaduttānasya sthāpanaṃ manyante
samprati trividho yo dvādaśaprasṛto nirūhastasya kaṣāyasnehamātrāṃ nirūpayannāha- bhāgā ityādi
bhāgāḥ kaṣāyasya pañcetyanena sarvatraiva doṣe svasthe ca puruṣe dvādaśaprasṛtabhāgarūpe nirūhe pañcabhāgāḥ kaṣāyasya bhavanti, tena pañca prasṛtāḥ kaṣāyasya
snehasya ca doṣabhedena svasthe ca mānabhedamāha- pitte ityādi
pitte snehasya ṣaṣṭhaḥ, tathā prakṛtau sthite ca puruṣe svasthe ṣaṣṭha ityarthaḥ; tatra ṣaṇṇāṃ pūraṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ, tena dvādaśaprasṛtasya ṣaṣṭho bhāgo dviprasṛtaṃ bhavati
vāte tu vṛddhe caturtho bhāgaḥ; snehacaturtho bhāgaḥ prasṛtatrayam
asminnarthe hārītaḥ- “kvāthasya pañcaprasṛtā vibhāgāḥ, snehasya ṣaṣṭho hyadhike tu pitte
svasthe ca tāvat, pavane caturthaḥ, kapheaṣṭamoatyantagate(?) vikalpaḥ” iti

eṣā snehamātrā hīnamātreapi nirūhe kvāthasnehayoruktamātrānusāreṇa yojanīyā; śeṣaṇāṃ tu madhukalkasaindhavānāmiha mātrāniyamo noktaḥ, teṣāmapi prakṛtyādibhadenāniyatatvāt; tena madhvādīnāṃ prakṛtyādyanusāreṇa prasṛtamānena dvādaśaprasṛtatvaṃ pūraṇīyam
tatra jatūkaṇapratyayāt sarvatra kalkasya paladvayaṃ bhavati

uktaṃ hi tatra “caturviṃśatike puṭake peṣyāṇāṃ dvipalaṃ, kiñcicca madhusaindhavāt, sneho vakṣyamāṇaḥ, śeṣaṃ kaṣāyasya; vāte tailaṣaṭpalaṃ svasthe ca; catvāri pitte ghṛtasya, kaphe trīṇi tailasya” iti; saindhavaṃ tu karṣapramāṇamasti; yataḥ suśrute- “saindhavākṣaṃ samādāya madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam” (su.ci.a.38) ityādyuktam; hārīta tu- “kṣaudraṃ tu deyaṃ prasṛtapramāṇaṃ dvitīyamāhurlavaṇasya cākṣam” ityuktaṃ; tenānayā diśā saindhavamadhukalpanā
yathoktakaṣāyasnehakalkamadhusaindhavāpūritāṃśapūraṇaṃ cāvāpenaiva kartavyam; āvāpaścātrānuktoapyuttaratra vakṣyamāṇo vātādibhedena māṃsarasakṣīragomūtrādiko jñeyaḥ
vakṣyati hi- “snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane nirūho, dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte
trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ” iti
hārītaapyuktaṃ “snehaṃ guḍaṃ māṃsarasaṃ payaśca hyamlāni mūtrāṇi ca saindhavaṃ ca
etāni sarvāṇyapi yojayīta nirūhayoge madanāt phalaṃ ca” iti
yattu tantrāntare- dvādaśaprasṛtapūraṇaṃ prati pratidravyavibhāgenoktaṃ; yathā- “dattvāaadau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam
ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtaṃ kṣipet
evaṃ sukalpito bastirdvādaśaprasṛto bhavet” (su.ci.a.38) iti; tadvātaviṣayameva, snehasya vātaghnatvāt; kintvatra yaccatuḥprasṛtaṃ kaṣāyasya manyate, tadasmattantrānumatameva
trīṇi ṣaṭ dve daśa trīṇi palānyanilarogiṇām
pitte catvāri catvāri dve dvipañca catuṣṭayam
ṣaṭ trīṇi dve daśa trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam” iti; tadasmattantrānugatatvādanumatameva

ādye varṣe bālasya palamāne nirūhe kvāthādi yathoktamānānusāreṇa vaktavyam; ardhaprasṛtābhivṛddhiḥ tataḥ prativarṣaṃ bhavati; tena dvādaśavarṣe ṣaṭprasṛto bastirbhavati; dvādaśādūrdhvamaṣṭādaśavarṣaparyantaṃ prativarṣaṃ prasṛtavṛddhyā dvādaśaprasṛtapūraṇaṃ bhavati; ‘dvādaśataḥ paraṃ syuḥ’ ityanenādhikapramāṇabastimānaṃ mahātyayakaraṃ kaiścidanumataṃ niṣedhayati; yathā hārīte ekīyamataṃ paṭhyate- “ardhāḍhakaṃ paramatamaṃ pramāṇam” iti; tathā suśruteapi (?)- “dvādaśaprasṛtaṃ kecit triṃśatpalamathāapare” ityādi
bālavṛddhayoryathoktaiva nirūhamātrā prasṛtapramāṇā kāryā, viśeṣeṇa tayorbastirmṛduḥ kāryaḥ
tīkṣṇatvamārdavakaraṃ ca vidhānaṃ vakṣyati; yathā- “tīkṣṇatvaṃ mūtrapīlvagnilavaṇakṣārasarṣapaiḥ
samprati ‘śayane vidhiḥ kaḥ’ iti praśnasyottaramāha- nātyucchritamityādi
pūrvaṃ yaḥ śayanavidhiruktaḥ sa tātkālikaḥ, ayaṃ tūttarakālika iti viśeṣaḥ
pradhānaṃ mahanmṛdu cāstaraṇaṃ pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇaṃ, tenopapannaṃ yuktam
prākśīrṣakamiti “prācyāṃ diśi sthitā devāstatpūjārthaṃ ca prākśirāḥ” (su.sū.a.19) iti vacanāt
yūṣādi bhojyavidhānaṃ yathākramaṃ kaphe, pitte, vāte; kiṃvā, agnyapekṣaṃ yathāyogyatayā vyākhyeyam
etadādyamiti pradhānam, autsargikamiti yāvat; tena viśeṣavidhānenāpavādoapyasya bhaviṣyatīti sūcayati
trisnehayukta ityanena, majjaparityāgaṃ sarvabastisiddhaṃ smārayati; uktaṃ hyanyatra- “vijñeyastrividhaḥ sneho bastyartha majjavarjitaḥ” iti

sthirādivargasyetyādau madhusaindhave yadyapi sāmānyenoktabastividhānalabdhe, tathāapi tailādīnāmatrāprakarṣārthaṃ punastayorabhidhānaṃ, kiṃvā sāmānyavidhismaraṇārthamatrābhidhānam; evamanyatrāpi sāmānyavidhiprāptasya punarabhidhāne vyākhyeyam
yaṣṭyāhvayasyetyādikāścatvāraḥ pitte, pūrvaṃ tūktāḥ pañca vāte
suśītatvamihautsargikaṃ mṛdukoṣṭheṣvadhikaṃ pittahitatvāt; anayā ca diśāaparapittaharabastāvapi śītatvaṃ jñeyam
atra kvāthadaśaprasṛtena tathā kalkena kṣaudrādinā ca yadyapi mānamadhikaṃ bhavati, tathāapyevameva dravyasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśaprasṛta eva bastirdeyaḥ, tadadhikamānasya niṣiddhatvāt
paṭoletyādau paṭolādipippalyantaistoyaṃ sādhayitvā pūrvavad dvitīyaḥ, kapharogiṇe dvipañcamūlyādibhistṛtīyaḥ kartavyaḥ
atra piṇḍītakakvāthoapyāvāpakalpo yena praviśati; piṇḍītakaḥ madanaḥ
rūkṣauṣadhairatyapatarpitebhyoapyeteṣu kuṣṭhādirogeṣvayaṃ datto balaṃ karotīti yojanā
uktānāṃ vātādiharabastīnāṃ saṅkhyākalpanāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ darśayannāha- snigdhoṣṇa ityādi
na paraṃ vidheyā ityanena tantrāntaravihitaṃ caturthabastidānamatyarthaśarīrahiṃsakaṃ niṣedhayati; yathā suśrute- “dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathārhataḥ
samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅge tu prāpte bastiṃ nivartayet” (su.ci.a.32) ityanenoktaṃ caturthadānamiti
samprati vātādibhedena pratibhojanaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tathāanuvāsanaṃ cāha- rasena vāte ityādi
vāte bilvatailānuvāsanaṃ, pitte jīvanīyasādhitaṃ, kaphe ca madanaphalasādhitam

atra bilvatailādīni vakṣyamāṇāni vyākhyānayanti; tena snehavyāpatsiddhau yad vakṣyati “daśamūlaṃ” (si.a.4) ityādinā bilvatailaṃ, jīvanīyaṃ ca “jīvantī madanaṃ” (si.a.4) ityādinā vakṣyamāṇayamakaṃ, tathā “madanairvāamlasaṃyuktaiḥ” (si.a.4) ityādinā vakṣyamāṇaṃ madanatailaṃ jñeyam
pūrvasiddhau bilvatailādīnyabhyaṅgasevānuvāsanārthaṃ nirdiṣṭāni, tadabhidhāyikā ceyaṃ siddhirityanantaraṃ snehavyāpatsiddhirucyate; snehānāmānuvāsanikānāṃ tadvyāpadāṃ ca bheṣajānāmabhidhāyikā siddhiḥ
bastiprayojyāḥ snehā etacchlokābhihitā ityarthaḥ; prapañcānabhidheyā ye tvapareatrārthāḥ “snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ ca” ityādinā vaktavyāḥ, te na prapañcavācyā iti te na pratijñātāḥ
daśamūlamityādau bhūtīkaṃ kattṛṇaṃ yavānikā vā; kākanāsā vāyasīphalam, anye tu vāsāphalaṃ ‘kāyuyāṭuṭī’ iti khyātaṃ dravyāntaramevāhuḥ
bilvādyo gaṇaḥ daśamūlaṃ; daśamūlaṃ cātra kvāthakalkābhyāmapi deyam

etāśca vyāpado mithyāyogena snehasya kriyamāṇā ucyante; pratijñātaṃ hi ‘mithyāpraṇihitānāṃ ca vyāpada’ iti, tena snehāyogātiyogajanyavyāpadāmihānavasara eva; anuvāsanāyogātiyogajanyāśca vyāpadaḥ kalpanāsiddhāvevoktāḥ; tadbheṣajaṃ cātisnehite śodhanabastiḥ, asnehite punaḥ snehabastidānameva jñeyam
varcaḥsañcayealpabala iti sañcite male sati alpabalo varcaḥsañcayapravartanākṣama ityarthaḥ
tairāvṛta iti padaṃ pratyekaṃ vātādiṣu pañcasu yojanīyam
abhibhavādapīti vātādināaavṛtamārgatvānna yāti; tathā tena vātādinolbaṇenābhibhūtaguṇatvācca na āyāti
tasya lakṣaṇamiti yathākramaṃ vātādyāvṛtasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇamaṅgamardādi
ete ca stambhādayo vātāvṛtasnehamahimnaiva jāyante, tena snehaprayogāt pūrvaṃ na bhavantyeva
āmavihitā kriyeti “āmaṃ praduṣṭamannābhibhūtaṃ punarullikhet” (vi.a.2) ityādinā vihitāanusartavyā
snehaṃ viḍāvṛtamityādau vartibhiriti phalavartibhiḥ, kecittu ‘bastibhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti
śyāmābilvādīni ca śyāmā ca bilvādīni daśamūlāni ca śyāmābilvādīni; kiṃvā, śyāmādīnyapyatra kalpoktāni nava gṛhyante; tairnirūhasya tathāanuvāsanasya ca sādhanamiha jñeyam

abhukte ityādihetutrayaṃ snehabasterūrdhvagamanakāraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ; pūrvaṃ ca yadyapyabhojanadānameva kāraṇaṃ pratiśrutaṃ, tathāapyekakāryatayā cikitsitasāmānyācca śūnyapāyutvātipīḍane apyatra hetutvenokte; śūnyapāyutvaṃ cādhonirodhākartṛtayā snehamūrdhvaṃ nayati
āgacchata iti āgamanasamaya eva stambhādi kartavyam
chardighnīḥ kriyāḥ chardiścikitsite “manoabhighāte tu manoanukūlāḥ” ityādinā “sukha eva jetum” (ci.a.20) ityantenoktā ihābhipretā jñeyāḥ
alpo vāaavṛta iti stokaniḥsṛtaḥ, stokaśca vṛtaḥ

tadāatyartharūkṣatayā śarīrasya tiṣṭhannapi sneho na vyāpadamāvahatītyarthaḥ; upekṣya iti na tatra yathoktavātāvṛtasnehacikitsā kartavyetyarthaḥ; anyatrāpyuktam- “ahorātrādapi snehaḥ pratyāgacchanna dūṣyati
vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇigataśca tathodāvṛttaśca vāto yeṣāṃ te vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇyudāvṛttavātāḥ
uktaṃ cānyatra- “rūkṣasya bahuvātasya snehabastiṃ dine dine

tryahāt snehaṃ pacatīti pakvāśayopalepakaṃ snehaṃ bahirniḥsṛtenoṣmaṇā pacati; yadyapyatrāgninordhvasthitena tādṛśaḥ sambandhaḥ snehasya nāsti, tathāapi jāṭharasyaiva vimiśritairavayavaistatpāko vaktavyaḥ
prāyaḥśabdena pañcāhapākamapi darśayati, tena pañcāhadānamapyanuvāsane mandāgniṃ prati prāguktaṃ jñeyam, uktaṃ hi- “paratastryahe vā dvyaheanuvāsyoahani pañcame vā” (si.a.10) iti
vātamagniṃ ca dūṣayediti atra vātadūṣaṇamajīrṇajanakatayā vātāvaraṇācca jñeyam
nirūhānuvāsanayoḥ parasparāvyavadhānadāne doṣamāha- snehavastiṃ nirūhaṃ vetyādi
nirūhāt pavanādbhayamiti nirantaranirūheṇa śarīrasya śodhanātiyogāt pavanādbhayaṃ bhavati
nirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehya iti nirūheṇa srotaḥsu śodhiteṣu kaphapittajaye kṛte snehavastirabhyasyaḥ; tathāanuvāsitaśca samyaganuvāsanena hi snigdhaḥ sannirūhya eva
anuvāsanaviśeṣasya mātrābasterviṣayaṃ pramāṇaṃ guṇāṃśca yathākramamāha- karmetyādi
hrasvāyā iti ardhāhaḥpariṇamanīyāyāḥ; uktaṃ hi- “ahorātramahaḥ kṛtsnaṃ dinārdhaṃ ca pratīkṣate
uttamā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati” (sū.a.13) iti
tantrāntare snehamātrātrayaṃ pramāṇairevoktaṃ; yathā- “ṣaṭpalī tu bhavejjyeṣṭhā, madhyamā tripalī bhavet
suśrutenāpi bastipramāṇamuktaṃ; yathā anuvāsane- “tasyāpi vikalpoardhārdhamātrāvakṛṣṭoaparihāryo mātrābastiḥ” (su.ci.a.35) iti
anena ca sārdhapalamāno mātrābastirukto bhavati; tatra hi ṣaṭpalaḥ snehabastiruktaḥ, anuvāsanaṃ tu tripalam

netragatā tathā bastipuṭakagatā ca vyāpat tathā netrāsamyakpraṇidhānajanyā ca yā vyāpadastāsāṃ siddhiḥ; tena netrabastivyāpatsiddhiḥ duṣṭanetrabastipuṭakayośca vyāpatsiddhiḥ tayoḥ sadoṣatvena jñātvā parivarjanam
viṣamaḥ viṣamasaṃsthānaḥ, sthulaḥ atipramāṇaḥ, jālikaḥ sūkṣmānekacchidraḥ, vātalaḥ vātaduṣṭaḥ, sa cātra vihitasnehādeḥ phenilatvādinā niścīyate
visratvam āmagandhatā, daurgrāhyaṃ durgrahatā, cyutiḥ hastādbhraṃśaḥ, adhāryatvaṃ basteriti klinnatvāddhi dhāraṇāyogyatvaṃ bastipuṭakasya
tatra savātatā anucchvāsya baddhe bastau tathā niḥśeṣaṃ ca datte bhavati
ulluptatvamiha pīḍanadoṣo yaḥ pīḍanavicchedaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ pīḍyate sa jñeyaḥ

ete cānucchvāsanādayo yadyapi pūrvameva niṣiddhāḥ “subaddhamucchvāsya ca nirvalīkaṃ” (si.a.3) ityādinaiva, tathāapi pramādāttathāprayoge sati jātavyāpadāṃ cikitsābhidhānārthamasmin prakaraṇe punaruktāḥ
niṣkṛṣṭe sahaseti cchedaḥ, utkṣepastvasahasāapi vyāpattikara eva

tiryagvalyāvṛtadvāre baddhe vāapīti tiryakpraṇihite netre valyāvṛtadvāre sati tathā bastidravyagatasūtradravyādinā vibaddhe netre bastidravyaṃ na yāti; tannetraṃ tiryakpraṇihitaṃ niṣkṛṣya ṛju praveśayet, baddhadvāraṃ ca saṃśodhya praveśayediti yojyam
gude pratihatoanila iti pīḍanavicchedajanito vāyurgudāt pratyāhataḥ
atimātrapraṇīteneti punaḥ punaḥ praṇītena; anye tu duṣpraveśanamatimātrapraṇītamāhuḥ; atipraṇayanaṃ yadyapi grathitakarṇikāyā upari na bhavati, tathāapi karṇikāpīḍayā gudapīḍanādatipraveśo jñeyaḥ
atipīḍane koṣṭhe vā tiṣṭhatīti pakṣaḥ mandādatipīḍanādvātāvaraṇācca jñeyaḥ; galagamanaṃ tu tīvrātipīḍanādanāvaraṇācca bhavati
iyaṃ ca vyāpat pūrvādhyāye āhāraṃ vinā dattānuvāsanaviṣayatayoktā, iha tu nirūhasyānuvāsanasya cātipīḍanajanyatayā bodhyata iti viśeṣaḥ
iha bastirvireko vā koṣṭhastheapravartamāne, kaṇṭhapīḍanādi tu galagate jñeyam

vyāpatsiddhyabhidhānaprasaṅgādvamanavirecanayorapi vyāpatsiddhirucyate, bastivyāpatsiddhistu vamanavirecanapūrvakatvādbasteḥ paścādabhidhīyate; tena bastivyāpatsiddhyabhidhānena basteriha karmabhyaḥ prādhānyamapi dyotitaṃ; bastiprādhānyaṃ “tasmāccikitsārdhamiti bruvanti sarvāṃ cikitsāmapi bastimeke” (si.a.1) ityanenoktam

śodhanayośca vidhiryadyapi kalpanāsiddhyupakalpanīyādau tatra tatrābhihitaḥ, tathāapyanuktaviśeṣapratipādanārthamabhidhānaṃ, tatprasaṅgācca tatrāpyuktoartha ucyate, sarvathāanuktābhidhānaṃ ‘nātisnigdhān virecayet’ ityādi jñeyam
teṣāṃ sādhāraṇā iti uṣṇavarṣaśītānāṃ sādhāraṇāḥ; anudbhūtoṣṇavarṣaśītā iti yāvat
śodhanaṃ pratīti śodhane kartavyeayaṃ yathoktaḥ prāvṛḍādiṛtuvibhāgo bhavati; svasthavṛttau rasotpattau vā tasyāśitīyokta eva varṣāśaraddhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmarūpaḥ ṛtukramo bhavati

etaduktasaṃśodhanāṅgartukramavibhāgenaiva carakasaṃskāraapi navegāndhāraṇīye “mādhavaprathame māsi” (sū.a.7) ityādinā granthena caitraśrāvaṇāgrahāyaṇeṣu vamanādisaṃśodhanamuktaṃ, tathā rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) ca śiśiraṃ parityajya prāvṛḍādinaiva ṛtukramaḥ saṃśodhanāṅgatayoktaḥ; tena, rasabalotpādacintāyāṃ svasthavṛttānuṣṭhāneṣu ca śiśirādikramo bhavati, saṃśodhanavyavasthāyāṃ tu prāvṛḍādiriti prāvṛḍādikramoayaṃ saṃśodhanānukūlatayāaacāryeṇa kalpito na pāramārthikaḥ
ye tu, prāvṛḍādikramaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe kūle, uttareapi śiśirādikramaṃ vadanti, tanmate ‘śodhanaṃ prati’ iti granthoanupapannaḥ; tena, “bhūyo varṣati parjanyo gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe jalam
tena varṣāprāvṛḍākhyau ṛtū teṣāṃ prakalpitau” ityādinā granthena yadi nāma deśabhedenāpi ṛtukramaḥ pāramārthikoabhidhīyate, tathāapi nāsāvācāryasyehābhimataḥ, prapañcitaścāyamarthaḥ sūtrasthāna eva

ayaṃ ca śodhanakālopadeśoanātyayike vyādhau jñeyaḥ, ātyayike tu ūṣmādipratikāraṃ kṛtvā atyuṣṇeapi kāle saṃśodhanapravṛttirbhavatyeva, ukto hyayamartho rogabhiṣagjitīye- “ātyayike tu punaḥ karmaṇi kāmamṛtuṃ vikalpya kṛtrimaguṇopadhānena” (vi.a.8) ityādinā granthena

karmaṇāmityādau antareṣviti vamanānantaraṃ virecane kartavye virecanānantaraṃ vā bastau kartavye snehasvedau yathoktavidhānena punaḥ kartavyau, na sakṛtprayuktenaiva snehasvedena pañcakarmāṇi kartavyānītyarthaḥ
snehaṃ cānte prayojayediti saṃśodhanakarmaparisamāptau saṃśodhanajanitaglāniparihārārthaṃ saṃśamanīyasnehaṃ prayojayedityarthaḥ
avaśyakartavye virecane sati atisnigdhāsnigdhayoḥ samyagyogakārakaṃ virecanaṃ darśayannāha- nātītyādi

anatisnigdhe snehavirecanamanatisnigdhatvena kriyamāṇavirecanāyogapratiṣedhārtham; atisnigdhasya snehavirecanaṃ snehanaprakarṣādativegaṃ gacchan pracalitānapi doṣān nihantuṃ na śaknoti, doṣāstu tena virecanena svasthānāt pracyāvitā bhūyaḥsrotaḥsu līyante, tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ rūkṣaṃ virecanaṃ samyagyogakārakaṃ dadyādityayamāśayaḥ
ekāgramanaseti saṃśodhanaikacittena, kāmādivyagramanaso hi vegavighātādayogaḥ syāt
snehasvedayoḥ phalaṃ ‘snigdhāt pātrāt’ ityādinā bhūridṛṣṭāntena darśayan snehasvedayoravaśyakartavyatāṃ sūcayati
viṣyandayati sarvata iti sarvataḥ sthitaṃ dravamākarṣati
agnidṛṣṭāntena snigdhagātrasya samyagdoṣaharaṇamucyate, tṛtīyadṛṣṭāntena tu snehasvedayormilitayoḥ phalamucyate

śodhanasamyagyogasāmagryabhidhāne proktasnehasvedayoḥ phalamabhidhāya, kramāgatasya jīrṇe pītamityasya viparyaye doṣamāha- ajīrṇe vardhate glāniriti; ajīrṇāvasthāyāṃ pīte śodhane sati glānirmahatī bhavati
viparītaṃ pravartate iti vamanamadho yāti, virecanaṃ cordhvaṃ yāti

yadyapi ca sukhāsvādādayo mātrāyāḥ phalaṃ na bhavanti, tathāapīha mātrāyāḥ praśastatvena dravyasaṃskārādiviśeṣādhīnā api te gṛhyante; sukhādyāśrayadravyagatatvamapi hi mātrāyāḥ prāśastyamiha; kiṃvā, evambhūte eva saṃśodhane etanmātrāvattvaṃ paribhāṣitaṃ jñeyam
vamanavirecanayoḥ pūrvadine yathā bhoktavyaṃ tadāha- nara ityādi
virecanaṃ pātā laghu aśītaṃ ca bhuñjīteti sambandhaḥ
utkliṣṭālpakaphatveneti vamanaṃ prati utkliṣṭakaphatvena, virecanaṃ prati tvalpakaphatveneti vibhāgaḥ
vamanavirecanayoḥ śuddhiliṅgāni yadyapi prāguktāni, tathāapīha śeṣauṣadhamalādiviśeṣābhidhānārthaṃ punaḥ pītauṣadhasyetyādinā tānyabhidhatte
kaphānuge pitte ūrdhvahṛtadoṣaṃ vadet, viṭpitte cānukaphe dṛśyamāneadhohṛtadoṣaṃ vadediti yojanā; etat kaphāntatvaṃ virecanasya, vamanasya ca pittāntatvaṃ pūrvameva vyāhṛtam
etat pittāntatvaṃ kaphāntatvaṃ vāasamyakśuddheapi doṣasyānupūrvyāavasthānādbhavatīti kṛtvā lakṣaṇāntarāṇyapi etayoḥ sāhacaryeṇāha- kārśyadaurbalye cet salāghave iti
virecanayoge sāvaśeṣa evauṣadhe śuddhilakṣaṇadarśane sati kartavyamāha- vāmayettu tataḥ śeṣamauṣadhamiti; śuddhilakṣaṇe jāte śeṣamauṣadhamupalabhya virecanātiyogapratiṣedhārthaṃ vāmayedityarthaḥ
na tvalāghave ityanena lāghavavyatiriktaśeṣaśuddhilakṣaṇadarśane satyapi na virecanaśeṣauṣadhavamiḥ kartavyā
vamanauṣadhaprayoge yāvat staimityānilasaṅgau vartete, tāvannirudgāreapi bheṣaje sati vamanaṃ kārayitavyam
pramādāllāghavatanutvayoḥ parataḥ kriyamāṇavamanasya doṣamāha- āpat paraṃ bhavediti; āpaditi atiyogalakṣaṇā
anye tu, staimitye ityādināapi virecanauṣadhasyaivāvasthikaṃ vamanamucyate ityāhuḥ
yadyapi nirūḍhasyāpyagnimāndyaṃ bhavati, tathāapi nirūḍhasya tādṛgagnimāndyaṃ na bhavati yena peyādikramaḥ kriyate, ato nirūhavyudāsārthaṃ saṃśodhanābhyāmiti dvivacanaṃ kṛtam
yā tu samyagviriktalakṣaṇe “ūrjoagniḥ” (si.a.1) ityanenāgnivṛddhiruktā, sā ca virecanauṣadhakṣobhātisaṅgāt kṛtāagnimāndyāpekṣayāagnivṛddhiḥ; teneha yātyagnirmandatāmiti vacanena samaṃ na virodhaḥ
tarpaṇādikrame ca peyāyāḥ sthāne svacchatarpaṇaṃ, vilepyāḥ sthāne ca ghanatarpaṇaṃ deyam
) etā vyāpadaḥ preṣyādivaiguṇyādutpannā ayogādatiyogācca bhavantīti vākyārthaḥ

tatrādhmānamayogādbhavati, parikartikā tvatiyogāt, srāvoayogāt, hṛdgrahoapyayogādeva, tathāaṅgagrahoayogācca bhavati, jīvādānamatiyogāt; vibhraṃśastu gudabhraṃśa-sañjñābhraṃśa-kaṇḍvādilakṣaṇabhraṃśabhedāttrividho vaktavyaḥ; gudabhraṃśa-sañjñābhraṃśāvatiyogajanyau, śeṣastu vibhraṃśoayogajanyaḥ; upadravoapyayogajanya eva, klamoapyayogajaḥ
